store_data.about_the_game:
SnapDogs is a cozy dog sticker jigsaw game.

There are 100 cute and funny little dog scenes: stealing sushi, hiding in boxes, climbing into a fish tank, napping lazily, and more. Sticker pieces are scattered across the table, waiting for you to put them back together.

Look for clues in each dog's pose and scene, organize the table, and place each piece where it belongs. When the position is right, the sticker snaps together with a satisfying little sound. Piece by piece, the whole table fills with charming dogs.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]

[*]100 dog-scene sticker puzzles, each made from 2 to 5 pieces

[*]100 Steam achievements, one for each dog sticker

[*]Freely arrange completed dog stickers after finishing a level

[*]Hide the UI and take photos of your finished dog-sticker table

[*]Relaxing music, soft sound effects, and plenty of dog barks and happy pants

[/list]

[h2]How to Play[/h2]

Move sticker pieces around the table and place them in the right spots. Right-click to rotate the piece or group you are holding. Correctly matched pieces become one object, then can connect with other pieces or groups until the full dog sticker is complete.

As levels progress, more dogs and pieces will appear on the table. You can zoom, pan the table, and box-select multiple pieces to search and organize more comfortably.

If you cannot find unfinished pieces, use the hint function to briefly highlight them.

[h2]Controls[/h2]

[list]

[*]Left mouse button: pick up, drag, drop pieces, and click buttons

[*]Right mouse button: rotate the held piece or group

[*]Mouse wheel: zoom the table

[*]Middle mouse button / Space: pan the table

[*]F: reset the table view

[*]Esc: hide or show the game UI

[*]H: highlight unfinished pieces

[/list]

SnapDogs is a cozy dog sticker jigsaw game.

There are 100 cute and funny little dog scenes: stealing sushi, hiding in boxes, climbing into a fish tank, napping lazily, and more. Sticker pieces are scattered across the table, waiting for you to put them back together.

Look for clues in each dog's pose and scene, organize the table, and place each piece where it belongs. When the position is right, the sticker snaps together with a satisfying little sound. Piece by piece, the whole table fills with charming dogs.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]

[*]100 dog-scene sticker puzzles, each made from 2 to 5 pieces

[*]100 Steam achievements, one for each dog sticker

[*]Freely arrange completed dog stickers after finishing a level

[*]Hide the UI and take photos of your finished dog-sticker table

[*]Relaxing music, soft sound effects, and plenty of dog barks and happy pants

[/list]

[h2]How to Play[/h2]

Move sticker pieces around the table and place them in the right spots. Right-click to rotate the piece or group you are holding. Correctly matched pieces become one object, then can connect with other pieces or groups until the full dog sticker is complete.

As levels progress, more dogs and pieces will appear on the table. You can zoom, pan the table, and box-select multiple pieces to search and organize more comfortably.

If you cannot find unfinished pieces, use the hint function to briefly highlight them.

[h2]Controls[/h2]

[list]

[*]Left mouse button: pick up, drag, drop pieces, and click buttons

[*]Right mouse button: rotate the held piece or group

[*]Mouse wheel: zoom the table

[*]Middle mouse button / Space: pan the table

[*]F: reset the table view

[*]Esc: hide or show the game UI

[*]H: highlight unfinished pieces

[/list]

store_data.about_the_game:
You will not save the world. You loose magic swords into it, and witness how it bends around them.


Your human master left you one lesson: "Do not think the work ends when the blade is forged. Witness the life that follows."
A long-lived elf, you kept that lesson so faithfully that the iron itself woke with a will of its own — the birth of the magic sword.
In a workshop beyond the town, you light the forge, and your story begins.

Forge

Choose a recipe and materials, and shape a magic sword over several days. At completion a cold void opens and a staged reveal begins.
Darkness, then a silhouette, the glow of rarity, the crest, and finally the numbers — the blade's appearance and properties emerge one beat at a time.

Deal

Read each visitor's Vessel, Ambition, Ethics and Lifespan with your appraising eye, and decide: should this person hold this blade?
Give too strong a sword to the ambitious and you invite ruin; entrust it to the just and a hero is born.
Swords carry no affinity tags — the judgment is yours alone.

Observe

A sold blade lives on in the world. Days later its wielder rises as a hero or falls to destruction, and that fate returns to you as a story.
Your reputation grows along two separate axes — fame and infamy — shifting your clientele and even the balance of factions.

Inherit

People age and die. The sword remains, and returns to your hand. Melt a well-worn blade down as material and its skills pass into the next.
An endless loop of inheritance, honed across generations.

Beyond the workshop

  • At least 100 recipes, over 50 materials, and more than 350 magic-sword designs
  • Nearly 100 adventurers and more than 20 unique customers, each with a fate to follow
  • More than 20 quests and multiple endings shaped by accumulated choices
  • At least 30 original BGM tracks, plus character motifs, stingers and sound effects
  • A walkable Blade Museum where returned swords and their histories can be preserved

A quiet craft, one blade at a time. The blade remains; the wielder does not — spend a while with the marks they leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
Put first class back together

First Class Waifu is a relaxing tile-swap puzzle game set aboard a luxurious private jet. Each level divides a hand-crafted illustration into a 7x4 grid and shuffles the tiles. Swap them back into place and reveal the complete scene.

Simple rules, no pressure

Click one tile, then another, and the two trade places. A reference thumbnail sits in the corner, while a progress bar tracks how many tiles are already home. There are no timers and no fail states, so you can solve every puzzle at your own pace. If you get stuck, the hint button restores a batch of tiles for you.

Every puzzle comes to life

Complete a grid and the tiles dissolve away. The scene you just rebuilt comes to life as a fully animated reward with sound.

Your first-class itinerary

  • 10 hand-crafted 7x4 tile-swap puzzles
  • A fully animated reward scene with sound for every level
  • No timers, no fail states and a built-in hint system
  • Level select for replaying every unlocked scene
  • 10 Steam Achievements, one for each level

Adults only

First Class Waifu contains explicit sexual content and uncensored nudity. It is intended only for players aged 18 and over. All depicted characters are adults.

store_data.about_the_game:
SaboTour is a chaotic asymmetric party racer for up to 6 players.

Up to five Racers battle it out on a procedurally generated track,

drifting through corners and fighting for the podium. But they're not

alone — one player is the Saboteur, watching everything from an

observation tower at the center of the track.

From up there, the Saboteur picks their moment and strikes:

  • ICE BOMB — freeze the road and send racers sliding into the walls

  • CHICKEN FLOCK — release a stampede that scatters across the track

  • DRIFT TRAP — punish anyone who dares to drift through the zone

Every checkpoint is a target. Every lap is a gamble. Racers win if

even one of them crosses the finish line — but the fastest still

earns bragging rights on the leaderboard. The Saboteur wins if the

clock runs out first.

No two tracks are the same — every race generates a brand new course,

so the Saboteur can never rely on the same tricks twice.

FEATURES:

  • Asymmetric multiplayer: up to 5 Racers vs. 1 Saboteur

  • Procedurally generated tracks — a new layout every race

  • Physics-based drift racing

  • Three distinct sabotage abilities with real strategic timing

  • Built for quick, chaotic sessions with friends

store_data.about_the_game:
The war reaches Anping, in the city of Tainan.

An emergency broadcast comes through on your phone. Everyone is to evacuate inland. You can't be bothered to go out, and you don't much like crowds, so you decide to stay in.

Next morning you open your eyes and you're still alive. Outside the window everything is chaos. The power is out, and whatever was in the fridge has probably turned.

That's where the game starts.

There's no counterattack, no base to defend, no fighting your way out. What you have to do is far more ordinary: stay alive one more day, in an apartment with no electricity, on whatever you can turn up by going through drawers.

This isn't a game about a hero. It's a game about the person who didn't leave — why they didn't, whether they still could, and how to get through the next few hours.

There are only ever a few cards on screen

Search, move, sleep, nap, check backpack, supplies here, codex — action cards of that kind. All you do is decide what the next stretch of time gets spent on.

  • Search — go through the room. There are cans in the kitchen cupboard, but you'll need to find the can opener first. Until then a can is just a sealed tin.

  • Move — walking from the bedroom to the bathroom takes a few minutes. Taking the stairs down from the fourteenth floor is another matter entirely. The lift doesn't work; there's no power.

  • Eat, drink, sleep — a salty can will leave you thirstier. Sleeping saves your game, and puts you through a whole night at your most vulnerable.

Every action card spends in-game time, and how much it spends is decided by the thing itself — opening one drawer and descending fourteen flights of stairs are not the same errand.

Time is the only genuinely scarce thing here. Your body will not wait for you.

What you're up against isn't a who — it's eight numbers going down

Health, fullness, thirst, energy, body temperature, injury, mood, hygiene. Each falls at its own pace, and none of them is a case of "higher is better": eating until you're stuffed is as much a problem as passing out from hunger. Every one of them has a comfortable range.

The weather won't cooperate either. Full four-season simulation: the gap between day and night temperatures, rain that settles in for days, a typhoon that arrives without warning. Nobody gets to predict tomorrow. Whatever you wake up to is the weather you get.

When it's cold, a down jacket is worth far more than a can of pineapple.

Taiwanese

Taiwanese is a language a great many people in Taiwan speak every day. Speaking it takes no thought; writing it down or reading it is where most people get stuck. There was a generation that was fined and made to wear a sign for speaking Taiwanese at school, and what survived that was the speaking, and only the speaking.

This game's dialogue is written in Taiwanese Pe̍h-ōe-jī (POJ), a romanised orthography. Choose Taiwanese and you can pick a second language to run alongside it: POJ on top, the one you can read underneath. If you speak it but can't read it, you can match the sounds up as you play. If you don't speak it at all, you still know what you're reading.

Supported languages: 繁體中文, English, 日本語, Deutsch, and Taiwanese (Pe̍h-ōe-jī).

You decide who you are in the opening minutes

At the moment you wash your face and look in the bathroom mirror — young / adult / older, male / female, six combinations. Different bodies start in different places.

You get stronger after that, but only in the bluntest way: you train what you do. Carry more and you get stronger. Walk further and your stamina improves. Strength decides how much you can carry and whether you can shift that hand cart; stamina decides how tired the same task leaves you.

No experience points. No skill tree. Only the things you have actually spent the last few days doing.

What you can carry, and what you can't

Supplies have weight, and you have two hands, one backpack, and perhaps a hand cart. What to take and what to leave behind is a trade-off you are forced into at every turn.

An expired packet of curry is both a liquid food and an expired item. Whether you eat it is your call.

That raincoat won't make you warm. What it guarantees is that you won't get soaked through — and being soaked makes your body temperature fall much faster.

There is nobody to ask

There are no NPCs in this game. From beginning to end, the only voice you hear is the protagonist talking to himself.

Scattered through the rooms are codex fragments. Picking one up unlocks a codex entry — how this war got to where it is. The announcements, the notices, the days that were once entirely unremarkable.

None of it affects whether you survive. You can go a whole playthrough without picking up a single one and still get through every day.

But you will not meet another living person in this game, and the fragments are the only way you'll come to know any of them. Whether the protagonist stops to finish reading is itself part of who he is.

About the name

Anping is a district of Tainan, and the place where this story happens.

Read its two characters the other way round and you get 平安 — safe, unharmed, having come through it. A place name that also happens to be a wish.

An-pêng, set alongside the title, is how those two characters sound in Taiwanese, written in Pe̍h-ōe-jī. It isn't Mandarin romanisation; in Mandarin the same place is Anping.

About the artwork

The scenes start as photographs taken on location — the lanes of Anping, the stairwells, apartment courtyards. Each one is then worked over: removing things that shouldn't be in the frame, commercial branding, anything touching on someone's privacy, before being stylised into animation by AI.

Every single one took a long time.

Where development stands

This is a project in development, currently made by one person.

The core systems are running — time, weather, status resolution, supplies, story and quests are all in place. Early Access will take the game out of the flat: 20 new outdoor scenes and 5 new indoor ones, so you can actually get out of that building.

One more thing worth saying plainly: the interface is currently all engine-default styling. Buttons, windows and lists have not been designed yet. The proper interface design will be done during Early Access.

Early Access is planned for late 2026.

“What was in the fridge has already gone off. A while longer won’t hurt.”

Moving through outdoor areas can bring you into contact with hostile people. Choosing to fight and winning results in that person's death, and a body remains on the ground; there is no blood, no wounds and no depiction of physical injury. Avoiding the encounter is always an option.

Cigarettes and alcohol can be found and are the player's choice to take or use. Medicine scavenged from a pharmacy is unlabelled and is used to restore health.

The protagonist's monologue occasionally contains strong language.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story:

The city is once again experiencing strange weather.

A mysterious downpour causes anyone caught in the rain to turn into a frog.

Once the rain stops, they return to human form.

No one knows where the Frog Rain comes from, nor when it will strike again.

For most people, the Frog Rain has already become a part of everyday life.
But for me, a transfer student, it becomes an opportunity to connect with others and form meaningful bonds.

In these absurd yet peaceful days, I try to get closer to them and understand them.

Little by little, I begin to discover the desires and secrets hidden in each person's heart.

Gameplay:

A story-driven, multi-route visual novel where your choices lead to different experiences.

Explore intimate relationships and character growth at the heart of the story, with romance or horror elements featured in some routes.

Over 200,000 Chinese characters of text, 4 interactive characters, and 10 endings.

Each playthrough takes 3–5 hours, with 10–15 hours needed to experience all endings.

Characters:

  • Main Characters (5):

Chun Ran: The protagonist and a transfer student. She wants to make friends, but the only people left for her to befriend are these four weirdos.

Jin Xiao: An honor student who looks down on everyone else—and looks down on you, too.

Bu Yuezhi: Always seems to be in a bad mood after waking up, and smells faintly of disinfectant.

Ku Limu: Acts and speaks somewhat strangely, and seems to be isolated by the other students in the class.

Tian Sinong: A campus peddler with a loud voice. The quality of his goods is pretty poor.

Content Warnings:

  • Some characters cannot be pursued romantically;

  • Contains LGBTQ+ content and same-sex romance;

  • Contains a love-triangle-style route in which you can develop an intimate relationship with two characters at the same time;

  • Deals with themes including surrealism, loneliness, death, trauma, and deception, and contains murder, suicide, violence, and blood. Some scenes may be psychologically intense;

  • Contains non-sexual nudity;

  • Contains a lot of frog imagery;

  • This work is entirely fictional and is not related to any real person, group, event, or other real-world entity.

Please consider your own preferences and tolerance before playing.

Development Plans:

  • As of September 2026, the 200,000+ word script has been fully completed, and art and presentation work are underway. Development logs and previews will be posted on Weibo and Xiaohongshu from time to time. Feel free to follow us ^_^!

  • Demo: Coming by the end of 2026. It includes part of the story before the character routes branch off, with an estimated playtime of 2 hours.

  • Full Release: Planned for summer 2027. The full version will support Chinese and English, with a Japanese localization currently under discussion.

  • All story content, presentation, UI, and character settings are subject to change and will be finalized in the full release.

Development Team:

汉谟拉比炒面&我的屁是香哒（MM&PP）: A two-person creative team focused on original comics and visual novels.

store_data.about_the_game:
Prologue: A Game of Cards in the Fiery Sea  

The old king and the enemy monarch recognized each other on the battlefield - twenty years ago, they had been comrades-in-arms on the road of escape.  

"Krens," the old king said, "Look, what have I brought for you?"  

"A deck of cards is also a battle."  

The two countries went to war, and those who died were the strength of the nation and the loved ones of the people. So they agreed: to use card games as a substitute for war.  

But the pact of peace was betrayed. The old king was ambushed by a fire attack on his way back to the city, lying in a pool of blood; while the monarch of the enemy country was struck dead by a lightning bolt on his way back. The two countries became sworn enemies, and that deck of cards symbolizing peace, along with the secrets of the two kings, were all reduced to ashes.  

Many years later, you will become the heir of one of the six kingdoms and sit at the round table. This "King's Chess Game" will never come to an end.  

Six countries vying for the championship, the card game becomes the battle scene.  

In the world of "Crown‘s Gambit", every year the six kingdoms hold a meeting to compete for the crown symbolizing supreme royal power. During the meeting, warfare is prohibited - instead, card games are played.  

· Six monarchs, divided into two federations, competing in 3v3 battles

· Your Royal Knights are the trump card on the battlefield

· Your King must safely reach the finish line

· Your Queen needs to be escorted by the Knights' group  

The poker table is like a battlefield.  

Gameplay: Tower Defense Rules × Knight Narratives  

We have fully retained the core rules of Shandong Gouji - this classic card game that originated in the 1960s and was included in the list of Qingdao's Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2008 - and reinterpreted it using the Western knight system:  

Game terminology: In-game narrative; Rule explanation

Common cards (4-9) - Commoners - Basic card type, quantity determines power

2 / Jack / King / Queen / Duke - Special identity cards, each having its own privileges

Tournament cards (5 ones of 10 / 4 ones of J etc.) constitute (Royal Knights' Order), only members of the Knights' Order can guard the Queen.

Royal Knights' Order (Tournament cards)

When a player plays a tournament-level card type (such as five 10s, four Js, etc.), only their opponent can respond. This is the most psychologically-charged moment in the game - you are always guessing: How many Knights does the opponent still have in their hand?  

Requirement: This is necessary for each round. The knight group escorts the queen back to the city. Draw the level cards and start the escort mission. If the escort is successful, it will be regarded as a successful completion of the requirement.  

Blindfold Attack: The Knight's Ambush

When an enemy team that is not your opponent plays the Knight's Team card, you can use a stronger Knight's Team card to "burn" it away (cancel the contract). A successful burn card attack can instantly turn the tide of the battle - just like in an ambush. Burn card attacks do come at a cost.  

Core gameplay: Your throne requires protection.  

3v3 Federation Battle

Six players are divided into two federations, sitting alternately. Your teammates sit in your "neighbor's seat", while your "opponent" sits directly opposite. The game requires the cooperation of three people - trust, which is more important than card skills.  

Zhengke (the one to finish all their cards first) Striving for the Crown. The federation that escorts the king to the finish line first wins the glory.  

Single 3 = King The King's Final Mission (Single 3 as the tiebreaker)

The King (Single 3) must be played as the last card. If your King is trapped by your opponent, the entire federation will be in a passive position - protect your King until the very end. The King's ultimate coronation, the King must be the last to play, symbolizing the monarch protecting the subjects.  

 

Card announcement: The King's Critical Moment (Remaining ≤ 10 cards)

When a player has no more than 10 cards in hand, the remaining quantity must be disclosed. From this moment on, you become the center of attention - your teammates will fully support you in rushing towards the throne, while your opponents will do whatever it takes to stop you.  

Characteristic System  

· Federal Score: Even if the federation loses, individuals who perform well can still receive high scores - honor, not just victory.

· Customized Experience: Unique backdrops, expressions, and monarch skins for each country - your kingdom, defined by you.

· Six Kingdom Power Choices: Each monarch has a unique background story and starting tendency - which faction will you represent?  

How many cards will your glory defend the throne until?  

"Unite the allies and seize the crown"  

" Crown‘s Gambit " is not merely a poker game; it is a narrative about trust, betrayal and glory. Every card played is a silent farewell to the teammates, and every burned card is a resolute response to the opponents.  

The deck of cards belonging to the old king and Kronos did not burn up in the inferno. It ended up in your possession.  

Now, sit around the round table and form your federation - compete for the crown that belongs to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
SURVIVE YOUR NOSTALGIC URGE 

Are you still not tired of dwelling in those sweet memories of the 90s you have? Are you craving another nostalgia bait? Do you want to fry your dopamine receptors with another roguelike?  Well I cannot bring your past back, but I can abuse semiotics and aesthetics and a saturated genre to try evoke those feelings in you! 

Survive hordes of enemies, earn XP, collect weapons and upgrades and upgrade your upgrades! see numbers popping up and fancy effects happening, all that with visuals inspired by the 90s and early 2000s games, UI and operating systems.

ON A SERIOUS NOTE

PROJECT.98 Is a roguelike, you acquire XP by destroying enemies and each time you level up you can acquire a new random upgrade, you can also destroy bosses that drop a chest containing a granted higher rarity pool. Upgrades have four levels of rarity, they can be new weapons, augmentations to your character stats or even change the status or behavior of a weapon you already posses. Each run lasts 20 minutes with bosses and timed events through, each completed run will take you to a NG+ state and award you with a random boon and a bane.

THAT NOSTALGIC LOOK

With its visuals heavily inspired by that which you were used to look at in the 90s and early 2000s, PROJECT.98 also packs a CRT Shader to bring you closer to what could have been your youth, but even if not, it is also for those who just love the aesthetics of that era. A true love letter to that era and the roguelike genre.

store_data.about_the_game:
STARSHRED is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter set in the depths of space. Take control of Gemini, weave through barrages of bullets, and survive against waves of enemies that grow deadlier with every round.

At the end of every wave, choose one of three different upgrades and shape your build on the fly. Combine upgrades, discover new synergies, and create a completely different playstyle with every run. The same beginning can turn into a different kind of chaos every time.

Every run tells its own story. Choose upgrades between waves, collect transformations, chain synergies, and improve your ship in the hangar for the next attempt. Short runs, readable combat, and an arcade pace.

What awaits you?

  • Fast, readable top-down space combat

  • Escalating threats and boss encounters wave after wave

  • In-run upgrades and transformation synergies

  • Permanent progression through the hangar

  • Different regions, enemy types, and trading encounters

  • A replayable arcade loop designed for a single session

store_data.about_the_game:
One woman, one mountain, and a window you leave open.

Anne is wandering the mountain on the edge of your screen (or the full screen, I'm not your supervisor), a dog at her heel. She hunts, chops, climbs and...punches rocks as you direct. Every night she makes camp and lights a fire. No one knows why she's climbing. She knows.

PUNCH ROCK is a casual idle survival game that lives in a small window beside whatever else you're doing. It isn't a game you sit down to play. It's one you leave running that you can pay as much or as little attention to as you want.

You give her the day. She does the work.

Each morning you have a handful of action slots, as many as her pack can carry. Spread them across five pursuits: forage, chop, mine, climb, and camp. That's the whole plan. Then she goes and does it, at her own pace, in real time, whether you're watching or not.

You never steer her directly. The tray is your input. The mountain is the output.

The whole mountain.

Five bands stand between the first campfire and the last one, and each changes what a day costs.

  • Foothill forest. Green and generous. Where you learn the rhythm.

  • River valley. Autumn ground, wider country, further to walk for the same haul.

  • Highland scree. The swamp above the rope. Footing stops being free.

  • Snowline. Evergreens and real cold, and a still lakeshore that has no business being up this high.

  • Summit approach. Thin trees, thinner air, and the number you've been chasing.

Gear opens the way up. Ropes, packs, better tools, and things you'll find lying in a cleared field with no explanation attached. Each one raises the height she can hold, and the mountain immediately asks for more.

The mountain sets the burn rate.

  • Wood is warmth. The higher she climbs, the colder it gets, and the faster the fire eats.

  • Food is fuel. The further she ranges, the more she needs.

  • Ore and bone buy gear, and better gear raises the height she can hold.

Push past what she can carry and you aren't punished. You fall but recover. Somewhere above camp is a line where her output meets the mountain's drain, and the whole game is moving that line upward until it reaches the top.

You cannot lose this.

No death. No lost saves. No confiscated materials. The worst day on the mountain is a hard one, and Nugget pulls her out of it. Come back after a meeting and she's further up than you left her, with a fire going.

Attention is rewarded, never required. No timing bonuses. Nothing to click fast.

A finite climb.

The mountain is generated fresh for every run, but the journey isn't endless. The summit is forty to fifty days up and reaching it ends the game. Your score is how many days it took, and it's a number you want to get down.

Then you can go again, on a mountain you've never seen, and try to get there faster.

What's waiting at the top is small, and human, and said without a word.

Along the way

  • Pixel art with dawns, firelight, and weather moving across the slope

  • Sun, cloud, rain: cloud is always the warning, so the storm never blindsides you

  • A resizable window: tall strip, square, or wide that sits on top of your other work

  • Trail signs, an altitude readout, and a journal you open only when you want it

  • A whole mountain of gear, gates, and things worth walking off the path for

  • A dog

store_data.about_the_game:
Your uncle left you a resort in paradise. He forgot to mention it's sinking.

When a letter from the eccentric Uncle Reginald drags you to Palmyra Island, you expect a vacation. Instead you get Paradise Resort: leaking roofs, empty rooms, a mountain of debt — and a predatory buyout offer from Coral Bay Corporation that expires in twenty days.

The only thing standing between the resort and the wrecking ball? Five employees who have nowhere else to go, and no intention of leaving.

THE STAFF

  • Celeste — The manager who has held the ruins together for four years with spreadsheets, sarcasm and sheer stubbornness. She never lets go of anything. Maybe she should.

  • Sunny — The bartender whose cocktails are a lawsuit waiting for a name. All jokes, all the time — until the bar closes and the mask comes off.

  • Serena — The chef who can feed an entire island but can barely order bread over the phone. Her hands say everything her voice can't.

  • Rio — The lifeguard who has never lost a race and never won the thing she actually wanted. Ready. Set. Fall.

  • Lulu — The housekeeper who knows every secret on the island and keeps exactly one of his own. Underestimate him at your own risk.

Rebuild the resort by working every station — mix cocktails, survive the dinner rush, win the beach games, sweep the suites. Earn back the island's trust, face down Coral Bay's ice-cold heiress, and pull off the legendary Palmyra Festival: one night, every room full, or everything is lost.

And somewhere between the shifts and the schemes, one of them will steal your heart. Just one — this story doesn't do harems. Your choice decides whose epilogue you'll live.

FEATURES

  • A complete 2-3 hour story: prologue, 12 chapters, 5 romance epilogues and a post-credits surprise

  • Fully voiced main cast (English) — 650+ voiced dialogue lines

  • Uncensored animated adult scenes for every romance route

  • 5 romanceable characters (4 futanari, 1 femboy) — strictly one-on-one romance, no harem

  • 7 arcade-style resort minigames with combo scoring

  • Anime-style art, 20+ hand-tuned backgrounds, day/night scenes

  • Skip, auto, rollback and full save/load — proper VN comfort features

store_data.about_the_game:
Xenobiome Command is a colony management game set on a fungal exoplanet.

Each region is a map of areas to survey, claim, build on, and defend from the bloom.

Ferals press against your borders while incidents, blights, and seasons complicate every plan.

  • Survey fogged ground. Every survey costs vigor, and distant ground costs more.

  • Claim areas to harvest biomass, filtrate, fiber, and heat cells. Turn them into medicine, regolith, and alloy.

  • Build 38 structures, including beds, farms, labs, walls, and shrines.

  • Send wardens after feral packs. Combat plays out over several days: press the attack, pull the squad back, or draw the pack somewhere else.

  • Watch raids develop. Packs gather for days before moving on your colony.

  • Choose from 18 commanders and 7 traits. Each combination changes how a run develops.

  • Research across 4 tracks and draft 14 technologies. Your toolkit changes from run to run.

  • Face 127 incidents and colony events, including 28 core incidents with choices that carry a cost.

  • Seasons, drift, and blights change the conditions on each map.

  • Festivals, artifacts, and the contribution shop provide upgrades between runs.

  • Spend stars on artifact rerolls, map reseeds, an extra modifier slot, and permanent commissary items.

  • Each map records its highest cleared difficulty. Commanders earn titles as you play them.

  • Earn 624 rewards: achievements, artifacts, boons, doctrines, regional feats, difficulty badges, mastery titles, and commissary items.

  • Today's Drop is a new date-seeded scenario every day, with your best attempts saved on record.

  • Seeded runs begin with a draft. Pick your modifiers and choose one artifact from your collection.

Play through 2 campaigns and 27 handcrafted story maps: the Foothold, from first landing to last stand, then the Carrion, a faction that lives off what it kills. Narration between missions.

Then replay 24 scenario biomes, every distinct layout from both campaigns, with seeded layouts, quests, 16 rolled map traits, and adjustable threat.

Scenario mode also includes 4 asymmetric factions that change the core loop, not just the numbers.

An interactive tutorial guides you through your first colony.

The in-game codex explains every system.

Choose a pace from relaxed to sandbox. Pace modes control how much the in-game clock pressures you, or remove it entirely. Pause whenever you want.

Choose from 4 difficulty levels. Cancel queued builds for a full refund, and undo with one click. Play with mouse and keyboard, gamepad, or touch. On-screen prompts follow your active input, and you can rebind the controls.

Runs take about 10 to 30 minutes and save automatically when you quit. The game works offline, so a laptop without a connection is enough. Demo saves carry into the full game.

Buy Xenobiome Command once. Every future update and DLC will be free.

Xenobiome Command is made by one person. If you send a bug report through the Options menu, it reaches me directly. I read them and fix what I can. The game will keep growing after launch, and you will not be charged for that work.
store_data.detailed_description:
Xenobiome Command is a colony management game set on a fungal exoplanet.

Each region is a map of areas to survey, claim, build on, and defend from the bloom.

Ferals press against your borders while incidents, blights, and seasons complicate every plan.

  • Survey fogged ground. Every survey costs vigor, and distant ground costs more.

  • Claim areas to harvest biomass, filtrate, fiber, and heat cells. Turn them into medicine, regolith, and alloy.

  • Build 38 structures, including beds, farms, labs, walls, and shrines.

  • Send wardens after feral packs. Combat plays out over several days: press the attack, pull the squad back, or draw the pack somewhere else.

  • Watch raids develop. Packs gather for days before moving on your colony.

  • Choose from 18 commanders and 7 traits. Each combination changes how a run develops.

  • Research across 4 tracks and draft 14 technologies. Your toolkit changes from run to run.

  • Face 127 incidents and colony events, including 28 core incidents with choices that carry a cost.

  • Seasons, drift, and blights change the conditions on each map.

  • Festivals, artifacts, and the contribution shop provide upgrades between runs.

  • Spend stars on artifact rerolls, map reseeds, an extra modifier slot, and permanent commissary items.

  • Each map records its highest cleared difficulty. Commanders earn titles as you play them.

  • Earn 624 rewards: achievements, artifacts, boons, doctrines, regional feats, difficulty badges, mastery titles, and commissary items.

  • Today's Drop is a new date-seeded scenario every day, with your best attempts saved on record.

  • Seeded runs begin with a draft. Pick your modifiers and choose one artifact from your collection.

Play through 2 campaigns and 27 handcrafted story maps: the Foothold, from first landing to last stand, then the Carrion, a faction that lives off what it kills. Narration between missions.

Then replay 24 scenario biomes, every distinct layout from both campaigns, with seeded layouts, quests, 16 rolled map traits, and adjustable threat.

Scenario mode also includes 4 asymmetric factions that change the core loop, not just the numbers.

An interactive tutorial guides you through your first colony.

The in-game codex explains every system.

Choose a pace from relaxed to sandbox. Pace modes control how much the in-game clock pressures you, or remove it entirely. Pause whenever you want.

Choose from 4 difficulty levels. Cancel queued builds for a full refund, and undo with one click. Play with mouse and keyboard, gamepad, or touch. On-screen prompts follow your active input, and you can rebind the controls.

Runs take about 10 to 30 minutes and save automatically when you quit. The game works offline, so a laptop without a connection is enough. Demo saves carry into the full game.

Buy Xenobiome Command once. Every future update and DLC will be free.

Xenobiome Command is made by one person. If you send a bug report through the Options menu, it reaches me directly. I read them and fix what I can. The game will keep growing after launch, and you will not be charged for that work.
store_data.short_description: A colony survival strategy game on a fungal exoplanet, crossing colony sim, base building and territory control. Survey the fog, claim the ground under it, raise an outpost, and hold the line as the bloom and its ferals close in.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a peaceful journey through beautiful forest landscapes, where every successful card combination brings you closer to victory. Match cards in ascending or descending order, create long combos, overcome unique obstacles, and clear beautifully designed layouts.

Whether you enjoy classic solitaire or prefer larger, more challenging levels with unique gameplay mechanics, Weekend Solitaire 7: Grace in Motion offers hours of relaxing and engaging entertainment.

Game Features

  • Over 200 carefully handcrafted levels

  • Three game modes:

    • Classic Levels — traditional solitaire with no special mechanics.

    • Big Levels Relax — large layouts with an expanded deck for a calm and relaxing experience.

    • Big Levels Bonus — large layouts featuring boosters, power-ups, and additional challenges.

  • Easy to learn, rewarding to master.

  • Build long card streaks to earn bonuses.

  • Use Jokers and powerful boosters to overcome difficult situations.

  • Discover a variety of gameplay mechanics, including ropes, locks, ice, wooden boards, multi-hit cards, and many other obstacles.

  • Beautiful high-quality natural scenery.

  • Relaxing atmosphere with soothing music.

  • Achievements for true solitaire enthusiasts.

Each new level introduces fresh challenges while maintaining intuitive and enjoyable gameplay. Plan your moves carefully, create impressive card combinations, and clear every board.

Relax, enjoy breathtaking scenery, and rediscover the timeless fun of solitaire.

store_data.about_the_game:
DaiDee 大弟 is a single-player roguelike built on Hong Kong Big Two combo grammar. No opponents, no passing, no AI opponents. The puzzle is you versus your own hand and the round's score target.

How it plays

  • Each round you draw 16 cards, keep 13, and split them into legal Big Two combos: singles, pairs, triples, straights, flushes, full houses, bombs all within a strict play budget.

  • Play order matters. Climbing Ladders and seizing the table with bombs builds Flow, the multiplier on your score. Round score = Power × Flow, minus penalties for unplayed cards.

  • 2s are your finishers. Play a group of 2s right after another combo to Link (+Flow), or close the round on a 2 Finisher for a bonus and the 2♠, the single highest card in the deck, is always waiting for the right moment.

Progression and difficulty

  • Between rounds, spend money on Style cards that rewrite how your hand can be split: turn a triple plus a stray card into a Cracked Bomb, substitute a rank in a straight, or fold two pairs into one four-card play.

  • Bosses impose constraints, reversed ladders, a Tax Collector, a seat reserved for your highest card. Miss the target and the run ends.

Features

  • True Hong Kong Big Two grammar: straights, flushes, full houses, bombs, 2 Links, finishers

  • Runs built on partitioning and ordering, no opponents, no dead draws

  • Style cards across grammar, scoring, sequencing, economy, and manipulation

  • Escalating targets and boss constraints

store_data.about_the_game:
GameStation, Yii, Game Kid... and many more. Games from all your childhood consoles are here!

More than 4000 video game boxes have been thrown everywhere, and it's up to you to put them back where they belong. Pick up each game, find the right shelf, and turn this disaster of a store back into a gaming paradise.

TIDY UP THE STORE

The shelves are a mess and games are scattered all over the place!

Sort each game onto the correct shelf and watch the store slowly transform from a complete disaster into a perfectly organized game shop.

YOUR CHILDHOOD CLASSICS... SORT OF.

Remember those games you played growing up?

They're here! Well... sort of.

The store is packed with parodies of games you know and love. Can you figure out which classic each one is parodying?

UNLOCK NEW ABILITIES

Gain experience by correctly sorting games and unlock new abilities to help you clean up the store faster.

Move faster, find games more easily, and become the ultimate organizing machine!

Can you become the ultimate game store employee?

KEY FEATURES

· 4000+ game boxes to sort and organize.

· 300+ different parodies of games you know and love.

· Games from Pretendo Yii, GameStation, YBox 720 and many more consoles spanning the last 30 years.

· Cozy progression as you transform a complete mess into a perfectly organized retro game store.

· Skills to make you faster at organizing: movement speed, finding games and many more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Upgrade. Roll. Deploy.

Every enemy you kill fills your purse. When you've saved enough, hit Pick and Roll: choose one upgrade from a spread of towers, each with several talents competing for your coins. Then the pool appears — and the dice decide which tower actually joins your deck as a card. Every talent you buy stays on that tower, waiting for the roll that brings it to your hand.

Draw it, hold it, and drop it into any slot on the field when the moment is right.

Wave After Wave, Hundreds of Enemies

They come in a relentless tide — faster, tougher, and in greater numbers with every wave. Your slots are limited. Your placement matters. Hold the line.

Level Up Mid-Battle

Coins aren't the only thing the horde gives you. As you fight, you level up — and every level offers three perks to choose from. These aren't tied to any single tower: they're the broad upgrades that shape your entire defense, and the direction you commit to early decides what your build becomes by the final wave.

Strategy Under Pressure

Do you pour everything into one tower and pray the dice remember you, or spread your talents wide so any roll is a good roll? The choices are yours, and the waves don't wait.

Let the Dice Decide

No two attempts play out the same way. A single roll can hand you the carry you were praying for, or force you to improvise an entire defense out of whatever landed in your hand. Adapt, or watch the line break.

Levels That Push Back

Each level brings its own layout, its own enemies, and its own set of difficulties. Clear one and the next tier is waiting — same map, sharper teeth. What carried you through the easy run won't survive the top difficulty, so come back with a better plan.

Unique Builds, Every Time

Tower talents, perks, and dice rolls collide in ways you won't see coming. Combine towers, chain their effects, and discover synergies that turn a lucky roll into an unstoppable engine. The builds you stumble into are the ones you'll want to chase again.

Earn Points, Grow Stronger

Every difficulty you conquer rewards skill points. Spend them in the skill tree to boost your towers, sharpen your odds, and unlock new ways to build — then take that power back into the levels you couldn't beat before.

Features

  • Tower defense driven by talent upgrades and dice rolls

  • Card-based deployment — place your towers when and where you choose

  • Multiple talents per tower, with progress that never goes to waste

  • Level up mid-battle and choose from three perks each time

  • Hundreds of enemies across escalating waves

  • Handcrafted levels, each with multiple difficulty tiers

  • Skill points from every difficulty cleared

  • A skill tree that boosts your builds and opens new strategies

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE BALL, AN ENDLESS RUN AND A LONG ROAD TO THE TOP

Once, you were just an unknown footballer kicking a ball around the neighborhood. Now, an entire career lies ahead of you—filled with opponents to overcome, matches to win and leagues to conquer.

But playing good football will not be enough on these pitches.

You must run faster, shoot harder and become stronger than everyone standing in your way.

KICKSLAUGHT combines the relentless pace of football with action-packed gameplay and deep character progression. Turn the ball into your greatest weapon, break through the opposition, defeat the goalkeeper and carve your name into football history!

⚽ NEVER STOP RUNNING, NEVER WASTE A SHOT

Once the match begins, there is no turning back.

Race toward the goal while defenders do everything they can to stop you. Time your shots carefully, smash through the defensive line and create a path toward victory.

At the end of every match, a powerful goalkeeper stands between you and the next stage of your career. Defeat them to advance and continue your journey.

But remember: the higher you climb, the stronger your opponents become.

🏆 RISE FROM THE LOWEST LEAGUE TO THE CHAMPIONSHIP

Begin your career in the lowest divisions, where nobody knows your name.

Win matches, face increasingly dangerous opponents and climb through the leagues one step at a time. Every new division introduces tougher defenses, stronger goalkeepers and much greater challenges.

Reaching the top will not be easy.

But with enough preparation, determination and power, the entire football world will eventually learn your name.

📈 DEVELOP YOUR FOOTBALLER

Every match transforms you into a more experienced player.

Earn experience, level up, improve your attributes and create a playstyle that belongs to you. Run faster, unleash more powerful shots and become durable enough to survive the toughest matches.

Complete special milestones to unlock new abilities capable of changing the course of a game.

You may begin as an ordinary player, but by the end of your career, you can become the footballer every opponent fears.

🎒 COLLECT, UPGRADE AND EQUIP POWERFUL ITEMS

The equipment you discover after matches can completely change your career.

Find new items, upgrade the equipment you already own and create the perfect combination for your playstyle. Every item provides different advantages and helps you prepare for more demanding opponents.

Better equipment means a stronger footballer.

Never settle for what you already have. Continue improving your gear and enter every match as the most powerful version of yourself.

📱 KEEP YOUR ENTIRE CAREER IN YOUR POCKET

Your phone is not just for checking messages—it is also the center of your football career.

Review your career summary, follow the latest football discussions on social media and analyze your upcoming opponent before stepping onto the pitch.

Knowing who you are about to face can provide a valuable advantage.

Follow your matches, development and growing reputation directly from your phone.

🏘️ RETURN TO THE NEIGHBORHOOD AND PREPARE

Life does not stop between matches.

Return to your neighborhood and decide how to spend your time. Visit the arcade, complete training sessions to improve your footballer or head to the market to purchase temporary power-ups.

The decisions you make before a match can completely change its outcome.

Sometimes a little extra speed, a harder shot or the right temporary boost can make the difference between victory and defeat.

🔥 EVERY MATCH IS HARDER, EVERY VICTORY IS GREATER

There is no room to stand still in the world of KICKSLAUGHT.

As you reach higher leagues, defenders become more dangerous, the opposition grows stronger and goalkeepers develop new ways to stop you.

That is why you must continuously improve your attributes, abilities and equipment.

You will begin your career as an unknown footballer from the neighborhood.

How that career ends is entirely up to you.

Prepare the ball.

Start running.

Destroy everything standing between you and the championship!

store_data.about_the_game:
ROLL. MANIPULATE. REPEAT.

The dice are random. Your decisions don't have to be.

Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game about turning bad rolls into great ones. Roll a set of colorful dice, discover the patterns you've been dealt, then play your cards to manipulate the outcome and push your score past the target.

Build ridiculous combinations. Stack powerful effects. Take dangerous risks.

MAKE THE ROLL YOURS

Every roll is an opportunity.

Match dice by color to create valuable patterns—from simple pairs and trios to massive sets and rare multi-color combinations.

Your dice determine what you can score. Your cards determine what you can make them become.

PLAY YOUR CARDS

Your hand is full of ways to manipulate the odds.

  • Reroll dice

  • Change their colors

  • Copy dice

  • Add powerful modifiers

  • Destroy dice for an advantage

  • Manipulate cards and their effects

A weak roll isn't necessarily a bad roll, you might just need the right card.

WELCOME TO THE SOUTERRAIN

Hidden beneath an unassuming occult shop is a gambling room where the stakes are higher than money.

Here, fate is something you can bargain with.

The tables are old. The cards are strange. The house has rules. Break them.

FEATURES

  • Dice-based roguelike gameplay — Every roll creates a new puzzle to solve.

  • Pattern-based scoring — Build combinations from differently colored dice.

  • Powerful cards — Manipulate dice, modifiers, cards, and the rules of the game.

  • Reactive effects — Cards can trigger from rolls, rerolls, draws, discards, scoring, destruction, and more.

  • High-risk, high-reward builds — Powerful passive effects can completely change your strategy.

  • Endless experimentation — Discover strange interactions and combinations across runs.

store_data.about_the_game:
CM27 is a deep single-player cricket management simulation from Shushi Studios. Create your manager, take over a domestic club or international side, and live the full cricket calendar — from tough domestic campaigns to the biggest ICC stages.

YOUR CAREER. YOUR CALLS.

Every decision shapes the path ahead. Set your XI, shape tactics, manage contracts and development, and push the calendar day by day. Win enough and the world opens up. Slip too far and the board starts asking hard questions.

FEATURES

• Full cricket management career

Create your manager, sign a contract, and run a multi-season save with objectives, inbox pressure, job moves, and a lasting trophy history.

• Domestic and international cricket

Lead a club through the season or take charge of a national side. Navigate bilateral tours, format rankings, and major ICC events including World Cups and championship pathways.

• Test, ODI, and T20

Plan for first-class grind, one-day tempo, and T20 chaos — each with its own preparation, selection, and matchday feel.

• Interactive matchdays

Step into matchday for the toss and live sessions. Follow limited-overs cricket ball by ball, or take first-class contests day by day. Adjust temperament, bowling plans, and field as the game shifts.

• Squad, academy, and transfer market

Build a senior core, develop youth, send scouts into the market, and balance budget with board expectations.

• Board confidence that matters

Quarterly reviews, confidence zones, and managerial pressure keep every season honest. Keep the board onside — or start packing.

• Built for keyboard and controller

A polished 2D career interface with atmospheric presentation and full gamepad support for long sessions on the couch or at the desk.

THE SEASON NEVER STOPS

Between fixtures you live in the hub: squad, transfers, academy, office, calendar, standings, and player chat. Sim forward when you want pace. Slow down when a final, a crisis, or a career-defining offer arrives.

This is cricket management with teeth — long careers, real pressure, and the chase for silverware.

CM27. Take the job. Shape the side. Write your legacy.

Shushi Studios

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re cut off from civilization, deep in the endless northern wilderness. Home was only a few hours away. Not anymore. Now there’s nothing but endless forests, bitter cold, and something moving in the bushes.

Whether alone or with friends, you’ll have to find your way home – preferably without losing anyone along the way.

Forget the GPS

Read your map, use your compass, navigate by natural landmarks, and carve your own path through dense forests, swamps, rivers, and mountain passes.

Live off the land

Hunt, fish, forage, cook over an open fire, and craft the tools required to survive. Nature provides everything you need – if you know where to look.

Build and upgrade your camp

When the cold sets in, your camp becomes more than just a place to sleep. Build and improve your shelter, warm up by the fire, prepare for the journey ahead, and decide who gets stuck sleeping at everyone else’s feet.

You're in their territory

The North belongs to its wildlife. Bears, wolves, and other animals defend their territory, react to your presence, and can even hear you through proximity voice chat.

Sometimes the smartest choice isn’t to fight – it’s to keep quiet and stay out of their way.

Everything's easier together… or is it?

Play solo or with up to 4 players. Work together, share supplies, and watch each other’s backs… or hope the bear catches someone else first.

Remember: the only thing more dangerous than the wilderness is your friend.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Oh Shoot!”

A phrase so simple, yet complexity underlies its initially silly premise. And with the ever-branching network of timelines, some, in a twisted string of fate, cannot help but find themselves entangled within its convoluted webs.

Oh Shoot! delivers an action-packed first-person shooter featuring a chapter-based campaign. With its compelling, varying storylines, breakneck combat and platformer gameplay, and reality-warping mechanics, travel through different eras and dimensions in order to disrupt the heart of the supernatural events tearing apart every timeline, one by one.

In the prologue, you are Sean O’ Sullivan, an officer part of a task force to save the mayor of Manchester, who has been captured by the feared gang, El Chippy Chip, terrorizing the streets. However, as you progress through your mission, you begin to find multiple bizarre crystalline anomalies that have been inflicted upon your planet. They quickly seep into your world’s roots and infect everything around it, eventually including you. Imbued with this supernatural energy, you still seek to accomplish your mission against the opposition. But your enemies are not just those directly ahead of you, but also a looming extraterrestrial horror that has the power to obliterate you and everything you’ve ever known.

Key Features:

  • Story-Driven Campaign and Cinematics: Live the first chapter through the eyes of Sean O’ Sullivan, and complete his mission as his orders and fate will dictate

  • Action-Packed First-Person Shooter Experience: Help save the innocent people around you and fight through gang members in order to topple their obsessed kingpin

  • Time-Bending Abilities and Dimensional Platforming: Use your new abilities to great heights, and, through the eyes of your newfound powers, traverse not only your world, but also realities time had long forgotten

  • An Original Soundtrack: Experience the original soundtrack as it evolves through each imperative stage of your mission

store_data.about_the_game:
Story: Reality vs. Dream

You wake up in your beautiful cabin in the woods to begin an ordinary day. But when an unexpected event turns your rest into a nightmare, the line between reality and dream shatters, and every detail of your day haunts the dream that follows.

World: Cabin of Secrets

Don't be fooled by the cozy initial setting. What starts as a small cabin expands into a multi-layered world that peels back like an onion, constantly changing its geometry and hiding surprises for those who look closely. As you wander around, the world quietly shrinks towards the cabin.

Gameplay: Follow the Words

  • Surreal Exploration & Light Platforming: Walk through carefully designed levels, featuring atmospheric traversal and light platforming elements.

  • 3 Quest Log Styles: Tailor your objective tracking to your playstyle. Choose between Cryptic Riddles, Standard Directives, or Sequential Steps style.

  • Interactive Hidden Objects & NPCs: Inspect your surroundings to discover hidden key items and NPCs.

  • Optional Visual Guidance: If you're struggling to find the next interactable object, toggle the visual guidance system to pinpoint targets with lightning strikes.

  • Chapter Select Freedom: Jump to any chapter at any time, but completing your first playthrough in order is recommended to avoid spoilers.

Chapters: Deeper and Darker

Throughout the game you will go through 7 chapters, each with distinct atmospheric environments to see, levels to explore, and secrets to uncover. The further you progress, the deeper and darker you venture into the unknown.

  • Chapter 1 - Brand New Day

  • Chapter 2 - Tree House Climb

  • Chapter 3 - Floating Catwalk Stride

  • Chapter 4 - Sweet Mountain Maze

  • Chapter 5 - Road to Hell

  • Chapter 6 - Bloody Family Reunion

  • Chapter 7 - Shadow of the Cave

Playtime: First Playthrough

approximately 3 hours, can be finished in one sitting.

About the Dev

This game was developed independently by a solo developer - LeonGrayJ

"A game without players has no meaning. Have a fantastic time playing, and thank you for the support!"

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Day: What Remains is a short, emotional point-and-click narrative about memory, regret, and the weight of one final choice. Explore a hand-drawn room, uncover the stories held by everyday objects, and decide how to spend the time you have left.

Today is the last day.

Nothing looks different. Your coffee is still warm, your cats are waiting, and the room is filled with everything you kept meaning to return to.

Every object offers a possibility. Call someone you miss. Play with your cats. Pick up an abandoned hobby. Go to work. Step outside. Each interaction reveals another part of the life you are leaving behind.

You can examine every possibility and postpone any decision. There is no countdown forcing your hand. But once you commit to an activity, the day ends.

What will matter when there is no tomorrow?

KEY FEATURES

  • Explore a detailed, hand-drawn 2D room through simple point-and-click interactions.

  • Uncover a dialogue-driven story through memories attached to ordinary possessions.

  • Reflect on relationships, responsibilities, unfinished passions, and quiet comforts.

  • Consider every possibility without a time limit before making one irreversible choice.

  • Replay the final day to experience every possible outcome and unlock achievements.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are Green. They are Tan.

Green vs Tan is tower defense fought with the plastic army men that used to live under the couch. A hundred to a bag. Stiff little soldiers on molded bases. You drag your troops onto the carpet, hold the line, and keep them off your toy box.


Every Toy Is a Unit You Place

Ten kinds of soldiers wait in the bin. The rifleman is your guy: he shoots his rifle and gets the job done. The machine gunner lays down heavy fire but moves like a slug. The minesweeper plants firecracker mines and defuses the enemy's. The bazooka blows up groups of soldiers, boulders, and occasionally himself. Why not? That's just how it is. The mortar sits far back and drops shells that land exactly where you need them, or nowhere close. The flamethrower gets in there and torches everything. The radio man calls in a paratrooper and boosts the troops around him. Discover more kinds of soldiers as you play.



The Carpet Fights Back

Every room is a level and every toy is a hazard. Wrecking balls roll through the alphabet blocks. The train thunders across Western Land without stopping for anyone. A soccer ball bowls through the backyard brawl. Boulders, mines, and the rooftop void all take men off the board, yours and theirs.



Someone Bigger Is Waiting at the Top

King Yeti and his snow army. King Rex and the stegos. The Nemesis and his paratroopers. The redcoats marching in formation. Mom's slippers. Over 100 levels of yetis to fight, dinosaurs to rule, secrets to uncover, and bosses who do not care that you are made of plastic.



Bring Your Buddies

Start a squad. Play real people in Battlefield mode from 1v1 to 10v10, open a private room and pass the invite code around the house, or jump into a co-op campaign and fight the bosses as a team. Beat a level and everyone's campaign moves forward. Prefer to play alone? Play against the CPU, no pressure. Bring the whole friend group, the whole family, or your local army commanders.




  • Ten soldier types to place, plus more to discover
  • 100+ levels across bedrooms, backyards, Western Land, the winter rug, and the rooftop
  • Bosses, secrets, and the Nightly Invasion
  • Solo, co-op campaign, or 1v1 to 10v10 Battlefield with cross-platform play
  • Seven languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, German, Russian, and Spanish

Before You Buy

An internet connection is required at all times. This is a live game loaded from our servers; there is no offline mode. No ads in the Steam version of Green vs Tan, ever. Mouse and keyboard only for now; there is no controller support.


We hope you enjoy Green vs Tan as much as we have.

Ten kinds of soldiers wait in the bin. The rifleman is your guy: he shoots his rifle and gets the job done. The machine gunner lays down heavy fire but moves like a slug. The minesweeper plants firecracker mines and defuses the enemy's. The bazooka blows up groups of soldiers, boulders, and occasionally himself. Why not? That's just how it is. The mortar sits far back and drops shells that land exactly where you need them, or nowhere close. The flamethrower gets in there and torches everything. The radio man calls in a paratrooper and boosts the troops around him. Discover more kinds of soldiers as you play.



The Carpet Fights Back

Every room is a level and every toy is a hazard. Wrecking balls roll through the alphabet blocks. The train thunders across Western Land without stopping for anyone. A soccer ball bowls through the backyard brawl. Boulders, mines, and the rooftop void all take men off the board, yours and theirs.



Someone Bigger Is Waiting at the Top

King Yeti and his snow army. King Rex and the stegos. The Nemesis and his paratroopers. The redcoats marching in formation. Mom's slippers. Over 100 levels of yetis to fight, dinosaurs to rule, secrets to uncover, and bosses who do not care that you are made of plastic.



Bring Your Buddies

Start a squad. Play real people in Battlefield mode from 1v1 to 10v10, open a private room and pass the invite code around the house, or jump into a co-op campaign and fight the bosses as a team. Beat a level and everyone's campaign moves forward. Prefer to play alone? Play against the CPU, no pressure. Bring the whole friend group, the whole family, or your local army commanders.




  • Ten soldier types to place, plus more to discover
  • 100+ levels across bedrooms, backyards, Western Land, the winter rug, and the rooftop
  • Bosses, secrets, and the Nightly Invasion
  • Solo, co-op campaign, or 1v1 to 10v10 Battlefield with cross-platform play
  • Seven languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, German, Russian, and Spanish

Before You Buy

An internet connection is required at all times. This is a live game loaded from our servers; there is no offline mode. No ads in the Steam version of Green vs Tan, ever. Mouse and keyboard only for now; there is no controller support.


We hope you enjoy Green vs Tan as much as we have.

A GPU-ACCELERATED PARTICLE SANDBOX

Experiment with a deeply interactive world of powders, liquids, gases, heat, pressure, combustion, and destruction. Simulate up to 1 MILLION PARTICLES (performance dependent on varying computer hardware)

SIMULATE DYNAMIC FLUIDS

Flood the world with water, oil, acid, nitro, molten materials, and more.

BUILD WORLDS ONE PARTICLE AT A TIME

Pour shifting landscapes of sand, soil, stone, snow, and other granular materials.

CREATE DYNAMIC LIFE

Grow forests from individual seeds and populate your world with autonomous stickmen. They explore the environment, react to danger, gather resources, and work together to construct procedural buildings and settlements.

BUILD, BURN, AND DESTROY

Test the limits with fire, volatile materials, and environmental forces.

UNLEASH TOTAL DESTRUCTION

Launch explosive and kinetic missiles, call down orbital beams, detonate nuclear weapons, or create a growing black hole that tears the surrounding world apart.

  • More than 40 powders, liquids, gases, solids, molten materials, plasma, fire, and more

  • Autonomous stickmen with exploration and construction behavior

  • Procedurally generated houses, towers, wells, bridges, windmills, and other structures

  • Destructive weapons including missiles, nuclear strikes, orbital beams, and black holes

  • Growing vegetation and reactive environments

  • Day-and-night cycle

  • Scene saving and loading

  • Multiple simulation and performance settings

Dive straight into incoming enemy groups and never stop moving. Dodge attacks with quick moves and clear the area. As each wave gets tougher, use the map to your advantage and stay alive!

Use points earned between rounds to shape your character to your playstyle. Max out your health to become a tank, or boost your damage to wipe out enemies in seconds. Every stat you pick defines your fate in the next wave.

Grab the best cards presented at the end of each wave. Some cards give huge power boosts while taking away armor or speed; balance the risk carefully. Combine the right cards to create an unstoppable build!

You don't have to rely only on your weapons. Turn the battlefield into total chaos with extra skills. Deploy orbiting fireballs, auto-targeting drones, or shockwaves that push enemies back to clear the screen with ease!

store_data.about_the_game:
A growing collection of cards, tactics, puzzles, arcade runs and competitive duels — one clean cyber launcher.

One hub. One visual language.

Every game opens from the same deck and plays by the same rules of respect: a fast, readable table, no ads, no timers, no coin shop — just the classic, done properly. Pick a tile, play a hand, come back tomorrow: your stats, best times and win streaks are always waiting.

♠ Card protocol

Texas Hold'em · Draw Poker · Blackjack · Klondike · Spider · FreeCell · Pyramid · Hearts · War · Durak
Card tables dealt from one shared neon deck — from a quiet solitaire run to a full poker table with side pots.

♞ Board protocol

Chess · Checkers · Reversi · Gomoku · Backgammon · Dominoes · Battleship · Four in a Row · Dice Poker · Tic-tac-toe
Classic tactics with bots that put up a real fight — four difficulty levels where it matters, rule variants where they belong.

◈ Puzzle protocol

Minesweeper · Sudoku · 2048 · 15 Puzzle · Nonogram · Circuit · Cargo · Blackout · Prism · Pairs
Short, sharp thinking breaks — every board generated solvable, every best time on record.

▶ Arcade protocol

Snake · Blockfall · Runner · Wings · Breakout · Pong · Debris · Echo · Ascent · Chroma · Bulwark
Instant restarts, rising speed curves, high scores. One more run.

⚔ Versus protocol

GRID · BLAST · ARMOR · CURVE · ARTILLERY · ORBIT · PUCK · VOLLEY · SUMO · RALLY
Duels built for two people at one keyboard — or two gamepads. Every one of them also has a bot to practise against, so nothing sits idle when you are alone.

Play it your way

Play solo against built-in opponents, hand the keyboard to a friend for a hotseat duel, hold the line together in Bulwark co-op, or take Durak, Poker, Chess, GRID, BLAST and ARTILLERY online through Steam lobbies or LAN. A dropped player is instantly covered by a bot, so the match never dies. The interface speaks English, Ukrainian, German, Spanish, French, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.

Something to come back to

  • Daily ops — three fresh challenges every day, the same three for everyone, with a month streak to keep alive.
  • Ranks and mastery — every match pays XP toward an operator rank, and every game keeps its own mastery stars.
  • 94 achievements — from a first clean sweep to the ones only a specialist will ever see.
  • Unlockable style — earn deck backs and hub themes by playing. Nothing is for sale, nothing is random.
  • Cloud saves — progress follows your account to the next machine.

Pick a protocol. Make it yours.
