store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR BADGE WORKS. THAT'S THE GOOD NEWS.

Corporate Slave is a satirical single-player RPG about surviving a modern tech job. You walk a

side-scrolling open floor plan in real time, from 9:00 to 18:00, and every hour is a decision: ship the

ticket, dodge the meeting, refill the coffee, or use the company laptop to apply for a different life.

Then you go home, spend your handful of evening hours, and do it again tomorrow.

There is a win condition. It is money. It is a long way away.

THE OFFICE DAY

Nine hours, one floor, a clock that does not care about your plans.

  • Actual work — feature tickets play out as SHIP IT, a coding QTE against the build timer, 

    or BUG HUNT, where you swat bugs before they escape into PROD. Escapees become "known issues".

Known issues are immortal.

  • Meetings — standups, syncs, and the ones that appear mid-sentence. Stay awake, answer with the

correct buzzword, and decide every time whether joining is worth the hour. Leaving early is noted.

Everything is noted.

  • The floor — printer duels (PC LOAD LETTER), coffee timing, water-cooler gossip that leaks real

intel, and a window you can stare out of. Staring helps.

  • Micro-events — SEV-2 incidents, fire drills, cake for a stranger named Craig, mandatory IT

restarts at 1:47 PM, and the VP walkthrough: a 2.6-second ALT-TAB reflex test.

  • Job-hunting on the clock — check mail or Easy-Apply at your desk and roll the dice on someone

seeing your screen.

THE EVENINGS ARE YOURS (ALL THREE HOURS OF THEM)

Rest, side hustle, BeetCode prep, doomscroll — you get a few slots and never enough. Take a therapy

session on the commute. Get shaken down by a dentist. Pay $10 a week for an app you don't remember

subscribing to. And run the job hunt properly: a fake email client where recruiter invites, offers and

rejections land overnight between the spam, and a satirical professional network where applications

percolate for days before fate arrives by mail.

Interviews are full multi-round gauntlets. Skill rounds, a rapid-fire question stage that escalates

from normal to unhinged, and a culture-fit finale — taken over video from your couch if you're still

employed, or in person inside the target company's own rendered interview room, under their values poster.

Offers expire in four days, because urgency is a core value. You can negotiate. They might rescind.

THE AI AGENT

Your new colleague was plugged in overnight. They roam the floors of different companies and absorbs your tasks, and the tasks count for them now. A five-act story runs the length of your career and it goes somewhere specific —

and when you finally learn what those agents actually are, you get to decide what to do about it. There is a seat

being offered. There is also a door.

CLIMB, TRANSFER, OR RUN

Perform well enough and the ladder forks: +15% pay and your IDE license revoked within the hour. As a

manager you hire your own team through a proper hiring minigame, run 1:1s for your reports, keep morale

above the resignation line, and watch your performance become a function of someone else's output.

Congratulations. You are the calendar now.

Or take an internal transfer. Or hand in your notice, serve the week, and sit through the exit interview.

THE MACHINERY

  • Six parody employers, each with its own office, CEO caricature, salary bands, stability and

mission statement — and their own all-hands announcements about the betaverse, the AGI timeline, or the

Year of Efficiency (#4).

  • Probation, performance reviews, PIPs, reorgs and layoffs — rumored at the water cooler, delivered

as a calendar invite titled "Quick Sync". Survive on performance and visibility, or take the box and do the

walk of shame.

  • RSUs that vest just slowly enough to keep you here. Rent, bills, salary, and a rival whose career

advances whether you log in or not.

  • Hackathons, mandatory HR seminars, employee surveys, remote all-hands, CEO floor visits, overtime

— and a side hustle you can run at your desk, at escalating risk of being caught.

  • Stats with teeth — energy, stress, performance, visibility and money all push back. Max out stress

and you break down. Do it three times and the run is over.

It's just a job. You can leave any time. Prove it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Koharu is a girl with no power to fight. In pursuit of her father's shadow, she borrows the strength of monsters and sets out for the summit of a colossal tower.

Memento Resonance is a monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game centered on forging Resonance with monsters, customizing skills with relics, responding to telegraphed enemy actions, and following the trail of lost memories.

Welcome Enemies as Allies Through Resonance


The monsters that inhabit the tower are more than foes to defeat.

Offer them food in battle to lower their guard, and if Resonance succeeds, they can join you as new allies.

At the end of each adventure, choose one of the monsters that joined you through Resonance to bring back to your base and take with you on your next journey. Each monster has a signature skill unique to its species, as well as passive skills that vary from one individual to another.

Even monsters of the same species have their own quirks. Find a favorite and climb toward the summit together.

Customize Skills with Relics


Relics found in the tower can be socketed into your monsters' skills.

Boost their power, add Shield, or combine status effects with special conditions—the same skill can play a different role depending on the relics equipped. Experiment with monsters and relics to create a battle style of your own.

2v2 Turn-Based Battles Built Around Telegraphed Actions


Enemy actions—such as attacking, defending, or inflicting debuffs—are telegraphed before they happen.

Each skill grows more expensive the more you use it, while holding it back lowers its cost. With limited Mana, decide which skills to use against the telegraphed action and which to save for the next turn.

Climb Again and Follow the Trail of Lost Memories


The tower's routes and the events along them change with every adventure. Overcome battles, events, camps, and encounters with powerful foes as you climb to ever higher floors.

By restoring Memory Logs over the course of your adventures, you will gradually uncover Koharu's past and the truth hidden within the tower.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fall for him. Doubt everything.


A tender day begins beside your childhood friend, Zuoluo.

An amusement park, cake, blue roses, and fireworks—the reunion feels almost too perfect. Yet among those familiar and tender moments, small inconsistencies begin to surface.

The closer you get to him, the harder those contradictions become to ignore. Zuoluo remains as gentle as ever, but he seems to be hiding something—and the seemingly ordinary world around you is beginning to crack.

What is real? What is a lie? Most importantly—who will you trust?

Your choices shape the story


Your decisions change relationships and lead the story down different paths. Trust, doubt, confront, or escape. Every choice may bring you closer to the truth—or take it away forever.

Features


  • A romantic science-fiction mystery visual novel
  • A complete story told across 24 chapters
  • Story-changing choices and an affection system
  • 13 endings, including bad, normal, and true endings
  • A story tree for revisiting unlocked chapters and endings
  • Text support for Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese

Fall for him. Doubt everything. Choose your ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trade, fight, and sail beyond the chart

Windward Isles is a sun-drenched age-of-sail sandbox. Take the wheel of your own ship, run cargo between ten living harbours, fight off corsairs with thundering broadsides, and climb from a lowly deckhand to the sea's highest honour — the Windward Sovereign.

No timers, no fail states rushing you along. Chart your own course across a crystal-clear ocean and make your fortune however you please.

A living sea to trade

  • Eighteen goods across ten harbours — buy low where they're made, sell dear where they're craved. Prices drift day to day, shortages spike, festivals lift a whole port.
  • The market lives and breathes — no harbour deals in everything, and as the isles prosper the docks carry ever more variety. Rare luxuries like amber, ivory and ambergris only surface as your voyage matures.
  • Read the trade winds — hover any good for a trade card telling you where it sells highest and what the run is worth. Warehouses, harbour investments, moneylenders and insurance all deepen the game.

Eight ships, thundering broadsides

  • Sail your way up the fleet — from a nimble Cutter to a mighty Man-o'-War. Every hull on the market is a little different; the grandest ships-of-the-line are laid down only at the great fortress capitals.
  • Broadside combat — fire port and starboard, cycle round, chain and grape shot, and unleash combat skills: a bursting mortar, a double broadside, a rigging-shredding chain volley, or brace and mend.
  • Board and plunder — batter a raider below a third of her hull, then board her for cargo and gold — or send her off to sail in your own prize fleet for daily dividends.

A world with a memory

  • The Royal Navy and the Brotherhood both keep score of your deeds — smuggling contraband pleases one and angers the other.
  • Story contracts, bounties, treasure maps and escort runs — and named corsair captains who come hunting as your fortune grows.
  • Play it your way — Relaxed, Standard or Cutthroat, plus a Peaceful mode with no enemies at all for pure, calm trade-sailing.

Set your own horizon

A full career runs a dozen hours or more, with new harbours charting themselves as the days pass. Rise through the ranks, deck out a flagship, and become a legend of the Windward Isles.

store_data.about_the_game:
● A Future on the Verge of Collapse

In 2179 AD, deep within the Earth, a metal capable of recreating life forms—Life Gold—was discovered.

With the development of the Life Gold biotechnology system, the massive vertical city—New Babel—was built.

Humanity entered an eternal era of immortality and perpetual rest...

Now, in the new era of 712, this city, once a milestone in human life technology, is decaying amidst bloodshed and madness.

You awaken in an age of despair to witness the decline of this great vertical city and make your own choices in this complex world.

● Hardcore Turn-Based Combat

In complex and demanding turn-based combat, carefully choose your tactics and strategies against enemies with unique characteristics. Strike different parts of your enemies, exploit weaknesses for a decisive victory, or overwhelm them with sheer power and numerical superiority. Experiment with unique personal combat styles and find ways to defeat powerful foes.

● Free Equipment Customization System

The game revolves around a "Face - Heart Machine - Tools" system, allowing for countless combinations to create your own unique gameplay experience. With a dazzling array of attributes, traits, and equipment options, you can freely shape the game style you desire.

● Intricate Dungeon Exploration

Freely explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," discovering various items, secret storylines, unique enemies, special events, and interesting NPC characters. Experience multiple distinct regional factions—the chivalrous "Bone Hall," the solemn and magnificent "White Floor Food Company," the orderly and austere "Century Heavy Industry," the solitary "Doghouse," and the "World Workers' Union," buried in history.

● Chaotic Branching Choices in the Plot

In "New Babel," the characters each have their own agendas. You can choose to side with a character or faction, or go your own way and form your own faction—your choices won't have a direct impact, but the world will develop in unpredictable directions. Each character has their own actions and paths; words may be lies, and information may be fabricated. You need to make your own judgments.

● Unique and Independent Art Style

All game art assets were drawn by the author himself—from the game UI to character illustrations, combining the characteristics of living things and metal to construct a bizarre bio-technological world.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fighter has two bars, and they work differently. Health simply runs out. Damage piles up and decides how far the next hit sends you. There are two ways to kill — finish them off, or throw them off the edge — and late in a round the second one is usually faster.

The fighting

Attack, heavy attack on hold, grab and throw, shield, roll. Shield at the last moment to parry. In the air: double jump, dash on a double tap of a direction, push off a wall. Miss the ledge and you can hang on and climb back — but while you hang, everyone can see you.

The arena gets in everyone's way equally

Low gravity, meteor shower, earthquake, item rain. Every event is announced by a banner a few seconds ahead: enough time to run, not enough to finish someone off.

Item crates drop on their own. Inside there might be a medkit or a speed boost — or a shotgun, bazooka, laser, mine, knife, boomerang, grenade launcher, anvil or black hole.

Nine modes

  • Deathmatch — lives and rounds. Run out of lives and you are out.
  • Siege — two towers. While your tower stands, your team respawns. When it falls, that's it.
  • King of the Hill — hold the zone alone. With two inside, nobody scores.
  • Football — score the most in three minutes. A knockout does not remove you, so beating each other up still pays off.
  • Basketball — the ball has to drop through the hoop from above. Two points a basket.
  • Rugby — the ball is carried in your hands, and hits knock it loose.
  • Capture the Flag — bring the enemy flag back to your base. A dropped flag returns on its own.
  • Hot Potato — the bomb goes from hand to hand, passed by touch and by hit. If the fuse burns out in your hands, they score.
  • Waves — everyone against the bots. The only mode that needs no live opponent.

Eight arenas

The Square, The Well, the fortress of The Siege, The Canyon with a chasm across the middle, The Skyway — a fight above the void, The Foundry where every platform under your feet is on the move. Plus The Pitch and The Court for the ball modes. Every mode has its own map pool: where you have to run the length of the field, cramped arenas never come up.

Two at one computer

Two players share one keyboard, or pick up gamepads.

Online for up to six: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3. The host picks the mode and the map, bots fill the empty seats — the match starts even if your friend is running late.

store_data.about_the_game:
Forty-eight hours until the floodgates open.

In Mother;Above, a short (~30 minute) psychological horror visual novel, you follow Vik, a teenage laborer in a basin town built beneath the floodwall that protects the City Above.

Vik maintains pumps, repairs drain lines… paints evacuation routes… and packs the emergency kits that keep the city dry.

Then the Flood Authority announces a controlled discharge. 

Vik's mother disappeared through the wall years earlier. Her civic file does not list her as dead or missing. It says only: MOTHER; ABOVE.

With Sava, Corn, Braska, and an older runaway named Meytan, Vik plans to steal the Highline, a maintenance tram that can carry them through the floodwall before the gates open.

Key Features:

  • Short but impactful psychological horror visual novel, with each playthrough lasting around 30 minutes.

  • A forty-eight hour countdown to a flood.

  • Three distinct endings.

  • A rain-soaked industrial basin, a floodwall visible from every street, and an upper city made horrifying by how ordinary it looks.

  • Ambient soundscape built around heavy rain, pump machinery, warning sirens, tram tunnels, and calm emergency broadcasts telling residents to remain where they are.

store_data.about_the_game:
Transform a rundown tavern into a veritable underground city for thieves, bandits, assassins, cultists, smugglers, pirates, mercenaries, and other riffraff from across the kingdom. Give every outcast a roof over their head and a job for their skillset.

BUILD AN UNDERGROUND EMPIRE

Start with a small tavern as a front for your shady business, and expand the den floor by floor. Build barracks, brothels, gambling parlors, lockpick workshops, labs, and dozens of other rooms, each opening up new opportunities for your organization.

GATHER THE SCUM

Every vagabond or escaped convict who knocks on the tavern's door can become a client, a regular, or a valuable employee. There is room for some in the barracks, where they can live, rest, and enjoy the den's amenities; others can be recruited into the gang and assigned suitable work. The O.U.T.L.A.W.S. stat system will help determine which criminal trade they will excel at.

SEND PEOPLE OUT ON MISSIONS

While some maintain the den, others gather information and carry out missions outside its confines. Set up a Rumor Room and a Planning Room, dispatch informants, and send out your best daredevils to carry out heists and assassinations and to scour ancient ruins for gold and rare loot.

DEFEND THE DEN

Your lodgers aren't always willing to share a roof peacefully. Assign the toughest of them as bouncers to stop fights and maintain order. Increase security to fend off raids by the city guards and the evil spirits swarming from the ancient dungeons.

DIG DEEPER

Expand your den with caution: every level may reveal secret waterways, cursed treasuries, catacombs full of the undead, and shrines to forgotten gods. However, these discoveries offer more than just threats—they can also serve as foundations for some exclusive buildings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of mystery writer Laura Bailey in a narrative-driven murder mystery adventure inspired by classic detective fiction.

Laura Bailey Mysteries features two complete murder cases, each with its own setting, cast of suspects, motives, clues and solution. Follow the story as Laura becomes caught up in a murder, then conduct your own investigation to uncover the truth.

Each mystery follows a classic investigation structure. Search detailed crime scenes for evidence, examine suspicious objects and uncover clues that may reveal what really happened. Solve interactive clue puzzles, including reconstructing torn documents and piecing together evidence to reveal new information about the suspects.

Once you've gathered your initial evidence, interview the suspects and hear their version of events. Everyone has something to hide, and their statements may reveal motives, contradictions and new leads for your investigation.

As the case develops, you'll visit additional scenes, discover further evidence and solve more clue-based puzzles before making your final deductions.

At the end of each mystery, review the evidence and decide who you believe committed the murder. Choose carefully — the game will allow you to accuse the wrong person, leading to a different outcome for the case.

Features

* Two complete narrative murder mysteries

* Crime scenes to search for clues and evidence

* Suspect interviews and interrogations

* Interactive clue and document puzzles

* Multiple investigation locations

* Final deduction and accusation sequences

* Different endings depending on whether you identify the killer

* A murder mystery-themed card mini-game

Follow the evidence, question everyone and decide who is telling the truth. Only one suspect is guilty — but it's up to you to prove it.

这是一款名将少年时、放置策略卡牌手游。男主穿越回到三国乱世，以收集《三国志》残页为主线，特色养成、自由搭配，打造独特超强军团，征战热血乱世；新增爬塔小游戏玩法，助力快乐统一天下！

【特色一】跨服争霸，谁能成就王者？

达到一定等级的玩家，可参与跨服竞技PK，成就全服霸主之比特。王者争霸的流程为：报名—海选—32强—16强—8强—4强—半决赛—决赛。所有玩家膜拜冠军，可获得丰厚奖励。

【特色二】超级福利，领到手软

七日狂欢、关公赐福、等级礼包、成长之路……多种活动爽爆体验，福利满满，海量资源轻松拿。不充钱也能战力飙升，超级良心手游！

【特色三】名将招募，尽在囊中

偶像歌手——貂蝉，炒股达人——曹操，加特林机枪手——关羽，横空降世。丰富、趣味的卡牌人物，古代元素与现代武器的碰撞，开启爆笑三国之旅。

【特色四】挂机升级，轻松放置

招神将、夺城池，三国荣耀升官职。演武楼、战魂阁、董卓来了，各种.三国挂机.玩法，永远玩不腻。

《挂机吧三国》——极致放置×策略养成！24小时离线.挂机三国.，打造你的最强三国军团！

【游戏核心特色】——解放双手，轻松称霸三国！

【极致离线挂机，收益不间断】

(1) 全自动战斗系统：武将自动释放技能、自动升级、自动收集资源，24小时离线也能累积经验、铜钱、装备！

(2) 智能收益加成：根据.风起三国.离线时长动态调整收益，离线8小时可领取双倍资源，上班族、学生党轻松成长！

(3) 一键扫荡副本：通关后直接跳过重复战斗，瞬间完成日常任务，告别枯燥刷图！

(1) 百位经典武将：关羽、张飞、赵云、吕布、诸葛亮等超萌化造型，.afk.技能特效华丽，羁绊组合策略无限！

(2) 神兵锻造：青龙偃月刀、方天画戟自由强化，附加暴击、吸血稀有属性！

(3) 坐骑系统：赤兔马、的卢马提升移速与生存能力！

【跨服国战，万人同屏激斗】

(2) 联盟协作攻城：联合全服玩家制定战术（夜袭、围城、断粮），击溃敌军防线！

《挂机吧三国》开发者的话：愿每一位主公，都能写下自己的三国传奇

亲爱的主公们：

大家好，我们是《挂机吧三国》开发团队。

当大家看到这封信时，我们共同打造的三国世界已经正式向各位主公敞开大门。首先，衷心感谢每一位关注、预约、下载和体验《挂机吧三国》的玩家。对开发团队而言，这不仅是一款游戏的上线，更像是一次持续了很久的远征终于抵达了新的起点。

在最初讨论产品方向时，我们曾围绕.SLG.、.卡牌.、.cod.、.mhw.、.anno.、.rim.和.rimworld.等不同游戏体验展开过许多思考。从.明末.的时代氛围，到.丝之歌.的探索期待，再到.牧场物语.式的长期陪伴，我们想要寻找的始终是一种属于《挂机吧三国》的.灵魂与追求.。最终，我们选择以.卡牌.养成为基础、以.SLG.策略为骨架，在.apex.般紧张的竞争与.far.式广阔征途中，构建一个兼具.双影.变化、.split.选择和.使命召唤.式战场使命感的三国世界。即使玩家熟悉.diablo.式成长循环，也能在这里获得不一样的体验。

为什么说上线只是新的起点？因为我们始终认为，一款长期运营的游戏不应该在上线的那一刻宣告“完成”。真正决定它能走多远的，是玩家进入游戏之后的每一次选择、每一场战斗、每一条意见，以及开发团队能否认真聆听并持续改进。三国的故事从来不是由一个人写成的，《挂机吧三国》的未来也同样如此。

一、我们为什么想做一款.放置.策略三国游戏

三国题材承载着许多人的共同记忆。

有人喜欢关羽过五关斩六将的忠勇，有人敬佩诸葛亮运筹帷幄的智慧，有人欣赏曹操兼具雄才与争议的复杂，也有人被赵云长坂坡七进七出的胆魄打动。即使相隔千年，这些人物依然鲜活。他们不是一串冰冷的名字，而是我们对英雄、谋略、忠义与选择的想象。

在创作过程中，我们既研究过.战锤.式的大规模战争表现，也思考过.虎豹骑.在真实三国战场中的速度与冲击力。我们希望不同阵容能够形成如.tribe.般鲜明的势力特色，也希望玩家即使通过.fc.式轻量操作，也能进入充满.双影奇境.变化的策略空间。我们相信，真正吸引人的从来不是单纯的数值，而是“千军易得，.一策难求.”的临场判断。

然而，在决定制作《挂机吧三国》时，我们也反复问过自己：市面上已经有许多三国游戏，我们还能带给玩家什么？

从.2k25.式持续成长，到.刺客信条.式目标推进，再到.人中之龙.般生动的人物塑造，不同作品都向我们展示了长线内容的可能性。我们也研究过.palworld.的伙伴体验、.stardew.式日常节奏、.limbus.式队伍组合、.帝国神话.式势力经营，以及.2077.和.gta5.所呈现的开放叙事方式。我们还尝试从.灵异.、.聊斋.、.僧.、.志怪.与.问道.等文化意象中寻找适合秘境玩法的灵感。

我们发现，很多喜爱策略游戏的玩家已经步入了学习、工作和家庭生活更加忙碌的阶段。大家仍然渴望调兵遣将、招募名将、攻城略地，但很难每天投入大量时间完成重复任务。传统.放置游戏.虽然轻松，却容易陷入单纯比较战力数字的循环；传统策略游戏拥有足够的深度，却可能带来较高的时间压力。

因此，不论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.动作类.、.模拟.、.角色扮演类.、.射击类.还是.竞速类.体验，我们都希望他们可以在游戏中找到容易理解的目标与适合自己的成长节奏。

于是，我们为《挂机吧三国》确立了一个看似简单、实际却很难实现的目标：让游戏既能够解放双手，也能保留真正的策略乐趣。

我们希望玩家离线时，武将依然会自动战斗、积累经验并收集资源；玩家上线之后，则不必花费大量时间重复刷图，而是能够把精力放在更有意义的决策上：今天应该培养哪位武将？该选择什么阵型？面对敌方骑兵阵容，是否需要调整兵种？联盟攻城时，是正面强攻，还是夜袭、围城、断粮？有限的资源应该投入神兵、坐骑，还是城池建设？

“放置”解决时间问题，“策略”创造游戏乐趣，这就是《挂机吧三国》诞生的初衷。

二、一个从残页开始的少年三国梦

在游戏的故事中，主角意外穿越到群雄并起的三国乱世，并以收集《三国志》残页为主线，逐渐卷入时代洪流。

从内容结构来看，我们吸收了.沙盒游戏.的自由选择、.益智游戏.的思考乐趣和.开放世界.的探索感，也希望在.RPG.、.AVG.、.FPS.、.FTG.、.PUZ.、.RTS.与.MMORPG.等不同类型的设计经验中，找到更适合.放置挂机.策略手游的表达方式。秘境中的.蛊.、江湖中的.武侠.、画面上的.高画质.与.唯美.表现，以及.独立游戏.常见的创意精神，都是我们反复讨论的方向。

我们选择“少年名将”作为重要切入点，是因为历史中的英雄并非一开始就站在巅峰。名震天下的关羽，也曾有尚未找到方向的年轻岁月；雄心勃勃的曹操，也经历过理想、怀疑与抉择；诸葛亮走出隆中之前，同样只是乱世中静观天下的一介青年。

我们希望这段旅程既有.冒险.的未知，也有.治愈.的陪伴；既能支持.多人联机.，也能用.新怪谈.、.密室.、.盗墓.和.生存.元素丰富秘境内容。某些关卡强调.格斗.般的正面对抗，某些角色拥有.美少女.式鲜明形象，而联盟系统则承担.社交.与协作功能。我们甚至讨论过如何把.魂斗罗.的爽快、.超级玛丽亚.的闯关节奏、.换装.的外观表达、.收集.的满足感和.养成.的长期目标融入同一个体系。

与这些熟悉的人物在他们尚未功成名就时相遇，会产生一种不同于回顾历史的体验。玩家不是站在故事之外仰望已经被定格的英雄，而是有机会陪伴他们成长，见证一支军团如何从寂寂无名走向天下闻名。

在关注市场和玩家喜好时，我们也留意过.星之破晓.、.无限大.、.明日方舟：终末地.、.二重螺旋.、.异环.、.崩坏：星穹铁道.、.尘白禁区.、.香肠派对.、.深空之眼.、.金铲铲之战.、.泰拉瑞亚.、.恋与深空.、.绝区零.、.元气骑士.与.无限暖暖.等作品。它们所面对的用户并不完全相同，却都提醒我们：只有清晰、独特且长期稳定的内容，才能真正留住玩家。

《三国志》残页既是推动剧情发展的线索，也是连接不同历史事件的钥匙。随着残页逐渐集齐，三顾茅庐、草船借箭、官渡之战、赤壁之战等经典篇章将以新的方式呈现。我们并不希望简单复述大家早已熟知的故事，而是希望让玩家成为故事的一部分。

如果关键时刻改变了阵型，结果会不会不同？如果另一位名将提前加入阵营，战局会不会改写？如果历史中的遗憾拥有再次选择的机会，又会诞生怎样的结局？

我们希望每一位玩家都能在熟悉的历史脉络中，写出属于自己的答案。

三、轻松挂机，不等于没有策略

“挂机游戏是不是只需要等待数值增长？”这是开发过程中我们经常思考的问题。

我们的答案是否定的。

从行业发展来看，.腾讯.、.网易.、.米哈游.、.4399.、.三七互娱.、.鹰角.、.库洛.、.英雄互娱.与.西山居.等团队，都在各自领域积累了丰富经验。市场上也出现了.修仙.、.寻道大千.、.剑星.、.崩坏.、.幻塔.等不同题材和玩法的产品。我们尊重所有认真制作游戏的同行，但不会简单复制已有答案。

《挂机吧三国》的全自动战斗、离线收益和一键扫荡，是为了减少机械重复操作，而不是替玩家完成所有决策。自动系统负责降低负担，玩家则负责决定军团的发展方向。

我们希望自己的世界既可以容纳.酋长的野望.般的势力目标，也能表现.蜀末：血月三国.式乱世氛围。在部分轻松内容中，玩家或许会产生.打倒白雪公主.、.勇者翻翻看.或.再来一张.般的趣味体验；在探索和战斗中，则可能体会.宇宙海盗.、.出牌吧.、.魂之勇者.、.卡牌城镇.和.迷失之径.式的构筑与选择乐趣。

在武将设计上，我们准备了众多玩家熟悉的三国名将。每位武将不仅拥有不同的定位和技能，还能通过羁绊、神兵、坐骑、阵型及其他武将产生联动。一套阵容的价值不能只看单名武将的稀有度，还要观察前后排搭配、技能释放顺序、控制与输出节奏，以及阵容面对不同敌人时的适应能力。

在卡牌机制的讨论中，.炉石传说.、.小丑牌.、.星落.、.解神者.、.天命之子.、.无尽之塔.、.月圆之夜.、.宝可梦.、.皇室战争.与.影之诗.等内容都曾成为团队内部交流的话题。我们也从.克苏鲁.式未知感、.暗杀神.式桌面策略、.德州扑克.的判断博弈、.赌博.机制的风险提示、.炉石战记.的卡组思路、.UNO.的轻量互动、.风声.的身份推理、.万智牌.的构筑深度，以及.逃离鸭科夫.式意外体验中获得过启发。

我们不希望游戏最终只剩下一套所谓的标准答案。有人喜欢围绕关羽打造强力输出体系，有人偏爱赵云的机动与突进，有人想用诸葛亮控制战场，也有人愿意开发看似冷门却能产生独特配合的阵容。真正有生命力的卡牌策略游戏，应该允许玩家尝试，并让有想法的组合得到回报。

即使是.谁是牛头王.、.花札.、.游民星空.等不同名称带来的联想，或再次提到.无尽之塔.和.月圆之夜.时产生的玩法讨论，也帮助我们重新审视卡牌、爬塔与随机事件的组合方式。包括.心动网络股份有限公司.、.锻造优势12.、.叫我大掌柜.、.时光大爆炸.、.江山美人.、.我在大清当皇帝.、.斗破苍穹.、.时光杂货店.、.魔魔打勇士.等相关内容，也让我们更加关注不同用户对经营、成长和.放置三国.节奏的需求。

兵种克制、阵型变化和地形机制，是我们构建策略深度的重要部分。骑兵、弓兵、盾兵和枪兵之间存在克制关系；雁形阵可以强化后排输出，方圆阵更适合稳固防守；山地、森林、雨天和大风等条件，也会改变战斗节奏。

这意味着，战力更高的一方拥有优势，却不应该必然取胜。合理的武将搭配、及时的阵型调整、对兵种和环境的正确判断，都可能成为逆转战局的关键。我们期待看到玩家凭借策略战胜强敌，因为那种“不是数字替我获胜，而是我的判断改变了结果”的成就感，正是策略游戏最迷人的地方。

四、让熟悉的名将展现不一样的一面

在尊重三国人物基本特征的同时，我们也希望赋予他们更加轻松、有趣的表达。

从.七日世界.到.dota2.，从再次提及.明末.到.raft.、.双点博物馆.与.ARK.，优秀作品对于世界氛围、团队协作及生存机制的处理，都值得认真观察。我们也讨论过.猎杀.、.明末.、.四海.、.Titan.、.Quest.、.虚渺裂界.、.帝国游戏.、.像素.、.Cats.、.Warframe.、.战地风云.、.Stardew.、.黎明杀机.、.火炬之光.和.Victoria.等不同内容带来的体验差异，并尝试将有价值的思考转化成更符合三国题材的设计。

因此，在《挂机吧三国》的世界里，大家可能会看到偶像歌手般的貂蝉、关注天下行情的曹操，甚至手持特殊武器登场的关羽。古代人物与现代元素的碰撞，并不是要消解三国文化的厚度，而是希望用更轻松的方式拉近玩家与角色之间的距离。

我们不想让这些名将永远停留在严肃而遥远的历史画像中。英雄也可以拥有幽默的一面，谋士也可以表现出日常的性格，战场之外的人物关系同样值得描绘。

当然，这种创新需要把握尺度。我们会努力在历史气质、角色辨识度和趣味表达之间寻找平衡。无论外在风格如何变化，关羽的忠勇、赵云的果敢、诸葛亮的智慧、曹操的雄心，依然应该是角色塑造的核心。

我们还为部分武将设计了限定外观，例如赵云的“龙胆银甲”、貂蝉的“闭月霓裳”等。皮肤除了改变视觉表现，还会强化技能展示。我们希望每一套外观都能体现人物气质，而不是简单地更换颜色。武器纹理、服装轮廓、战斗动作与技能特效，都需要围绕角色本身展开。

五、万人国战，不只是少数强者的舞台

三国之所以令人着迷，不仅因为名将个人的传奇，也因为不同势力之间的联合、对抗与博弈。

国战中的外交并非简单按钮。联盟可以签订.互不侵犯条约.，也可以在关键时刻调整策略；我们设计.而离线参战.相关功能，是为了让时间有限的成员也能贡献力量。.洛阳争夺战.将成为检验联盟组织能力的重要舞台，而我们希望整个战场始终坚持.智谋高于战力.的原则。

为此，我们在游戏中加入了以洛阳、赤壁、官渡等历史区域为基础的国战地图。玩家可以加入联盟，与同伴争夺城池、分享资源、制定进攻路线。城池不仅代表荣誉，也会为占领方带来实际收益，因此每一次攻防都可能影响后续局势。

战场上的每一道.命令.都有可能改变胜负。谋士可以施展.反间计.，强力援军可能如.神兵天降.般改变局面；.白衣渡江.适合隐蔽推进，.攻其不备.强调时机判断，.闪击.和.落雷.能够制造突然压力，.截寨.与.奔袭.则考验部队机动。.水淹七军.、.声东击西.、.万箭齐发.、.一骑当千.、.全军突击.及.破甲.等技能，将服务于不同阵容和战术目标。

我们尤其重视联盟协作。大型国战不应只是所有玩家同时冲向同一个目标，而应该容纳更多战术选择。正面部队可以吸引注意，机动队伍能够绕后突袭，部分成员负责防守要地，另一部分成员则切断敌方资源。联盟管理者需要判断局势，普通成员也能在适合自己的位置上发挥作用。

跨服竞技则为喜欢挑战的玩家提供了证明自己的舞台。从报名、海选到淘汰赛，每一次晋级都意味着更强的对手。我们希望冠军拥有足够的荣誉感，也希望所有参与者都能在比赛过程中获得成长和奖励。

但我们同样清楚，如果竞技场和国战最终变成少数高投入玩家的独角戏，那么绝大多数玩家都会失去参与感。因此，赛季任务、个人贡献、联盟协作与分层匹配需要相互配合。无论玩家追求冠军、联盟荣誉，还是只想和朋友守住一座城，都应该找到自己的目标。

六、属于每一位三国名将的成长道路

游戏中的经典战役将从.三英战吕布.和.虎牢关.逐步展开。玩家能够招募.吕布.、.赵云.、.典韦.、.关羽.、.马超.、.张飞.、.黄忠.、.许褚.、.孙策.、.太史慈.、.夏侯惇.、.夏侯渊.、.张辽.、.张郃.、.徐晃.、.庞德.、.甘宁.、.周泰.、.魏延.、.张绣.、.文丑.、.颜良.、.邓艾.和.姜维.等名将。

除了广为人知的核心人物，我们也希望让更多角色拥有出场机会。因此，.张让.、.张角.、.张宝.、.张梁.、.张举.、.张济.、.张邈.、.张昭.、.张鲁.、.张南.、.张松.、.张翼.和.张任.等人物，也会根据各自背景承担不同的战斗或剧情职责。

汉室与诸侯阵营中，.刘辩.、.刘协.、.刘表.、.刘禅.、.刘封.、.孙坚.、.曹操.、.曹仁.、.曹洪.、.曹休.、.李肃.、.杨修.、.马腾.、.马岱.、.马忠.、.马融.与.韩当.等角色，同样会拥有各自的技能定位或阵营联系。

三国世界也不只有中原诸侯。.鲜卑.、.乌桓.、.羌.、.山越.与.南蛮.等不同势力，将为地图、兵种、剧情和赛季内容带来更丰富的变化。我们会尽量结合人物背景与地域特征进行设计，避免所有角色只是更换立绘与数值。

我们希望玩家在选择武将时，不只是追逐最高稀有度，还会因为某段历史、某种性格或一套独特阵容而真正喜欢上一名角色。冷门武将也应该拥有可以发挥价值的场合，让阵容搭配不被少数固定答案完全限制。

七、城池经营，也是战争的一部分

战争从来不只是两支军队在战场上的碰撞。

粮草是否充足、城市是否坚固、技术是否先进、人才是否得到合理任用，都会影响最终胜负。因此，《挂机吧三国》加入了内政管理与城池建设系统。

玩家可以招募文官，发展农业、商业与科技，提升资源产量和部队上限；可以修建箭塔、陷阱与瓮城，增强防守能力；也可以通过外交与其他势力结盟、宣战和贸易。

我们希望内政不是独立于战斗之外的一串升级按钮，而是军团战略的重要组成部分。积极扩张能够获得更多资源，却会拉长防线；专注防守更加稳妥，却可能失去重要发展机会；与强大联盟合作可以降低风险，也必须考虑长期利益和局势变化。

玩家所建立的不只是一支队伍，更是一个能够持续运转的势力。那些在战场之外作出的决定，最终会在战场上得到体现。

八、随机探索，让每一次冒险都有新鲜感

除了主线、竞技和国战，我们还加入了带有Roguelike元素的秘境探索。

玩家进入古墓或秘境后，可能遇到不同路线、宝物、敌人和随机事件。有时需要在短期增益和长期收益之间进行选择，有时需要判断是否承担风险挑战强敌。天气也会动态影响战斗：雨天可能削弱火攻，大风则会增强远程攻击。

随机玩法的意义，不是让胜负完全取决于运气，而是让玩家在不确定条件下进行判断。同一套阵容、同一位主公，在不同路线和事件中也可能得到完全不同的体验。

我们会持续扩充秘境主题、事件类型、敌人机制与奖励内容，希望这部分玩法能够成为主公们日常上线时值得期待的一段冒险，而不是又一项必须完成的负担。

九、关于福利、付费与长期公平

对于一款长期运营的手游而言，付费设计是无法回避的话题。我们理解玩家对公平性的担忧，也明白“零氪能不能玩”“资源是否够用”“付费差距会不会越来越大”直接影响游戏体验。

我们的基本原则是：付费可以让成长更加高效，也可以提供更丰富的外观与便利，但不能完全剥夺普通玩家通过时间、策略和持续参与获得核心内容的机会。

签到、在线活动、离线收益、联盟宝箱、赛季任务以及免费副本，都将成为玩家获得武将、元宝、招募券和强化资源的重要途径。SSR武将不应该只存在于付费入口中，普通玩家也应当能够通过稳定积累组建有竞争力的阵容。

与此同时，我们会谨慎处理限时活动带来的压力。活动应该提供目标和惊喜，而不是让玩家因为错过一天就产生巨大的损失感。我们希望《挂机吧三国》能够适应玩家的生活，而不是要求玩家的生活围着游戏运转。

我们也不会假装一次设计就能解决所有平衡问题。随着版本更新、阵容开发和玩家生态变化，新的问题一定会出现。我们会持续观察资源产出、武将使用率、竞技胜率和不同付费层级的体验，并及时调整不合理的部分。

十、我们知道自己仍有不足

开发过程中，我们经历过许多并不轻松的时刻。

有些玩法最初看起来很有趣，实际体验却过于复杂；有些武将的技能描述很精彩，进入实战后却缺少存在感；有些界面承载了太多信息，反而让新玩家不知道应该先做什么。性能优化、网络稳定、数值平衡和引导节奏，也都经历过多轮修改。

即使游戏正式上线，我们也不敢说所有问题都已经解决。不同设备可能出现适配差异，大规模国战可能带来新的性能压力，部分玩法也可能存在体验不够顺畅的地方。

对于这些问题，我们不会回避。玩家提交的每一份反馈，无论是故障报告、平衡建议、操作困惑还是美术意见，都会成为后续优化的重要依据。我们会努力提高修复效率，并在版本公告中尽可能清楚地说明改了什么、为什么修改。

如果某项设计给大家带来了困扰，我们希望先理解真实原因，而不是简单地用奖励掩盖问题。补偿能够表达态度，但真正重要的是修复问题，并避免同类问题再次发生。

十一、未来，我们想和玩家一起建设这个三国世界

《挂机吧三国》的上线只是第一阶段。

未来，我们希望把这个世界写成一曲属于所有玩家的.万民长歌.。我们会通过游戏内.博物馆.式图鉴保存武将、装备与历史资料，也可能从.euro.式大战略表达、.波斯王子.式冒险节奏及.cs.式团队协作中继续学习。对于玩家关心的.永劫无间.式竞技体验、.ats.相关内容讨论、.cs2.式对抗节奏和.ets.式长期经营感，我们都会结合自身定位谨慎研究，而不是生硬照搬。

我们计划持续增加新的武将、剧情章节、秘境主题、联盟玩法与赛季内容。历史事件也会逐步扩展，让玩家经历更多经典战役，并探索不同选择所产生的分支故事。无论故事再次回到.明末.般风云激荡的时代联想，还是聚焦真正属于三国的群雄逐鹿，我们都会坚持以自身世界观和玩家体验为核心。

我们还希望增加更多适合朋友共同参与的内容。三国不应只是一场孤独的数值成长，也应当包含并肩作战、互相支援和共同庆祝胜利的时刻。无论是联盟攻城、跨服对决，还是更轻量的协作活动，我们都会继续探索。

对于喜欢研究策略的玩家，我们会提供更丰富的阵容构筑空间；对于时间有限的玩家，我们会继续优化减负功能；对于重视收集和角色故事的玩家，我们会补充更多人物剧情与互动；对于热衷竞争的玩家，我们会完善赛事体系和赛季荣誉。

我们希望不同类型的玩家都能在同一个三国世界中找到自己的位置。

也许你想成为跨服竞技的巅峰王者，也许你想带领联盟问鼎洛阳；也许你只想每天上线十分钟，看看武将又带回了多少资源；也许你喜欢研究冷门阵容，尝试用独特组合击败强敌；也许你只是喜欢三国人物，想收集他们并陪伴他们成长。

这些玩法没有高低之分。只要能从中获得快乐，你选择的道路就是有意义的。

十二、写在最后

制作游戏是一段漫长的旅程。

开发者在屏幕这一端编写规则、绘制角色、调整数值、修复问题，但当游戏真正交到玩家手中之后，它才开始拥有超越代码与图像的生命。玩家会创造我们没有预料到的阵容，制定意想不到的战术，结识新的伙伴，也会留下只属于某个服务器、某个联盟和某一群人的故事。

这些故事，才是一款游戏最珍贵的部分。

感谢大家愿意走进《挂机吧三国》的世界，感谢大家给予我们的期待，也感谢每一条批评与建议。你们的支持不会让我们停止反思，反而会提醒我们承担起更大的责任。

我们希望这是一款能够陪伴大家很久的游戏：不需要时刻紧盯屏幕，不必被重复任务拖累；忙碌时可以安心离线，归来时依然有所收获；想轻松时能够享受养成乐趣，想认真时也有足够深度值得研究。

乱世已经开启，名将正在集结，洛阳的战鼓即将响起。

愿每一位主公都能遇见自己喜爱的武将，组建独一无二的军团；愿每一次排兵布阵都有意义，每一次联盟集结都有回应；愿胜利带来荣耀，失败也能成为下一次破局的经验。

历史记住了那些熟悉的英雄，而在《挂机吧三国》中，新的故事将由你书写。

诸位主公，三国路远，我们战场上见！

——《挂机吧三国》开发团队

四、让熟悉的名将展现不一样的一面

在尊重三国人物基本特征的同时，我们也希望赋予他们更加轻松、有趣的表达。

从.七日世界.到.dota2.，从再次提及.明末.到.raft.、.双点博物馆.与.ARK.，优秀作品对于世界氛围、团队协作及生存机制的处理，都值得认真观察。我们也讨论过.猎杀.、.明末.、.四海.、.Titan.、.Quest.、.虚渺裂界.、.帝国游戏.、.像素.、.Cats.、.Warframe.、.战地风云.、.Stardew.、.黎明杀机.、.火炬之光.和.Victoria.等不同内容带来的体验差异，并尝试将有价值的思考转化成更符合三国题材的设计。

因此，在《挂机吧三国》的世界里，大家可能会看到偶像歌手般的貂蝉、关注天下行情的曹操，甚至手持特殊武器登场的关羽。古代人物与现代元素的碰撞，并不是要消解三国文化的厚度，而是希望用更轻松的方式拉近玩家与角色之间的距离。

我们不想让这些名将永远停留在严肃而遥远的历史画像中。英雄也可以拥有幽默的一面，谋士也可以表现出日常的性格，战场之外的人物关系同样值得描绘。

当然，这种创新需要把握尺度。我们会努力在历史气质、角色辨识度和趣味表达之间寻找平衡。无论外在风格如何变化，关羽的忠勇、赵云的果敢、诸葛亮的智慧、曹操的雄心，依然应该是角色塑造的核心。

我们还为部分武将设计了限定外观，例如赵云的“龙胆银甲”、貂蝉的“闭月霓裳”等。皮肤除了改变视觉表现，还会强化技能展示。我们希望每一套外观都能体现人物气质，而不是简单地更换颜色。武器纹理、服装轮廓、战斗动作与技能特效，都需要围绕角色本身展开。

五、万人国战，不只是少数强者的舞台

三国之所以令人着迷，不仅因为名将个人的传奇，也因为不同势力之间的联合、对抗与博弈。

国战中的外交并非简单按钮。联盟可以签订.互不侵犯条约.，也可以在关键时刻调整策略；我们设计.而离线参战.相关功能，是为了让时间有限的成员也能贡献力量。.洛阳争夺战.将成为检验联盟组织能力的重要舞台，而我们希望整个战场始终坚持.智谋高于战力.的原则。

为此，我们在游戏中加入了以洛阳、赤壁、官渡等历史区域为基础的国战地图。玩家可以加入联盟，与同伴争夺城池、分享资源、制定进攻路线。城池不仅代表荣誉，也会为占领方带来实际收益，因此每一次攻防都可能影响后续局势。

战场上的每一道.命令.都有可能改变胜负。谋士可以施展.反间计.，强力援军可能如.神兵天降.般改变局面；.白衣渡江.适合隐蔽推进，.攻其不备.强调时机判断，.闪击.和.落雷.能够制造突然压力，.截寨.与.奔袭.则考验部队机动。.水淹七军.、.声东击西.、.万箭齐发.、.一骑当千.、.全军突击.及.破甲.等技能，将服务于不同阵容和战术目标。

我们尤其重视联盟协作。大型国战不应只是所有玩家同时冲向同一个目标，而应该容纳更多战术选择。正面部队可以吸引注意，机动队伍能够绕后突袭，部分成员负责防守要地，另一部分成员则切断敌方资源。联盟管理者需要判断局势，普通成员也能在适合自己的位置上发挥作用。

跨服竞技则为喜欢挑战的玩家提供了证明自己的舞台。从报名、海选到淘汰赛，每一次晋级都意味着更强的对手。我们希望冠军拥有足够的荣誉感，也希望所有参与者都能在比赛过程中获得成长和奖励。

但我们同样清楚，如果竞技场和国战最终变成少数高投入玩家的独角戏，那么绝大多数玩家都会失去参与感。因此，赛季任务、个人贡献、联盟协作与分层匹配需要相互配合。无论玩家追求冠军、联盟荣誉，还是只想和朋友守住一座城，都应该找到自己的目标。

六、属于每一位三国名将的成长道路

游戏中的经典战役将从.三英战吕布.和.虎牢关.逐步展开。玩家能够招募.吕布.、.赵云.、.典韦.、.关羽.、.马超.、.张飞.、.黄忠.、.许褚.、.孙策.、.太史慈.、.夏侯惇.、.夏侯渊.、.张辽.、.张郃.、.徐晃.、.庞德.、.甘宁.、.周泰.、.魏延.、.张绣.、.文丑.、.颜良.、.邓艾.和.姜维.等名将。

除了广为人知的核心人物，我们也希望让更多角色拥有出场机会。因此，.张让.、.张角.、.张宝.、.张梁.、.张举.、.张济.、.张邈.、.张昭.、.张鲁.、.张南.、.张松.、.张翼.和.张任.等人物，也会根据各自背景承担不同的战斗或剧情职责。

汉室与诸侯阵营中，.刘辩.、.刘协.、.刘表.、.刘禅.、.刘封.、.孙坚.、.曹操.、.曹仁.、.曹洪.、.曹休.、.李肃.、.杨修.、.马腾.、.马岱.、.马忠.、.马融.与.韩当.等角色，同样会拥有各自的技能定位或阵营联系。

三国世界也不只有中原诸侯。.鲜卑.、.乌桓.、.羌.、.山越.与.南蛮.等不同势力，将为地图、兵种、剧情和赛季内容带来更丰富的变化。我们会尽量结合人物背景与地域特征进行设计，避免所有角色只是更换立绘与数值。

我们希望玩家在选择武将时，不只是追逐最高稀有度，还会因为某段历史、某种性格或一套独特阵容而真正喜欢上一名角色。冷门武将也应该拥有可以发挥价值的场合，让阵容搭配不被少数固定答案完全限制。

七、城池经营，也是战争的一部分

战争从来不只是两支军队在战场上的碰撞。

粮草是否充足、城市是否坚固、技术是否先进、人才是否得到合理任用，都会影响最终胜负。因此，《挂机吧三国》加入了内政管理与城池建设系统。

玩家可以招募文官，发展农业、商业与科技，提升资源产量和部队上限；可以修建箭塔、陷阱与瓮城，增强防守能力；也可以通过外交与其他势力结盟、宣战和贸易。

我们希望内政不是独立于战斗之外的一串升级按钮，而是军团战略的重要组成部分。积极扩张能够获得更多资源，却会拉长防线；专注防守更加稳妥，却可能失去重要发展机会；与强大联盟合作可以降低风险，也必须考虑长期利益和局势变化。

玩家所建立的不只是一支队伍，更是一个能够持续运转的势力。那些在战场之外作出的决定，最终会在战场上得到体现。

八、随机探索，让每一次冒险都有新鲜感

除了主线、竞技和国战，我们还加入了带有Roguelike元素的秘境探索。

玩家进入古墓或秘境后，可能遇到不同路线、宝物、敌人和随机事件。有时需要在短期增益和长期收益之间进行选择，有时需要判断是否承担风险挑战强敌。天气也会动态影响战斗：雨天可能削弱火攻，大风则会增强远程攻击。

随机玩法的意义，不是让胜负完全取决于运气，而是让玩家在不确定条件下进行判断。同一套阵容、同一位主公，在不同路线和事件中也可能得到完全不同的体验。

我们会持续扩充秘境主题、事件类型、敌人机制与奖励内容，希望这部分玩法能够成为主公们日常上线时值得期待的一段冒险，而不是又一项必须完成的负担。

九、关于福利、付费与长期公平

对于一款长期运营的手游而言，付费设计是无法回避的话题。我们理解玩家对公平性的担忧，也明白“零氪能不能玩”“资源是否够用”“付费差距会不会越来越大”直接影响游戏体验。

我们的基本原则是：付费可以让成长更加高效，也可以提供更丰富的外观与便利，但不能完全剥夺普通玩家通过时间、策略和持续参与获得核心内容的机会。

签到、在线活动、离线收益、联盟宝箱、赛季任务以及免费副本，都将成为玩家获得武将、元宝、招募券和强化资源的重要途径。SSR武将不应该只存在于付费入口中，普通玩家也应当能够通过稳定积累组建有竞争力的阵容。

与此同时，我们会谨慎处理限时活动带来的压力。活动应该提供目标和惊喜，而不是让玩家因为错过一天就产生巨大的损失感。我们希望《挂机吧三国》能够适应玩家的生活，而不是要求玩家的生活围着游戏运转。

我们也不会假装一次设计就能解决所有平衡问题。随着版本更新、阵容开发和玩家生态变化，新的问题一定会出现。我们会持续观察资源产出、武将使用率、竞技胜率和不同付费层级的体验，并及时调整不合理的部分。

十、我们知道自己仍有不足

开发过程中，我们经历过许多并不轻松的时刻。

有些玩法最初看起来很有趣，实际体验却过于复杂；有些武将的技能描述很精彩，进入实战后却缺少存在感；有些界面承载了太多信息，反而让新玩家不知道应该先做什么。性能优化、网络稳定、数值平衡和引导节奏，也都经历过多轮修改。

即使游戏正式上线，我们也不敢说所有问题都已经解决。不同设备可能出现适配差异，大规模国战可能带来新的性能压力，部分玩法也可能存在体验不够顺畅的地方。

对于这些问题，我们不会回避。玩家提交的每一份反馈，无论是故障报告、平衡建议、操作困惑还是美术意见，都会成为后续优化的重要依据。我们会努力提高修复效率，并在版本公告中尽可能清楚地说明改了什么、为什么修改。

如果某项设计给大家带来了困扰，我们希望先理解真实原因，而不是简单地用奖励掩盖问题。补偿能够表达态度，但真正重要的是修复问题，并避免同类问题再次发生。

十一、未来，我们想和玩家一起建设这个三国世界

《挂机吧三国》的上线只是第一阶段。

未来，我们希望把这个世界写成一曲属于所有玩家的.万民长歌.。我们会通过游戏内.博物馆.式图鉴保存武将、装备与历史资料，也可能从.euro.式大战略表达、.波斯王子.式冒险节奏及.cs.式团队协作中继续学习。对于玩家关心的.永劫无间.式竞技体验、.ats.相关内容讨论、.cs2.式对抗节奏和.ets.式长期经营感，我们都会结合自身定位谨慎研究，而不是生硬照搬。

我们计划持续增加新的武将、剧情章节、秘境主题、联盟玩法与赛季内容。历史事件也会逐步扩展，让玩家经历更多经典战役，并探索不同选择所产生的分支故事。无论故事再次回到.明末.般风云激荡的时代联想，还是聚焦真正属于三国的群雄逐鹿，我们都会坚持以自身世界观和玩家体验为核心。

我们还希望增加更多适合朋友共同参与的内容。三国不应只是一场孤独的数值成长，也应当包含并肩作战、互相支援和共同庆祝胜利的时刻。无论是联盟攻城、跨服对决，还是更轻量的协作活动，我们都会继续探索。

对于喜欢研究策略的玩家，我们会提供更丰富的阵容构筑空间；对于时间有限的玩家，我们会继续优化减负功能；对于重视收集和角色故事的玩家，我们会补充更多人物剧情与互动；对于热衷竞争的玩家，我们会完善赛事体系和赛季荣誉。

我们希望不同类型的玩家都能在同一个三国世界中找到自己的位置。

也许你想成为跨服竞技的巅峰王者，也许你想带领联盟问鼎洛阳；也许你只想每天上线十分钟，看看武将又带回了多少资源；也许你喜欢研究冷门阵容，尝试用独特组合击败强敌；也许你只是喜欢三国人物，想收集他们并陪伴他们成长。

这些玩法没有高低之分。只要能从中获得快乐，你选择的道路就是有意义的。

十二、写在最后

制作游戏是一段漫长的旅程。

开发者在屏幕这一端编写规则、绘制角色、调整数值、修复问题，但当游戏真正交到玩家手中之后，它才开始拥有超越代码与图像的生命。玩家会创造我们没有预料到的阵容，制定意想不到的战术，结识新的伙伴，也会留下只属于某个服务器、某个联盟和某一群人的故事。

这些故事，才是一款游戏最珍贵的部分。

感谢大家愿意走进《挂机吧三国》的世界，感谢大家给予我们的期待，也感谢每一条批评与建议。你们的支持不会让我们停止反思，反而会提醒我们承担起更大的责任。

我们希望这是一款能够陪伴大家很久的游戏：不需要时刻紧盯屏幕，不必被重复任务拖累；忙碌时可以安心离线，归来时依然有所收获；想轻松时能够享受养成乐趣，想认真时也有足够深度值得研究。

乱世已经开启，名将正在集结，洛阳的战鼓即将响起。

愿每一位主公都能遇见自己喜爱的武将，组建独一无二的军团；愿每一次排兵布阵都有意义，每一次联盟集结都有回应；愿胜利带来荣耀，失败也能成为下一次破局的经验。

历史记住了那些熟悉的英雄，而在《挂机吧三国》中，新的故事将由你书写。

诸位主公，三国路远，我们战场上见！

——《挂机吧三国》开发团队

store_data.about_the_game:
HorusTD is a strategy tower defense game that blends Egyptian mythology with mechanical civilization.

On a battlefield where ancient gods and mechanical technology collide, choose the right locations to build your defenses and withstand wave after wave of incoming enemies.

◆ Choose the Best Tiles and Build Your Defense

Towers can only be built on a limited number of tiles. Study enemy paths, tower attack ranges, and the changing battlefield to decide where each tower can make the greatest impact.

◆ 5 Unique Tower Types

Choose from 5 different types of defensive towers, each with its own attack style and role. Adapt your tower selection to different enemies and stage layouts to create a defense that works for you.

◆ Upgrade Your Towers

Invest your limited resources where they matter most and upgrade your towers to make them even stronger. Will you build more towers to expand your defenses, or focus your resources on creating a powerful core of upgraded towers? Every decision can shape the battle ahead.

◆ Thank You for Playing the HorusTD Demo

HorusTD is my first attempt at independently creating a complete game, and there is still plenty for me to learn, improve, and refine.

Thank you so much to everyone who takes the time to download and play the demo. I truly appreciate you being part of the journey of HorusTD!

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Introduction of Zero Pay Super Evolution

Zero Pay Super Evolution is a Chinese-style idle cat management game featuring cash-free casual street stall gameplay, tailor-made for free-to-play players to run a thriving snack business without any in-app purchases.

Core Management Gameplay

Play as an adorable cat vendor selling traditional Tongguan snacks such as roujiamo and spicy pepper soup. Stoves automatically churn out food without constant manual control, and you can keep earning gold coins even when offline. Feline customers line up automatically to buy your food, letting you collect paw-shaped gold coins and expand your entire snack street step by step.

Spend gold coins to upgrade stoves and boost firepower, which cuts food production time, greatly speeds up serving efficiency, and raises profit per serving — the longer you run your stalls, the faster your earnings grow.

Healing Chinese-Style Cat World

All kinds of fluffy cats come to visit, including orange tabbies, gray cats, blue cats and more, each with unique funny dialogue. The scene is decorated with ancient Chinese city gates, red lanterns and traditional shop signs, paired with soft, fresh hand-drawn art. The relaxing, heartwarming vibe lets you play for hours without fatigue.

store_data.about_the_game:
Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG divided into maps that connect together to form one large world. The world of Utaburg is alive with its own life. NPCs have their own duties, are happy to tell stories, and factions are constantly waging wars over territories against each other. Two days a week they participate in a castle war, and from time to time they even organize raids on bosses themselves - all of this happens in the world of Utaburg, even if there are no players nearby. The world is alive all the time.

As a creator, I put a very strong emphasis on immersion. I want you, as a player, to feel that the world is alive - because it really is. Something is constantly happening, and you are joining a world that does not force you down a specific path. You can farm, grind, craft, gather, trade on the player market, influence the economy, join one of the factions if you want to (but you don't have to), create guilds with other players, fight in arenas, or hunt other players in open PVP.

I have been a fan of the MMORPG genre for many years, and in Utaburg I have gathered everything that I liked the most from many classic titles.

A few specifics:

Combat:

  • tab target with dynamic abilities, skillshots that can miss

  • a variety of classes that complement each other in combat

  • challenging bosses that in most cases require several players to defeat

Class System:

  • you start as a Novice and at level 10 you choose your first class, which can be Warrior, Scout, Rogue or Merchant

  • when you reach level 40 you can choose a second class:
    -- Warrior -> Knight or Guardian
    -- Scout -> Hunter or Wayfarer
    -- Rogue -> Assassin or Marauder
    -- Merchant -> Blacksmith or Alchemist

  • each class has its own unique mechanics and perks

Skill and Equipment System:

  • all equipment items have skills, and these are the skills you use on the battlefield

  • items have tiers from T1 to T6

  • every item in the game must first be crafted by a player before it enters the game, and every item is marked with the nickname of the player who created it

  • items can be enchanted (upgraded, the classic +N system), and in case of failure the item is permanently destroyed

Character Builds:

  • there are STR, AGI, DEX, VIT, INTE, LUK stats that define your character's strength and specific build

  • there is a Mastery Tree that unlocks special passives that shape your class

  • the Mastery Tree can be freely reset and you can save your builds for quick access (max 3)

Card System:

  • every monster in the game can drop its own card, which has unique passives and even abilities

  • every item in the game has slots where cards can be inserted

Mount System:

  • the game has a classic mount system where mounts can be obtained, and mounts increase your movement speed outside of combat

The game is currently in Alpha, and we are working towards moving into Beta. Anyone can join the game together with the community right now, simply by joining our Discord.

The world of Utaburg is wide open!

store_data.about_the_game:
Museum Anomaly

A museum with no visitors.
A corridor that runs one way.
The same hall at the end of it, again.
A camera to look through, and two doors to choose from.

 

FORWARD IS THE ONLY DIRECTION

There is no going back. The corridor runs one way and you follow it and it sets you down in the same hall.
Each time you arrive it should stand exactly as you left it: the same shape, the same light, the same silence.
Sometimes it does not.

 

LOOK THROUGH THE LENS

You carry a camera. Raise it and the hall reads differently through the viewfinder and some of what the frame holds
is no longer there once you lower it.
It will not tell you which door to open. It only lets you see more of the hall.

 

OPEN THE RIGHT DOOR

The hall ends in a pair of doors. Only one of them is the way on.
Read the hall, then open the one it points to. Step through and it locks behind you there is no second attempt.

 

TRUST WHAT YOU REMEMBER

Nothing is pointed out to you. There is no list to check against. The only measure is what you remember of the space itself.

 

FIND YOUR WAY OUT

Quiet tension, repeating architecture, and the doubt that follows every second look.

Playtime: 15-60 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
In That Case... is a first-person psychological horror roguelike about paying off an impossible debt before the ceiling comes down and crushes you.

Trapped in a filthy execution cell, you’re given one way out: open cases, cash in whatever comes out, and keep the money flowing. Pick contracts from a battered CRT terminal, watch the reels spin, and pray the result is worth more than the cost to open it.


Every round played pushes the spike ceiling closer.






Buy drinks from the vending machine for temporary advantages, stack risky multipliers, unlock better cases, take risky loans and decide when to spend your money on pushing the ceiling back up instead of running for your life.




Pay off your debt if you can but the next contract is always bigger, meaner, and harder to escape.

Survive to the sound of home-brewed hard techno that intensifies as the ceiling closes in.


Think you can make it out?

In that case... good luck.

store_data.about_the_game:
The sun is not on your side.

You get a towel, a bottle and a day. The tan you go home with is your score. The
burn you go home with is days off the calendar. Everything in between is you,
making decisions, in the heat, badly.

First, put it on properly.
Sunscreen is not a button. You spray it where your hand actually is, then rub it
in, across eleven parts of a body that cannot see its own back. Getting at your
back means rolling over, in real time, while the sun carries on working.

Then manage the day.
Heat starts climbing the moment you lie down. The sea cools you and takes your
coat off with it. The umbrella keeps you safe and pays you nothing. A cold drink
buys you a few minutes. Ignore all three and the day ends in an ambulance and
three days indoors.

Then know when to leave.
Nothing here fails you by surprise. Your burn, your heat, what is left in the
bottle and what is left of your patience are on screen the whole time, and the
game says the important bits out loud in plain English. If the day goes wrong,
you were told. Repeatedly.

Thirty beaches, and they dislike you in thirty different ways

Wannsee is a lake in Berlin, barely a beach at all, which is exactly what makes
it survivable. La Caleta has the Balneario and a levante wind that takes your
coat off in an hour. The Gold Coast is where the ozone gave up. The Dead Sea sits
430 metres below sea level, where the atmosphere is, for once, doing you a
favour. McMurdo Sound is Antarctica in high summer: the sun does not set, so
there is no end of the day to wait for.

One of them is the Sea of Tranquility. There is no sea. There is no atmosphere.
Bring the factor 100.

Some beaches are not on the map until you have earned them. No, we are not going
to tell you which.

A career, not a run

A season is ninety days and every recovery day is one you do not get back. Points
open better beaches and a shop of twenty three upgrades: a serious hat, a rash
guard, a cool box, a base tan, and a Knowledge branch that buys you nothing
whatsoever except the truth about numbers the game had been keeping from you.

A season only counts if you come out of it with a tan worth having and skin you
have not wrecked. Sitting ninety days out under an umbrella is not an
achievement, and the game will say so to your face.

Also in the bag

Eight bottles, from a factor 15 bought at a petrol station at 07:40 to something
a pharmacist would raise an eyebrow at. Fourteen swimsuits, none of which protect
you from anything at all. A globe you can spin. A crab.

Works with the Steam Deck

The trackpad aims, the triggers spray and rub, and every menu takes a finger.
Mouse and keyboard on the desktop, full controller support if you would rather.

At the end of the season

A skin risk score, built out of every burn you took. It is a game statistic and
not a medical one. It shows up once, as a percentage, and does not lecture you.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Ride the Wave] When AI becomes the wildest gold rush of the era, you refuse to be a bystander. Build your company from scratch and carve a path through an industry dominated by giants. No magic here—just data, compute, algorithms, and your instincts as a decision-maker.

[From Zero to Foundation Model]

  • The Data War: Scour the globe for high-quality training data and build a moat around your dataset. Exclusive corpora might be the key to a breakout model.

  • Tech Breakthroughs: Invest in R&D to unlock new architectures and optimization techniques. Do you chase extreme inference efficiency, or bet everything on a disruptive structure?

  • Iterative Training: Allocate compute resources, monitor training runs, and fight overfitting & catastrophic forgetting. Every weight update is a high-stakes gamble.

[Monetization & Business Chess] Training a powerful model is only the beginning. You must turn it into real profit:

  • Launch API services and subscription products to win enterprise clients;

  • Weigh the influence of open-sourcing your model against the profits of keeping it proprietary;

  • Navigate volatile market demands, competitor attacks, and sudden ethical controversies.

[Where Strategy Meets Management] This is more than a tycoon sim. Walk the tightrope between long-term tech investment and short-term cash flow. Make critical calls on hiring, fundraising timing, and product launches. Will you become the next industry titan, or collapse when the bubble bursts?

[Infinite Replayability, New Race Every Run] Procedurally generated market trends, tech paths, and competitor strategies ensure no two playthroughs are alike. There is no single formula for victory—only your own legend in the AI business.

Break ore, grow your crew, and turn a magical mine into a lively mining operation!

store_data.about_the_game:
Dodge. Survive. Repeat.

One square. One arena. A flood of projectiles. Dodgeon is an arcade game with a minimalist neon style: no weapons, no frills — your reflexes against the chaos. Only one question matters: how long can you last?

Craft your own challenge

This isn't an "Easy / Hard" menu: you define the challenge. Before every run:

  • Choose a power from 9 — Dash, Teleport, Shield, Slow Time, Decoy, Wall, Prescience… or none, for the purists.

  • Assemble your enemies from 15 types with unique behaviors: trackers, boomerangs, spirals, chargers, ghosts, projectiles that split…

  • Set the pressure: 1 to 3 enemy types for a ranked run, or throw in all 15 for an unmanageable free-for-all.

Same arena, same rules for everyone — the only thing that changes is what you choose to face.

Chase the high score

575 leaderboards, one per enemy set. Every power competes on the same board, so only your survival time decides. Beat your records, grab the bonuses and push the limit, second after second.

The Daily Challenge

Each day, a fixed combination, the same for every player. A new test to take on, a reason to come back.

Features

  • 9 powers and 15 enemy types to mix freely

  • A level playing field: fixed arena, fixed pacing — you pick the enemies

  • A daily challenge every day

  • 575 leaderboards, local and online

  • 42 achievements to unlock

  • Minimalist neon style — clean, sharp, snappy

  • Original soundtrack

  • Full controller support

  • Available in 9 languages

store_data.about_the_game:
PROJECT NEBULA

Blast your way through swarms of enemies, dodge deadly asteroid fields, and battle alien bosses in this fast-paced arcade planet shooter inspired by the golden age of classic space shooters.

Drawing inspiration from genre-defining games like Asteroids and their 90s spiritual successors such as Super Stardust, the game takes the timeless idea of 360-degree arcade space combat and reimagines it for a modern audience with faster action, massive planetary battlefields, spectacular weapons, deeper progression, and relentless enemy encounters.

Every planet is a battlefield. Circle massive worlds, survive increasingly intense enemy waves, collect powerful upgrades, and master an arsenal of devastating weapons in a game built around score chasing, replayability, skillful movement, and explosive arcade action.

Features

  • 100 handcrafted waves packed with non-stop action.

  • 10 unique planets, each with its own enemies, hazards and visual style.

  • More than 10 epic boss battles, each requiring different tactics.

  • Two-player local hot-seat co-op—take turns and compete for the highest score together.

  • Three unique ships, each offering a different playstyle.

  • Eight ship upgrades to improve your combat capabilities.

  • A huge variety of power-ups and weapon upgrades to help you survive overwhelming odds.

  • Choose your preferred controls: Twin-stick, Tank Controls, or Keyboard & Mouse.

  • Classic Mode for a pure retro experience, or Modern Mode featuring power-ups and expanded gameplay mechanics.

  • Continue from the highest level you've reached and keep pushing further.

  • Global online leaderboards to compete with players around the world.

  • A high-energy soundtrack designed to keep the adrenaline pumping. 

Simple to learn, challenging to master, PROJECT NEBULA delivers classic arcade gameplay with modern features, spectacular explosions, and endless score-chasing excitement.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the first howl pierced the sky, this last bastion of human civilization entered its darkest countdown.

*Final Bulwark: Zombie Tide Defense* is a base-building and strategic defense game set against the backdrop of a zombie siege. You are no longer a bystander in the story—you are the commander of this fortress. Every second of the day is precious, and every moment of the night is a matter of life and death. Build, fortify, upgrade, and hold your ground—defend humanity’s right to survive amidst the tidal wave of zombies.

Core Gameplay Features

🧱 Build an Ironclad Defense from Scratch

Don’t let a single piece of wood or steel go to waste. You’ll need to plan your base layout from scratch, constructing walls and watchtowers. Will you build maze-like passages to slow the zombie hordes, or concentrate your resources to create an impenetrable fortress? Your planning determines how long the fortress will hold.

🔥 Build a Deadly Network of Firepower

Unlock and deploy over 10 types of defensive structures: machine gun turrets, laser turrets, electromagnetic pulse cannons, missile turrets… Use blind spots in the terrain to create a crisscrossing network of fire. Watch hordes of zombies turn to ash under a barrage of fire and experience the thrill of tower defense where strategy meets pure excitement.

⏳ The Cycle of Life and Death Through Day and Night

At daybreak, the zombies weaken, and you become the producer—build watchtowers to capture resource facilities and gather as many resources as possible.

When night falls, the zombies grow stronger, and you become the guardian—the hordes will emerge in full force under the cover of darkness. Allocate the resources you acquired during the day wisely to protect your last beacon of light in the darkness.

🧬 Face an Ever-Evolving Terror

Zombies aren’t static targets. As defense waves progress, you’ll encounter massive mutant zombies, self-destructing mutants, and the Zombie Doctor, who wields mysterious powers. Only by continuously upgrading your tech tree and defenses can you survive to see another day in this wasteland.

📈 Every Failure Is a Step Toward Growth

Don’t be afraid to fall. After each defeat, you’ll gain resources to permanently enhance your base’s attributes. Study your enemies’ weaknesses, adjust your deployment strategies, and next time, you’ll hold out even longer.

Why Are We Protecting This Sanctuary?

This isn’t just a base—it’s the last spark of human civilization. Here, every survivor has a name, a story, and a will to live. Every wall you build and every bullet you fire is fighting for humanity’s future.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cry Wolf reinvents the classic Werewolf party game for multiplayer. On small maps where every corner matters, suspicion spreads fast: who's lying, who's manipulating, and who's hiding among you?

How to Play

Each match brings together 6 to 20 players, secretly split between villagers and werewolves. By day, discuss, accuse, and vote. By night, the wolves strike in the shadows. The village must unmask and eliminate every wolf before it's too late but a single surviving wolf is enough to make the other side lose.

Brand-New Roles

Beyond the genre's classic roles, Cry Wolf introduces original mechanics that completely change how you play:

  • Friend / Enemy - designates a player who will die in their place, or vice versa.

  • The Gambler - bets on a player's survival: gain votes if they die, loses votes if they survive.

  • The Detective - discovers who a player voted for, valuable information for cutting through the lies.

A Brand-New Team System

Players no longer face off alone: entire teams can win together by eliminating the opposing side. But watch out if a single werewolf remains alive, they win alone, even against their own team.

Features

  • 6 to 20 players per room

  • Built-in voice chat

  • Multiple playable maps

  • Base roles + brand-new roles (Friend/Enemy, Gambler, Detective...)

  • Customizable skins

Who's lying? Who's playing both sides? Who can you trust when night falls? Join Cry Wolf and find out for yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
MAKE FILTHY CARPETS CLEAN AGAIN

Carpet Daddy is a contract based, first-person carpet cleaning simulator about taking properly filthy spaces and making them look right again.

Turn up to a job, assess the mess, move furniture out of the way and get to work. Cleaning isn't a one-tool job: different types of dirt and stains need different treatment, and getting a great result means using the right tools in the right order.

USE THE RIGHT TOOL FOR THE JOB

Build your cleaning process around a set of professional carpet-cleaning tools.

  • Vacuum loose debris before getting into the deeper clean.

  • Pre-spray dirty carpet to prepare it for extraction.

  • Agitate the carpet fibres to work treatment into stubborn dirt.

  • Spot-treat stains that need some extra attention.

  • Extract the dirt and solution from the carpet and reveal the clean surface underneath.

Different messes respond differently to each stage, so simply running the extractor over everything isn't always enough.

WORK THE WHOLE ROOM

The dirt doesn't conveniently stop at the edge of the sofa.

Move furniture out of your way, get into awkward areas and work across the room until the entire carpet is properly clean. Watch dirt, stains and grime disappear as you work, with each pass leaving a visible difference behind.

TAKE ON CLEANING CONTRACTS

Head out to cleaning jobs ranging from everyday rooms to much larger spaces, each with its own layout, mess and challenges.

Complete the work, earn your payment and reviews, then return to your workshop and get ready for the next job.

BUILT AROUND THE SATISFACTION OF CLEANING

Carpet Daddy is all about the process: finding the dirty bits, choosing how to tackle them, hearing and seeing your tools at work, and finally looking back at a carpet that is completely different from the one you started with.

No complicated story to keep track of. Just dirty carpets and the deeply satisfying job of cleaning them.

Timeline:

Hi everyone! I am looking to get a demo submitted to Steam Next Fest this October! The base mechanics of the game are done, I just need to start blasting assets out of Blender to create more contracts. I am hoping to release this mid-December if all goes well! Make sure to take a look at our TikTok page where we post development updates reguarly!

store_data.about_the_game:
EVERY SONG BEGINS WITH SOMEONE WORTH HEARING.

You are a travelling bard arriving in communities that have forgotten how to sing. Listen to the people who live there, learn the melodies bound up in their work, grief, history and hope, then carry their stories onward in your songbook.

LISTEN

Meet 24 townsfolk across six distinct regions. Return after performances to see relationships change, complete commissioned shows and earn each community’s trust.

ARRANGE

PERFORM

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

Solo Tower Defense VR is a single-player VR tower defense shooter where you warp between two lanes and personally take down incoming enemies.

Shoot down enemies advancing from both lanes and protect the gate behind you.
Unlike traditional tower defense games where you place units and watch them fight, you stand on the front line and do the fighting yourself.

Grow Stronger Between Waves

Combat progresses in waves.
After clearing a wave, you can choose an upgrade card to improve stats such as attack power, fire rate, projectile speed, range, and gate durability.

The upgrades you choose will affect how you approach the battles ahead.

Face a Variety of Enemies

You will encounter more than just standard ground enemies. Different enemy types include ranged attackers, shielded enemies, self-destructing enemies, flying enemies, and enemies that deploy special units.

As the waves progress, enemy combinations and attacks become increasingly intense, requiring quick decisions and accurate shooting.

Designed for Comfortable VR Play

The game is designed with seated play and reduced motion sickness in mind.

Instead of moving freely through the environment, you switch between two lanes by warping.

By keeping movement simple, the game is easier to play while seated and lets you focus on the fast-paced action of aiming and shooting directly with your VR controllers.

Fight Alongside Your Operator

Between waves, your operator will provide advice and guidance.

Prepare for the next wave, choose your upgrades, and keep defending until the very end.

store_data.about_the_game:
POINT CLOUDS HAVE INVADED YOUR FAVORITE PIXEL ART APP!!

A tower defense living inside a retro app. No towers. No units (except in some DLCs). No hero.

A pencil.

Your upgrades are cards. Your loadout is a deck. The order you weave them is your build. Re-tracing a path over a card levels it up. And everything is shareable as a file: your base (.dvp), your build (.dvpm), your run GIF, your map PNG, all signed with your nickname. Trade builds like decklists.

The mass is coming: tens of thousands, then hundreds of thousands, then ONE TRILLION dots (on the counter) simulated on your GPU. They flow like a fluid, hug your walls, pour through every gap, pile up… and where the pressure builds, your pixels break one by one.

🖊 DRAW. The interface is an old-school paint app: pencil, line, eraser, brush sizes. Every painted pixel is a wall. Every erased pixel is a breach. Thick walls get chewed layer by layer. Thickness is strength.

🌊 RESIST. The swarm is a real pressurized fluid: it paths to your core, flanks, seeps, overflows. Erase two pixels of a besieged wall and watch the torrent rush in. Repair during the pause. Hold the wave. Then the next, bigger one.

⚡ BREAK THE GAME. Between runs, expand your territory across an unlock graph. Not a tree: a map. Every node is paid by tracing a PATH from your territory, and you acquire the whole path. Two players aiming for the same power will never have the same build. Find the broken routes: they're there on purpose.

🎵 THE MUSIC IS GENERATED. Seeded procedural chiptune: every run gets its own track (seed displayed), escalating as the wave hits. Your actions play notes. A breach has a sound. So does your core dying.

Features

  • Up to 1,000,000,000,000 dots on the counter (1,000,000 GPU-simulated in real time)

  • One verb: draw. Pencil, line, eraser. That's all, and it's enough.

  • Defense mode: escalating waves, matter economy, repairs under fire

  • Sandbox mode: threat tiers T1 → T5 "MEGA SATURATED", 60-second stress test

  • Roguelite meta: path-based unlock graph. Different routes, different builds.

  • Seeded generative chiptune + reactive stingers

  • Aesthetic: two primitives. ■ vs · . Nothing on screen but the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Whodunit Sudoku is a logic puzzle where each case is a grid-based crime scene. Your goal is to place every suspect and identify the killer through strict logical deduction.

Grid Placement The crime scene is divided into a grid. Place all suspects following Sudoku rules: each row and each column can contain only one suspect.

The Crime Scene Each grid contains rooms, furniture, walls, and open spaces. Rooms are bounded by walls or doorways. Only empty floor tiles are valid positions for suspects.

Clues Written clues describe spatial relationships between suspects and the environment. These include directional clues, proximity clues, relative position clues, and boundary clues. Every clue must be satisfied by the final arrangement.

Once all suspects are placed, the killer is the one left alone in the same room as the victim.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ever played an RPG and wished the girls got VISIBLY MUSCULAR as they level up?

This is that game.

I love JRPGs with cute girls and would dream about a game that would dare to make them look muscular as they grow stronger. When a girl is level 99 but still looks the same as she did at level 1... it never sat right with me. That's why I made this game.

Muscle is the love language.

You wash ashore in Valdheim with no memory and an amulet that will not stop humming. The girl who pulls you off the tideline is a princess in hiding; the kingdom that should be hers belongs to five hungry jarls. What you have to offer her cause is stranger than any army: a bond that makes the women who fight beside you grow visibly, permanently stronger and muscular.

FIGHT

Classic turn-based tactics: weapon triangle, terrain, class abilities, and 19 distinct classes. Position carefully, strike decisively. As your girls level up they grow muscles, even in mid-battle!

BUILD

Between battles, run the village week by week. Construct and upgrade buildings, and most importantly: date the girls. As your bonds strengthen, so do their muscles.

BOND

Eighteen girls, each with her own story arc, dates, birthday, and voice. Spend your weekends wisely: time together restores motivation, deepens trust, and unlocks the moments that change everything.

GROW

This is a game about strength you can see. As bonds deepen, each girl grows muscles reflected in her battle sprite, her portraits, and her story. The power fantasy isn't yours. It's hers. You're the reason it happens.

  • 25-chapter story campaign

  • Classic Tactics RPG gameplay

  • 18 girls girls with full personal story arcs: Romance them all in a single play through!

  • 19 classes with unique abilities and passives

  • Village management: building, training, arena, and shops!

  • Fully voiced dialogue

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

TinSpring Soccer is a faithful simulation of the tin-and-spring table game

you grew up playing — rebuilt from the rods up, with real material physics

instead of one generic pitch.

TEN BOARDS, TEN DIFFERENT GAMES

Every board is a different physical surface, not a different coat of

paint. A pre-war tinplate table drags and rebounds dully. A varnished ~1962

plywood table rolls far but rebounds soft. A century-old warped oak table

drifts the ball sideways on a long shot, so the same strike never lands in

the same place twice. A 2026 tournament board with a digital scoreboard is

the fastest and most predictable surface in the game. Ten boards, ten

distinct feels, one set of rules.

AN OPPONENT THAT PLAYS LIKE SOMEONE, NOT SOMETHING

The computer opponent's skill follows the strength of the team you're

facing — and so does its behaviour. Weak teams hesitate, shift their aim,

and visibly search for an opening before they strike. Strong teams commit

fast and don't second-guess themselves. You're not playing against a

difficulty slider; you're playing against something that feels like it's

deciding.

CHAMPIONSHIPS TO WIN

Take your national team through a full European Championship or World Cup,

group stage through to the final, against a real field of nations.

FOUR PLAYERS, ONE TABLE

Play locally with up to four players, taking turns on the same board — no

accounts, no lobbies, just pass the controller.

BUILT FROM CODE, NOT FROM A LIBRARY

Every board, every figure, every stitch of kit, every sound in this game

is generated procedurally — there isn't a single imported 3D model,

texture, or audio file in it.

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE

22 languages, including full native support for Simplified Chinese,

Japanese and Korean — not machine-translated filler, and not a font that

falls back to boxes when it hits a character it doesn't know.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Adjustable text size, a reduced-motion mode, and a high-contrast mode are

built in from the start, not bolted on afterwards.

COMING SOON

TinSpring Soccer is still in development. What you'll find here are real

screenshots — and, if included, a trailer — captured directly from the

running game, not concept art. There's no playable demo yet, and details

may still change before release. Wishlist to follow along.

About This Game

TinSpring Soccer is a faithful simulation of the tin-and-spring table game

you grew up playing — rebuilt from the rods up, with real material physics

instead of one generic pitch.

TEN BOARDS, TEN DIFFERENT GAMES

Every board is a different physical surface, not a different coat of

paint. A pre-war tinplate table drags and rebounds dully. A varnished ~1962

plywood table rolls far but rebounds soft. A century-old warped oak table

drifts the ball sideways on a long shot, so the same strike never lands in

the same place twice. A 2026 tournament board with a digital scoreboard is

the fastest and most predictable surface in the game. Ten boards, ten

distinct feels, one set of rules.

AN OPPONENT THAT PLAYS LIKE SOMEONE, NOT SOMETHING

The computer opponent's skill follows the strength of the team you're

facing — and so does its behaviour. Weak teams hesitate, shift their aim,

and visibly search for an opening before they strike. Strong teams commit

fast and don't second-guess themselves. You're not playing against a

difficulty slider; you're playing against something that feels like it's

deciding.

CHAMPIONSHIPS TO WIN

Take your national team through a full European Championship or World Cup,

group stage through to the final, against a real field of nations.

FOUR PLAYERS, ONE TABLE

Play locally with up to four players, taking turns on the same board — no

accounts, no lobbies, just pass the controller.

BUILT FROM CODE, NOT FROM A LIBRARY

Every board, every figure, every stitch of kit, every sound in this game

is generated procedurally — there isn't a single imported 3D model,

texture, or audio file in it.

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE

22 languages, including full native support for Simplified Chinese,

Japanese and Korean — not machine-translated filler, and not a font that

falls back to boxes when it hits a character it doesn't know.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Adjustable text size, a reduced-motion mode, and a high-contrast mode are

built in from the start, not bolted on afterwards.

COMING SOON

TinSpring Soccer is still in development. What you'll find here are real

screenshots — and, if included, a trailer — captured directly from the

running game, not concept art. There's no playable demo yet, and details

may still change before release. Wishlist to follow along.
store_data.short_description: TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person, full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Once upon a time there was a peaceful village of farmers...

And it was peaceful until a rageful salty wizard, Lord Blurcoal, decided to place a huge, rotten and bad smelling cake in the middle of it!

Now the farmers are in trouble and only a heroic mouse can help them.

A mouse called: Unpredictable...

Unpredictable Cake is a colorful 3D platform game full of strange characters and weird conversations.

Help Unpredictable to complete his quest and save the village, jumping, dodging and avoiding all the enemies and obstacles that will appear on his path!

Inside the game you will find:

Levels to complete

Boss battles to win

Collectables to collect

A very important mission

Strange faces

A giant mouse

A bearded man

Lots of rotten cakes

And much more!

Choose the camera view you prefer: side view, back view or rotate it freely.

Test your skill and complete the game to unlock The Gallery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Winters at Silky Peak is a cozy tourist-office simulator set in a tiny mountain village: listen to each traveler, work out what would actually make them happy, and send them off on the perfect day out.


Meet travelers and get to know them! You'll learn more about each of them and try to work out which activities would best suit their trip. Do they have kids with them? Are they looking for adventure? Everyone has their own preferences, and it's up to you to satisfy them!

Silky Peak has plenty of surprises in store! Use the map to find the best activities to recommend. A single place can offer several activities, but watch out, they come with constraints. Some aren't open all day, while others can be victims of their own success... Choose carefully the order in which you recommend them, so you can put together the best possible experience.

A well-planned trip makes for a happy traveler! Collect positive reviews and watch your chalet grow. Who knows, maybe your seasonal job will have a bigger impact on this little mountain village than you think!

Features

  • Meet all kinds of travelers and get to know them

  • Pick activities on the map, keeping their constraints in mind

  • Discover new places and activities to build the ideal trip

  • Collect satisfied customers to improve your workplace

  • Take the time to unwind. Welcome to Silky Peak!

store_data.about_the_game:
(This game is a work in progress that planning and development started on July 31st, 2026)

An intense, open-world tale of high-seas trading, naval warfare, and tactical survival.

Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly. Risk other dangerous factions as well, from the Faithful, a radical religious group spreading fanatical zeal across the world, to a tyrant King who unleashes his royal fleet on anyone entering his waters, every faction poses a deadly threat.

Choose your protagonist, build a loyal crew, and fight to survive and claim the ocean's riches. Can you avenge your parents deaths?

Key Features:

  • Tactical Grid-Based Naval AI: Enemy fleets don't just chase; they calculate. Powered by an intelligent spatial grid system, opposing captains evaluate the battlefield like a chess match, utilizing dynamic pathfinding and real-time rerouting to flank your ship and take you down.

  • Skill-Driven Boarding Battles: Leave victory to your battle command, not random chance algorithms. When cannon fire gives way to boarding actions, transition directly into tactical RPG combat where character builds, party strategy, and combat preparation determine who holds the deck.

  • Dynamic World Economy: Supply and demand respond directly to your actions. Flood a port with rare spices or drain a city’s raw materials, and watch global market prices fluctuate dynamically across every trade hub.

  • Vast Open-World Exploration: Chart unknown waters, barter with distant coastal towns, utilize land resources, and search the globe for specialized crew members whose trust you must earn.

  • Choose Your Path: Play as either a male or female protagonist, each carrying their own stakes into the battle against tyranny.

  • Ultra-Responsive Engine Performance: Built with zero bloated third-party dependencies, experience instantaneous map transitions, seamless audio playback, and fluid frame rates without loading hitches or stutter.

  • Original Musical Score: Fully original songs created by the amazing and talented Anthony Fusilier that bring depth and emotion to every scene.
store_data.detailed_description:
Freebies

Every Water's Bounty game comes with free Windows Icons using characters from the game, including different factions of ships, and a video thank you from the solo Dev himself. 


TBD Game Release Date

Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios only just started on this game on July 31st, 2026. We will need some time to get this game fully ready, but we have already within a week made a large step into getting the game's systems setup and running. 

- Enemy AI system is setup and ready to go for up to a 2 block radius, we're shooting for 3 to 4 however
- Economy generator that changes pricing depending on supply and demand is fully setup
- Land resource collection is setup
- Boarding parties in ship battles are setup
- Intro movie and trailer for Steam page - done
- Ship deck for a two mast ship and all pixel art - done
- Calculations for the enemy's ship's hull vs party size in boarding fight - done
- Calculations for the player's ship's hull vs starting HP in boarding fight - done
- Night and day cycles setup as well as a day tracker to track the economy - done
- Ship navigation and controls - done
- Flawless from ship to deck transfers - done

As you can see, I've been busy and moving fast. But, I still have a large world to create once the game's systems are finished being created. After that, I have to place the storyline inside of this sandbox world. So give me some time to get this all put together, and get excited. It's been a long time since a trading and naval battle pixel art game this well done has been made.

store_data.about_the_game:
Go My Pretties is a game about commanding a small army of cute robots. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons to collect resources, craft upgrades and get stronger.

Combat

Go My Pretties is a third person strategy game. In battle, you can choose which enemies your units engage with. Each enemy is countered by a specific unit, so choose your matchups wisely. You can also use Ground Target Mode to command units to a specific location - useful for flanking foes or keeping units away from danger. 

You'll need to give each type of unit different commands to make the most of them in battle. There are 6 types of vehicles that Ninabots can pilot, each of which have their own strengths and weaknesses.

You'll have some weapons of your own at your disposal too. Nina's Mech Walker can be customised with a left and right weapon. There are a total of 6 types of weapons to acquire in the game, which can each be upgraded to pack more of a punch.

Story

Nina is a scrapper, who flies to unexplored islands to harvest scrap. On islands like these, you are bound to find Flan. Flan are a mysterious type of creature which can repair old vehicles and use them offensively.

As soon as Nina and the Ninabots arrived at this archipelago however, something went wrong, and now the Ninabots are missing! Nina will have to rescue the Ninabots that are scattered around the islands so that all 30 of them are reunited.

Ninabots

Ninabots are the backbone of your army, so make sure they're well looked after. Grow food to keep them well fed and hose them down occasionally to clean them. Don't stay out in the dungeon past their bedtime, and give them some toys to play with. Don't push them too hard, or they might get upset.

Every Ninabot is a named character. Rescue them all to discover their unique personalities!

store_data.about_the_game:
ENTER AN ENDLESS, UNBOUNDED BULLET HELL

XenoVector is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell roguelike set across a procedural world with no boundaries and no final wave. Follow mission signals, destroy escalating enemy formations, defeat powerful bosses and transform their relics into a devastating combat build.

Choose from three distinct pilot ships: the resilient Aegis, high-speed Interceptor, or weapon-focused Striker. Unlock five evolving weapon systems, upgrade them through ten increasingly powerful tiers, and master a charged secondary attack for every armament.

The longer you survive, the more dangerous the universe becomes. Procedural bosses combine different chassis, movement styles, weapons, cores, and attack patterns. Beyond them wait six families of massive multipart Apex Colossi, each with unique mechanics, destructible systems and escalating phases.

There is no finish line. Build your arsenal, cross the horizon and see how far you can survive.

KEY FEATURES

  • An endless procedural world – Travel freely through 12 distinct terrain ecologies and continuously escalating danger.

  • Three unique pilot ships – Choose a resilient, high-speed, or weapon-focused hull, each with its own statistics and kill-charged ultimate ability.

  • Five evolving weapon systems – Unlock and upgrade every weapon through ten tiers, with increasingly powerful effects and a unique charged secondary attack.

  • 35 hostile enemy types – Face increasingly dangerous formations, elite variants, mission encounters and late-run threats.

  • Procedurally assembled bosses – Boss encounters combine independent chassis, movement, weapon, core, palette and attack-pattern traits.

  • Six Apex Colossus families – Destroy multipart Fortresses, Serpents, Lattices, Motherships, Black Holes, and Prismatic Crystals before attacking their exposed cores.

  • Run-defining progression – Collect permanent weapon relics and shield upgrades during each run, alongside rare temporary combat boosts.

  • High-impact combat abilities – Boost through danger with brief invulnerability, launch homing missiles, deploy proximity bombs, charge secondary attacks, and unleash ship-specific ultimates.

  • Unbounded difficulty scaling – Enemy power, formations, missions, bosses, and scoring continue escalating beyond maximum weapon tiers.
