BUILD A UNIVERSE THAT FIGHTS FOR YOU

Draft mortals at the altar, seat them where they fight best, and turn the age to transform your whole board — same souls, new bodies, bigger problems.

EVERY GOD PLAYS BY DIFFERENT LAWS

Take offerings from stranger gods, bend the rules of your own reality, and chase combos that cascade — one trigger feeding the next until the chain counter loses count.

SIEGE THE GODS NEXT DOOR

Every enemy board was built by a real player's run. Their universe meets yours at the seam — walls, wolves, drums, and all.

FROM MUD TO ASH

Five ages of growth in every run. Start with six slots of dirt-eating idiots; end commanding a pantheon that breaks its own physics.

store_data.about_the_game:
Skeleton Legends

Skeleton Legends is a casual vertical idle auto‑battler tower‑defense game. Easy to pick up, it lets you enjoy satisfying monster‑slaying combat without complicated operations.

Step into a fantastic adventure world and summon a wide roster of unique heroes. Barbarians, evil spirits, sorceresses, little dragons and more each come with distinctive damage‑dealing and crowd‑control abilities. Spend diamonds in‑battle to refresh the hero shop, build custom line‑ups to set up your defenses, and fend off endless waves of skeletons and demonic foes. Clear ten waves of trials to earn generous stage rewards.

Your adventure never grows dull. Main story stages unlock progressively starting from basic 1‑2 dungeons. Additional game modes including tower climbing, wish pools and daily quests become available as you advance. Collect heroes, unlock relic and insignia systems to boost your team’s attack and defense stats. Complete collection sets to gain permanent buffs.

The game is entirely free‑to‑play. In Early Access, we will keep iterating and optimizing. We gather feedback from players and plan to add new content in phases, such as roguelite random dungeons, collection galleries, multiplayer team modes, alongside new monsters, heroes and levels. Witness the game improve step‑by‑step, and grow stronger effortlessly even during short breaks

store_data.about_the_game:
Solve puzzles with your friends and clear the stages together.

[Carriers Together] is a 2–6 player cooperative puzzle game.
Work together to solve puzzles that would be difficult to overcome alone.
Pick up and carry your friends to where they need to be, or coordinate your movements and timing to create a path forward.
Sometimes, one player may have to take a risk so that everyone else can move forward.

· Cooperative Gameplay with Friends
Work together to solve puzzles where everyone has an important role to play.
Communicating where and when each player should move is the key to success.

· A Variety of Puzzles and interactive elements
Use buttons, mechanisms, moving platforms, and other interactive elements to overcome each stage.
As you progress, you'll need to work together more closely to solve increasingly challenging puzzles.

· The Ultimate Friendship Wrecker
Things don't always go according to plan—and that's part of the fun.
You might throw a friend in the wrong direction, miss the right timing, or simply end up laughing at each other's mistakes.
Put your heads together and work your way through the puzzles.
And most importantly, see if you can make it to the end with everyone still safe!

store_data.about_the_game:
Fidget Toy Engine brings a collection of interactive toys directly to your desktop. Open a compact transparent window, choose a toy, and keep a satisfying little distraction within reach while you work, study, chat, or take a break.

DISCOVER A VARIETY OF TOYS

Spin a fidget spinner or shuriken, squish slime, tap the keys on a mini keyboard, roll dice, fire a slingshot, send a roulette ball around the wheel, watch a DVD logo bounce, and discover much more. Every toy has its own way to move, react, or play.

Fidget Toy Engine is designed to keep growing, with more toys planned for future updates.

MAKE IT YOURS

Save your favorites or let Random choose for you. Resize the app, adjust volume and brightness, and recolor selected toys with custom colors and metallic finishes.

BUILT FOR YOUR DESKTOP

Place the transparent window wherever it works best for you. Keep it above other apps, minimize it to the system tray, or have it launch automatically when your computer starts. Stereo sound subtly shifts with the window's position across your desktop,

COMFORTABLE TO USE

Choose a dark or light theme, enlarge interface text, and tune frame rate, anti-aliasing, and shadow quality for your setup. The interface supports ten languages.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Steam achievements mark playful milestones, while Steam Cloud keeps supported preferences in sync. There is no fixed way to play—play with a toy for a few seconds or leave one beside you for longer.

store_data.about_the_game:
《This Is Not My Beloved Concubine》is a simulation game combining court inquisition, identity verification, and character interaction.

The story takes place in a fictional empire built around a vast inland sea, composed of twelve kingdoms, duchies, city-states, and autonomous territories. During the reign of the old emperor, the empire's unity was maintained through military power and political prestige. After the old emperor's death, the young you inherit the throne.

Each of the twelve kingdoms sends an adult royal woman or a high-ranking noblewoman.

🔍 Observe carefully and find the flaws in the disguise

To impersonate the real concubine, assassins will study the target's information in advance and receive targeted training.

  • 👁 Appearance: Face shape, hairstyle, eyes, skin tone, etc.

  • 👗 Dress: Clothing, jewelry, accessories, and the style of the country of origin

  • 📏 Physical Characteristics: Height, build, and personal features

  • 🗣 Voice and Accent: Language habits, pronunciation, and speaking style

  • 💃 Behavioral Habits: Actions, etiquette, posture, and walking style

  • 📖 Personal Experience: Family, hometown, experiences, and details known only to herself

Sometimes, a tiny mistake is enough to expose her true identity.

🌙 The King Personally Investigates

After the assassination attempt, you issued a secret decree:

Any woman entering the Emperor's private bedchamber at night, regardless of her identity documents, must be ultimately verified by the Emperor himself.

Some secrets can only be discovered up close, and the complete files of the concubines can only be viewed by the King himself.

🎮 Game Loop

Select difficulty → Multiple women enter in turn → Review files → Personally observe and verify → Determine authenticity → Deal with the assassin → Safely spend the night with the true concubine → Unlock character content → Proceed to the next night.

📈 The further you go, the harder it is to believe your eyes.

The game offers different difficulty levels.

Difficulty affects:

  • Number of female characters

  • Number of assassins

  • Degree of disguise

  • Completeness of information

  • Degree of concealment of identity clues

Observation and reasoning required for judgment

As the challenge progresses, you'll need to remember more and more character traits. The real challenge isn't remembering the twelve concubines.

But when an almost perfect "she" stands before you—Can you believe she really is her?

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Harvest Story is a casual strategy game that blends merge mechanics with survival management. On the surface, you're just dragging ingredients together on a small platform to craft fancier dishes and sell them for cash. Underneath, you're racing the clock—the landlord comes knocking every 7 days, and rent only climbs higher. The longer you want to last, the more carefully you need to plan every inch of platform space and every coin you earn.

🍳 Merge Your Way Through 200 Dishes

Start with basic crops and proteins, merge them into simple dishes, then advanced ones, and finally elaborate premium creations. The same ingredients combined in a different order can lead down an entirely different recipe tree—every run is a fresh planning puzzle.

🤖 Stop Doing Everything Yourself—Hire Robots

Five types of robots, each with their own job: auto-crafting, daily coin income, spawning more robots, tagging your priciest item for a bonus sale, and delivering fresh ingredients straight to your platform. Which ones do you invest in, when, and how many—to squeeze out the most value before rent comes due?

🧪 A Tech Tree for Going Further Next Time

Every run converts your days survived and total sales into tech points, which carry over permanently between runs. Spend them to unlock a bigger shelf, a larger crafting platform, a higher robot cap, and more—today's failure is tomorrow's comeback fund.

🏆 Chase Your Own High Score

A persistent leaderboard always reminds you how many days you lasted and how much you earned last time—every new run, you'll want to push just a little further.

Underneath the cozy farm aesthetic lies a survival challenge that demands careful planning. Can you survive the landlord's next visit?

A persistent leaderboard always reminds you how many days you lasted and how much you earned last time—every new run, you'll want to push just a little further.

store_data.about_the_game:
MOTORGRAVE: Wasteland Horde

MOTORGRAVE: Wasteland Horde is a top-down vehicular action game where your vehicle is your weapon, your armor, and your only chance of survival.

Enter an endless desert wasteland overrun by increasingly massive zombie hordes. Crush the undead beneath your wheels, tear through them with mounted guns, flamethrowers, missiles, saw blades, drones, and brutal ramming weapons. Collect salvage, survive escalating waves, defeat powerful bosses, and transform a battered vehicle into an unstoppable mobile fortress.

Death ends the run—but not your progress. Return to the upgrade garage, spend your recovered coins and gems, unlock stronger vehicles, and permanently expand your arsenal. Every new vehicle inherits the weapons and technology earned before it while unlocking new upgrade paths of its own.

How long can your war machine survive the horde?


Different powerups

Upgrade your vehicle

Key Features

  • Endless escalating warfare
    Zombie waves never stop. Enemy numbers, strength, variants, and boss encounters continue growing as long as you survive.

  • Vehicular combat
    Drift through hordes, perform devastating roadkills, and destroy zombies using ram spikes, powered saws, armor plating, and reinforced chassis upgrades.

  • Expanding weapon arsenal
    Equip machine guns, flamethrowers, missile launchers, heavy cannons, mortars, Tesla weapons, and other destructive systems.

  • Combat drones
    Deploy gun, flamethrower, missile, and support drones that orbit your vehicle and attack surrounding enemies.

  • Permanent incremental progression
    Spend recovered coins and gems in an extensive upgrade tree. Purchased technology carries forward to later vehicles, allowing your arsenal to grow throughout the entire game.

  • Five evolving vehicles
    Progress from the agile Road Hog to the heavily fortified Diesel, with each vehicle introducing new weapons, defensive systems, and upgrade branches.

  • Temporary run powers
    Adapt during each run with abilities such as chain lightning, fire trails, force fields, mines, repair drones, shockwaves, and other powerful modules.

  • Fuel and survival management
    Balance aggression with fuel consumption, improve tank capacity and efficiency, and unlock rare methods of recovering fuel during extended runs.

  • Diverse undead hordes
    Fight numerous zombie variants, wasteland mutants, armored enemies, fast attackers, elite threats, and powerful bosses.

  • A handcrafted wasteland
    Drive freely through a large post-apocalyptic environment filled with ruined structures, industrial wreckage, hostile terrain, and Mad Max-inspired atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yin‑Yang Mirror is an independently developed horror puzzle game rooted in Chinese folk customs and Taoist esoteric arts.

Background

All eerie incidents in this game originate from photographs — yet there is far more beneath the surface.

Drawing from traditional Chinese folklore and Taoist metaphysics, you take on the role of Master Chen, a capable Taoist priest. Employ ancient ritual arts, you uncover supernatural anomalies hidden within images.

Gameplay

Use the Yin‑Yang Mirror, Whisper‑Talisman, Heavenly Peng Seal, coffin nails, mountain‑ghost cash coins, Five‑Thunder Token and more, alongside a variety of Taoist rituals.

Pierce layers of illusions, subdue malevolent spirits and deliver wandering souls to peace. You must guard your sanity at all times, or you will fall prey to the phantom realm and become its next victim.

Story

Mysterious symbols materialize out of nowhere on photographs.

In the dead of night, a pair of pale hands deliver a pitch‑black photo.

While you dream, uncanny giggles echo in your ears.

One bizarre event unfolds after another. Will you lend your wit and courage to Master Chen, and unearth the truth buried behind all these appearances?

If you are a fan of Chinese rural folk horror and eerie mystery tales, add this game to your wishlist to follow future development and release updates.

REPLICANT is a narrative-driven cyberpunk adventure set in a dark future of neon streets, powerful corporations, and artificial humans hiding in plain sight.

Detective Kohen Webb is assigned a confidential investigation: track down four rogue replicants who have illegally made their way to Earth. But finding them won’t be easy. They look human, act human, and have spent months disappearing into the sprawling streets of NeoYork.

Investigate crime scenes, uncover clues, interview suspects, and follow the trail through the city’s neon-soaked underworld. Solve classic point-and-click inventory puzzles, crack environmental challenges, and use what you discover to piece together the truth.

When conventional methods fail, jack into a cyberpunk-inspired card game where hackers, viruses, firewalls, and rogue programs battle for control of the network.

Features:

  • A narrative-driven cyberpunk thriller

  • Investigate crime scenes and uncover hidden clues

  • Interview suspects and decide who to trust

  • Classic point-and-click inventory puzzles

  • A unique cyberpunk card-game hacking system

  • Explore the dark streets and seedy underworld of NeoYork

  • Track down four rogue replicants — and uncover the truth behind their arrival on Earth

store_data.about_the_game:
The First-Ever Mochiwasabi Game!

Mochi, the youngest of the cats, hops aboard a robot vacuum and sets off on a cleaning adventure!

Race through the room, dodge obstacles, suck up trash, and aim for 100% cleaning completion!

Clean the Room with Mochi!

All you need is the Space key!

The robot vacuum moves automatically, so just press Space to jump whenever an obstacle gets in your way!

Dodge obstacles while sucking up all the trash scattered around the room.

Collect enough trash to reach 100% and complete the cleaning!

With its simple controls and short playtime, this side-scrolling game is easy to pick up and enjoy, even if you don't usually play games.

🐱 Tons of Brand-New Animations!

The cats of “Mochiwasabi” are as carefree as ever, even inside the game!

Enjoy multiple brand-new animations created especially for the game!

Watch the cats run around, play, relax, and more as you make your way through the room.

🔊 Featuring the Real Cats' Meows!

The game's click sounds feature real meows recorded from the actual cats!

Press the buttons to hear the voices of Mochi, Chikuwa, Warabi, and Satsuma.

And for anyone who just wants to hear lots and lots of cat meows, there's even a special button you can mash as much as you like!

Enjoy plenty of adorable real-life meows while you play!

🏆 Chase a High Score in Endless Mode!

In addition to the standard mode, where your goal is to reach 100% cleaning completion, the game also features an Endless Mode where you can see how high you can score!

Dodge obstacles, suck up trash, and aim for a new high score!

store_data.about_the_game:
Illusion Remix is an audio-reactive visual creation sandbox where you design optical illusions, animate them, and decide exactly how your music controls them. Start instantly with handcrafted presets or dive deep into customization to make something entirely your own.

Pick from a growing library of handcrafted patterns and presets to get something striking on screen in seconds. Then customize colors, geometry, motion, effects, speed, and pattern-specific controls to shape the visual your way.

Map the music to the parts of the visual you care about. Drive motion, distortion, scale, glow, color, and pattern-specific parameters from different parts of the audio, then tune the strength and smoothness of each reaction.

Use your visuals beyond the editor. Play them full-screen, export videos and images for YouTube, music uploads, streams, and other creative projects, turn them into live wallpapers, and bring your creations into the Museum of Illusions.

Features:

  • Real-time optical illusion editor with deep customization

  • Handcrafted patterns and ready-to-use presets

  • Custom audio-reaction mappings for motion, color, distortion, glow, and more

  • Import your own music or react to desktop audio

  • Fullscreen music visualizer

  • Video, GIF, and image export

  • Live wallpaper export for Wallpaper Engine and Lively

  • Interactive museum where you can display your creations

  • Desktop Companion Mode - Bring Luna to life on your desktop and watch her use your creations!

Illusion Remix will continue to grow with new patterns, presets, polish, and improvements shaped by player feedback.

Fight with heart

  • Pick your colors — choose your team and defend in style

Whether you rush early towers or grow a bustling hillside town first, every run is a race to fortify the plateau before the horns sound again.

Build. Train. Hold the castle.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE HORROR TUTORIAL

A PC. A tutorial. An abandoned hospital. And something that should never have existed there.

You begin in a short, deserted corridor. After only a few steps, you find a computer that is still switched on. It has been waiting for you.

What first appears to be a simple tutorial soon leads you somewhere nothing is as it seems.

A TUTORIAL THAT KNOWS TOO MUCH

The PC guides you through a series of lessons, teaching you step by step what to do.

But with every lesson, something changes.

What begins as a seemingly harmless tutorial eventually leads you into an abandoned hospital that has been sealed off and turned into a quarantine zone. Behind its walls, horrific experiments were carried out — and the traces of what happened are still there.

The further you follow the tutorial, the more questions begin to emerge.

Why is the PC leading you here?

What really happened inside this hospital?

And why does the PC seem to know more about you than it should?

THE LESSONS GET DARKER

What starts as a simple tutorial slowly turns into a nightmare.

The tasks become more disturbing. The environment changes. Sounds appear where no one should be.

And eventually, it becomes clear that you are not simply completing a tutorial.

You are part of something that began long before you arrived.

AN ATMOSPHERE YOU CAN HEAR

The Horror Tutorial places a strong focus on an intense, oppressive atmosphere and immersive 8D audio.

Sounds can come from any direction, making you believe that something is standing right behind you.

Footsteps.

Whispers.

Distant noises.

Something moving when there is nothing there.

We strongly recommend playing with headphones.

EVERY LESSON BRINGS YOU CLOSER TO THE TRUTH

With every completed lesson, you uncover another piece of the story.

But some answers may be better left unknown.

Because deep beneath the surface of the hospital lies a truth that will change everything.

And in the end, you will have to decide how this story ends.

Not every lesson is meant to be completed.

store_data.about_the_game:
UP TO 30 players lobbies. One tower. One sniper. Multiple gamemodes. Build your way to the top, steal the rifle, chair or magic wand and become the player everyone else is trying to take down in a chaotic physics-based multiplayer party game.

GAME MODES


TOWER RUN
Everyone gets their own lane. Build faster than the others, survive the sniper and reach the top first.



JENGA
Protect your own jenga tower over open water while trying to shoot everyone else's apart. Stay out of the water longer than the rest.


Knife Wars
A city full of throwable knives. Blades stick into walls, floors and other blades, letting you build ridiculous improvised staircases wherever you can land them.


SNIPE OR HIDE
One player has the rifle. Everyone else has a brick wall. The sniper slowly destroys the cover layer by layer, and one good shot is enough. After each round the tables turn - hiders become snipers.


CHAIR WARS
Three lives. One chair. A very long drop.


DRAW SPELLS
Cast spells by actually drawing their symbols. There are loads of spells to learn, and the game judges the shape you draw rather than giving you a button to press.


AND MUCH MORE
- We won't spoil that though :)

ENJOY THE CHAOS

store_data.about_the_game:
Minigolf, but nobody plays fair

Sudden Death Golf is a chaotic party minigolf game for up to 12 players. Play locally on one PC or take the fight online with your friends.

Forget politely waiting your turn. Smash their balls, steal the lead, gang up on whoever's winning and use ridiculous powerups to ruin everyone's day.

The goal is still simple: get the ball in the hole. How you get there? That's your problem.

Embrace the chaos

This game ain't fair. That's the point.

With more than a dozen powerups, you can mess with physics, boost yourself, sabotage your opponents or turn an otherwise normal hole into complete nonsense.

And with ball-to-ball collisions enabled by default, every shot can become an opportunity to send your friend's ball flying into the nearest obstacle. Play nice if you want. But nobody else will.

Game Modes

If you're bored of regular golf, let me introduce the following:

  • Elimination mode - Every hole claims a victim. The worst-performing player gets eliminated. Don't be last.

  • Fistfight mode - Now striking an opponent is +1 for you and -1 for them, let's go to war!

  • Beer run - Grab beer powerups to make your screen wobble. The more you drink, the harder it gets to play. What happens off-screen is none of my business :)

Build your own nightmares

Play the included courses, then build your own with the built-in map editor.

Create something clever. Create something competitive.

Or get your friends to each make the most horribly designed map imaginable and combine them into one completely unplayable party course. Your friends will hate you.

That's a feature.

Coming soon to Early Access

Sudden Death Golf is coming soon to Early Access.

Wishlist now and get notified when it's time to gather your friends, pick your targets and completely ruin game night.

store_data.about_the_game:
A block breaker, unfolded in four directions


Every edge of the board is your paddle, and all four move together with the mouse.
Aim, fire, and the spell-ball tears through the walled graveyard maze —
mowing down monsters, cracking headstones — until it swings back out
and you catch it on a paddle. Every catch feeds your mana,
and mana is ammunition for grand magic: meteors, tsunamis, phantom turrets.

Fire. Carom. Catch. The faster that loop spins, the faster the graveyard empties.

Weakness chains blow straight through walls


There are 20 kinds of summoned monster, and each one is weak to fire, water or lightning.
Kill it with that element and the corpse detonates — and anything killed by that blast
with the same weakness detonates in turn. A daisy chain.

The chain ignores walls entirely.
The pack on the far side of the maze dies in the same breath as the one in front of you.
This game exists for the moment a screen-filling horde evaporates off a single hit.
Your ball's element swaps the instant you grab a capsule, so deciding
which colour to set off first is what the clock is really measuring.

The vandalism is the paycheck


Each burial ground is furnished with 24 kinds of destructible — altars, censers,
coffins, headstones. Smashing them raises the landlord's valuation (your score) and
sets off an effect besides. Monsters, monuments — mow it all down.
What to break, and in what order, is part of the read.

Why you are cleaning out a graveyard


A booming castle town, short on housing. The richest landlord in town set his eye
on the last flat ground left: a prime lot packed with several centuries of graves.
The lord of the land approved the redevelopment the same day, without reading past
the tax revenue. The necromancer who keeps the boneyard took it badly and
summoned an army. He is, for the record, the only character here with a
reasonable motive. He also badly overdid it. The overflow went into town —
raiding the market, peering down wells, chewing the laundry.

So the landlord hired you. A troubleshooter with a reputation.

"Kill the monsters, obviously. But while you're in there — and I'm only asking —
the headstones, the coffins, the altars, all of it. Scrap the lot,
so we can lay foundations. I'll pay generously by the pile!"

You left your conscience somewhere. The money is good. Get to work.

Break the summoning circles and the boss comes out


Those glowing sigils on the floor are the necromancer's summoning gates,
and they will keep producing corpses forever. Destroy them all and whoever is in charge
comes out personally. Five bosses are drawn from a roster of ten each run —
you will not see the same lineup twice.

Let them out and the townsfolk suffer


Monsters that reach a gap in the outer wall walk straight into town.
Let too many through and the job fails.
Knowing which exits to hold and which packs to drop first is the whole job.

The schedule is tight


The landlord is an impatient man, and he pays for speed.
Runs are short. If a build stalls, rebuild it and go again.

  • 20 grand magic lines (Lv1–5) — equip four. Meteors, gravity wells, converging shots,
    phantom turrets: a freelancer's accumulated toolkit, and each one rewrites how you attack
  • 10 familiars — take one along; it hurls itself at the nearest monster or gate
  • Burial grounds are generated fresh every run, and grow as you go deeper (16×16 → 28×28)
  • An event after every stage, a shop after every burial ground, permanent upgrades in both

Five burial grounds


From a modest parish plot to the master's own seat. Deeper means grander, and larger.

  • Site One: Whitewall Cemetery
  • Site Two: Redsand Outskirts Cemetery
  • Site Three: Crystal Ossuary
  • Site Four: The Burial Estates
  • Site Five: Verdigris Innermost Tomb

Race the clock


  • Weekly Challenge — everyone runs the same seed. Fastest time wins
  • Steam Leaderboards
  • 20 achievements
  • 7 languages — Japanese, English, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese
  • Full controller support

Grab your tools. It's going to be a messy job.

store_data.about_the_game:
INNER EKO is a dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of.

Enter a strange world somewhere between dream and reality. Traverse dark and submerged environments, meet mysterious beings, jump, fall, and overcome obstacles as you move through this mysterious place.

INNER EKO is designed as a focused experience that can be completed in around 30-60 minutes. There are no filler sections or endless progression, just a short journey through a strange place, built to be experienced from beginning to end.

HANDCRAFTED DREAMLIKE PLACES 

From ancient cisterns, to brutalist towers in hellish atmospheres, every corner is built to evoke a lingering sense of mystery and eerie beauty.

NAVIGATE THE UNKNOWN

Run, jump, and trust your instincts as you carve a path through strange structures, steep drops, and submerged ruins where one wrong step sends you into the void.

MEET MYSTERIOUS BEINGS  

Encounter strange entities lingering in the dark. Listen to their cryptic words, piece together their fragments of thought, and uncover why they remain bound to this world.

FEATURES

• First-person platforming with momentum-based movement
• Explore surreal underground and submerged environments
• Meet mysterious beings and uncover cryptic dialogues
• Traverse environmental obstacles and discover new paths

store_data.about_the_game:
LOSE A HAND: LOSE A FINGER

One of your hands is held flat on the table where everyone can see it, and your five fingers are your entire health bar.

  • Lose, and the dealer takes a finger. 

  • Win, and you will be granted some cash.

BUY ITEMS. USE THEM ON OTHER PLAYERS.

Because where is the fun if you can't mess up with other players?

  • ZIPPO LIGHTER: burn the card an opponent was saving.

  • CURSED RING: push it onto anyone's finger. When that finger goes, someone else bleeds with them.

  • ROMEO'S RING & JULIETTE'S RING: two rings, two people, one shared fate. 

  • THE DUCK: a gift that cannot be sold, cannot be removed, and eats one of their slots forever. You can squeak it, though.

BLACKJACK, WITH EXTRA STEPS

  • THE CAGE: every third round a cage comes down over the table with items to buy. Spend what you won. You will need it.

  • THE PIT: a row of face-up cards in the middle of the table. On your turn you may take one. So may everybody else.

  • THE SLEEVE: a card you keep in your sleeves for whenever the time is right. Assuming nobody burns it first.

Picronix 2 is a simple and relaxing nonogram puzzle game. Solve picture puzzles by filling in the correct cells and revealing hidden pixel images.

With over 100 small and easy-to-play levels, Picronix 2 is perfect for quick sessions or casual play. The puzzles start simple and gradually become more challenging, helping you improve your logic and focus.

Enjoy a clean design, smooth gameplay, and the satisfying feeling of completing each picture. Perfect for both beginners and nonogram fans.

Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image. Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot of unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cyber Video Poker — 38 Machines. Six Bonus Features. A Strategy Trainer That Never Sleeps.


LEARN VIDEO POKER. PLAY EVERY VARIANT. HOLD THE RIGHT CARDS.

Cyber Video Poker is not another casino cash grab. It's the most complete single-player video poker collection ever built for PC — 38 machines, six bonus features, up to 100 hands at once, and a Strategy Advisor that tells you the correct hold on every deal and then grades how you actually played.

Every paytable. Every hold. Every payout. Exactly like the machine on the casino floor, with tools no casino would ever put on the glass. Think of it as a video poker cabinet with an X-ray machine attached — same game, but now you can see what you're doing.

One purchase. Every machine unlocked from minute one. No chip packs, no energy timers, no ads, no internet required. Play ten hands or ten million — same price.

[hr][/hr]

38 MACHINES — THE WHOLE FLOOR, UNLOCKED


Not five machines with a "coming soon" banner. Thirty-eight, playable from the first minute, across every family that matters:

  • Jacks or Better — the benchmark. Full-pay 9/6 plus the 8/5, 7/6 and 7/5 paytables you'll actually meet in the wild, so you can see exactly what a downgraded pay schedule costs you. Tens or Better and All American round out the family.
  • Bonus Poker — the deepest shelf in the collection. Bonus Poker, Prime Bonus, Double Bonus (both 10/7 and 9/8), Twin Bonus, Triple Prestige, Max Aces, Aces & Faces, Dead Man's Hand, Blaze Aces, Royal Aces Bonus, Triple Bonus+, Prime Dual Bonus and Max Twin Bonus — every kicker rule and quad tier, faithfully implemented.
  • Deuces Wild — Full Pay, NSU, Deuces Prestige and Open Deuces. Four wilds, four completely different strategies.
  • Joker Poker — Aces-or-Better and Kings-or-Better, on a 53-card deck with a live wild Joker.

Every machine carries its own real paytable, its own evaluator rules, and its own strategy chart. Switching machines isn't a skin change — it's a different game with different correct plays.

[hr][/hr]

SIX BONUS FEATURES — THE MACHINES YOU CAME TO VEGAS FOR


The feature machines are the ones people queue for on a real floor. All six are here, layered on top of real base paytables, each charging its own premium per hand exactly like the cabinet does:

  • Surge Pay — a multiplier can strike before the cards are even dealt. When it lands, the whole hand pays at that multiple.
  • Dice Roll — roughly one deal in six triggers a full 3D dice cinematic. Two dice tumble, settle, and the total becomes your multiplier for the hand — anywhere from ×2 to a boxcars ×12.
  • Rapid Quads — three of a kind plus two kickers that add up to the trip rank becomes four of a kind. Suddenly a pair of throwaway low cards is the difference between 15 credits and a quad.
  • Echo X — win a hand and you arm a multiplier on every card column. Those multipliers apply to your next round across all hands on screen. Every win feeds the next one.
  • Pyro Spins — trigger the feature and you bank a queue of free games, each carrying its own multiplier. They can retrigger mid-run, and the queue survives a reload, a lobby trip, even closing the game.
  • Vault Pick — the deal stops and the vault opens. Pick one of five sealed tiles and the multiplier behind it rides on the hand about to be dealt.

[hr][/hr]

UP TO 100 HANDS AT ONCE


Play 1, 3, 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 hands on a single deal. Hold your cards once and your decision copies to every hand on the board — then each one draws from its own independent deck, exactly like a real multi-hand cabinet. Ten-Play a full-pay Jacks table, or take 100 hands of Deuces Wild and watch a single held deuce ripple across the whole grid.

Bet 1 to 5 coins per hand. Five coins unlocks the 4,000-credit Royal Flush — the reason anyone plays max bet in the first place.

[hr][/hr]

THE STRATEGY ADVISOR — A TRAINER THAT RUNS ENTIRELY ON YOUR MACHINE


This is what separates Cyber Video Poker from every other video poker game on the store.

Press A and the Advisor opens. It knows the correct play for the machine you're sitting at — not "video poker in general," but that specific paytable — and it shows you before you commit.

  • Stoplight holds. Green halo means hold it. Red means let it go. Yellow means you're holding something the chart wouldn't. Read the lights, make your own call.
  • The reasoning, in plain English. The Advisor names the pattern it found — "four to a flush," "low pair," "three to a royal" — so you learn the hand shapes, not just the answer.
  • Expected value on both plays. After the draw it scores your hold against the optimal one and tells you how close you came. When two holds are genuinely near-identical, it says so.
  • Lifetime accuracy tracking. Every decision is graded and banked, per machine and overall. Watch your accuracy climb from "I think aces are good" to something a pro would recognize. (Auto-played rounds are excluded — the trainer only grades hands you actually decided.)

Turn it on to learn. Turn it off to test yourself. Switch mid-session anytime. It runs 100% offline — nothing is uploaded, nothing phones home.

[hr][/hr]

DOUBLE UP — RIDE IT OR BANK IT


Win a hand and the machine offers you the gamble. One card up for the dealer, four face down for you. Beat the dealer's card and your win doubles. Up to four doublings in a row, with a streak counter tracking how far you've pushed it — and a COLLECT button that's always one click away.

[hr][/hr]

AUTO-PLAY WITH REAL STOP CONDITIONS


Set it running and watch the math work. Choose 10, 25, 50, 100, 250 or 500 rounds. Auto-Play holds by the strategy chart — the same picks the Advisor recommends — so you can watch optimal play unfold over hundreds of hands without clicking once.

Then tell it when to stop: on a bonus trigger, at a win threshold, or after a losing streak. Flip on Turbo and the whole round pipeline speeds up, not just the pauses between deals. It pauses automatically whenever a decision is genuinely yours — a Vault Pick, a Double Up — and hands the machine back.

[hr][/hr]

THE STATS DASHBOARD — YOUR PLAY, MEASURED


Every session is a math experiment. Here's the lab.

  • Overview — lifetime hands, total wagered, total won, biggest single win, royal flushes hit, time played, and your strategy accuracy across every machine.
  • Per Variant — the same breakdown machine by machine, so you can see which paytables you actually play well. Filter to just the ones you've touched.
  • Strategy — your decision accuracy over time, with the hands you got wrong counted honestly.
  • Achievements — all 40, with unlock dates.
  • Favorites — your personal bests on every machine you've sat at.

Every dollar figure is banked in exact cents at the moment of the round, so changing your credit value later never rewrites your history.

[hr][/hr]

YOUR BANKROLL, YOUR STAKES


Set your buy-in anywhere up to $50,000 and pick your credit value from a penny to $5.00. Your bankroll follows you from machine to machine — sit down at Twin Bonus, cash out, walk over to Pyro Spins, keep playing.

Change the credit value and your money is rebased to the exact cent. A $2,279.75 bankroll is still $2,279.75 whether you're playing pennies or five-dollar credits. Run dry and the machine offers you a top-up that keeps every statistic you've built.

Every session ends with a full review — hands played, biggest win, peak balance, hit frequency, profit or loss, all on one screen.

[hr][/hr]

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER


  • Its own sound. Thirty-seven original audio cues recorded for this game and an original soundtrack — not stock library sounds. Card deals, hold clicks, quad stingers, the dice clatter, the vault opening. Separate volume for effects and music, with a one-click reset.
  • Win celebrations that match the moment. Small wins get a clean chime. Big ones get a full-screen callout. A Royal Flush gets the coin shower, the fireworks, and the screen shake it earned.
  • Hover anything, learn something. Every control, cell, chip and machine tile explains itself — what it does, what it costs, what the shortcut key is. Turn tooltips off once you don't need them.
  • A real manual, in the game. Full rules, hand rankings, feature explanations and the complete keyboard reference — no browser tab required.
  • Play it from the keyboard. 1-5 to hold, Enter or Space to deal and draw, D to double, A for the Advisor, P for Auto-Play, C to collect, H and B for hands and bet, S for stats, plus credit-value stepping. Every shortcut documented in-game.
  • Cryptographically secure shuffling. Every deal and every draw comes from a genuinely random source. No seeded patterns, no "streak logic," no thumb on the scale.
  • 40 Steam achievements. From your first royal to a thousand hands on a single machine, chart-perfect streaks, boxcars on the dice, and a few you'll have to find on your own.
  • Persistent save. Close the game, come back tomorrow. Your bankroll, your machine, your stats and even a pending queue of free games are exactly where you left them.

[hr][/hr]

THE WHOLE VIDEO POKER EXPERIENCE, WITHOUT SPENDING A CENT


Learn the difference between 9/6 and 8/5 here, where it costs you nothing. Find out what holding four to a flush over a low pair really does to your bankroll — over ten thousand hands, not ten. Work out which feature machines you enjoy and which ones just eat your premium.

Then sit down at the real cabinet knowing exactly what you're doing. This game pays for itself on your next casino trip.

[hr][/hr]

ONE PRICE. THAT'S IT.


  • Every machine unlocked from minute one — nothing behind a paywall, nothing dripped out over a season pass.
  • No microtransactions. No credit packs, no premium chips, no "buy more coins."
  • No energy bars, no daily limits, no cooldowns. Play ten hands or ten thousand — same price.
  • No ads. No "watch a video to continue," no banners, no popups.
  • No internet required. Everything runs on your machine, including the Advisor. Nothing is uploaded.
  • Resettable virtual balance. Wipe and start over whenever you like, free.

Buy it once. Own it forever. We will never ask you for another cent.

[hr][/hr]

IMPORTANT — ENTERTAINMENT & EDUCATIONAL SIMULATOR — 18+


Cyber Video Poker is a video poker simulator for entertainment and educational purposes only. No real money is wagered, won, or transferred at any point. All credits and currency in the game are entirely virtual and have no real-world value. Success in this simulation does not imply future success at any form of real-money gambling. By purchasing and playing Cyber Video Poker, you confirm that you are 18 years of age or older (or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction). The Strategy Advisor runs entirely on your device, and your saves, statistics and progress are stored locally on your machine; no game data, hand history, or personal information is transmitted off your machine during play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Thirty Days with My First Love Sister is a fully video-based interactive romance game.

Your childhood friend and promised elder sister returns from abroad, staying at your home for a whole month before the new semester begins. Across thirty warm days of living together, you'll experience the sweet daily romance of sharing every moment with your beloved sister.

During the day, freely choose your destination from 10 main scenes — classroom, playground, amusement park, bridal shop, lingerie shop, clothing store, arcade, restaurant, gym, night market, supermarket, water park — and over 30 sub-locations, each with 20~40 AI-generated video scenes.

Every evening, you return home to spend the night with her — late-night chats, playing games together, watching TV, goodnight whispers — and intimate interactions gradually unlock as affection grows.

Every choice changes your stats — money, affection, stamina, intellect — and the total of 30 days determines which ending you reach. Friend, lover, marriage, or a hidden secret branch…

Experience heartfelt romantic moments and pure love in this relaxing journey, and write a love story that belongs only to you.

【Characters】

◆ The Sister (Female Lead)

Your childhood sweetheart and promised fiancée, who has returned from studying abroad and is staying with you before the new semester begins.

Gentle, clever, and caring with a warm sisterly charm — she is excellent at cooking and everyday life.

With her, you share both the familiarity of family and the flutter of new love.

She will be by your side for thirty days — every choice you make will shape how her heart feels about you.

【Features】

• Fully AI-Generated Video Scenes: Over 100 AI-generated video clips stitched into a continuous story — far beyond the static CG count of traditional visual novels

• 30-Day Simulation + Affection System: 4 core stats (money, affection, stamina, intellect) that change in real time and determine your ending

• 10 Main Scenes + 30+ Sub-Locations: Amusement park, bridal shop, gym, night market, water park and more — each with unique scenes

• Cross-Scene Story Arcs: Try wedding dress → Ferris wheel confession → buy ring → propose → marriage true ending

• 4 Major Endings: Friend, Lover, Marriage true ending, plus a hidden secret branch — multi-playthrough exploration

• 12 One-Time Key Moments: Ferris wheel kiss, bridal shop flutter, late-night confession, first hand-hold and more — each plays only once in a lifetime

• Anti-Repeat & Fallback Mechanism: 30 days × 30 events randomly drawn from the pool, with key moments protected

• Costume Unlock System: Buy swimsuit, gym outfit, wedding dress, ring to unlock exclusive scenes and storylines

• Multi-Playthrough Inheritance: Hidden easter eggs, affection bonus, starting coins from your 2nd playthrough

• Steam Cloud Saves: Sync your progress across devices

【About Us】

Indie Developer / Small Indie Team

This game is a single-developer / small-team production, featuring all-AI video alongside hand-crafted design, programming, art, and voice direction.

We are committed to using AI tools to lower the production barrier and deliver sweet, heartwarming pure-romance interactive stories to players.

Thank you for your support — we hope Thirty Days with My First Love Sister brings you a beautiful thirty-day journey.

【Content Disclosure】

The game features a non-blood-related childhood friend elder sister character (18+). All intimate interactions are pure romance, with no nudity, sexual hints or violence included.

【Content Warning】

This is an all-ages pure romance game. There is no violence, gore, or adult content.

The two main characters are not blood-related. All characters are 18+.

All intimate interactions are wholesome and romantic in nature.

In The Corrupted Witches, you take on the role of a newly appointed Substitute High-Master inside an isolated, dark-fantasy magical citadel. Your objective? Evaluate, manage, and stabilize the next generation of raw elemental forces and powerful mages.

Operating from your central office desk, you will summon elite witches, audit confidential ledgers, navigate high-stakes political tension, and gradually break down their defenses in a dynamic, high-consequence adult visual novel sandbox.

Key Features:

  • Centralized Desk-Hub Gameplay: Experience a refined, hub-based simulation loop inspired by classic adult training sandboxes. Manage your day-to-day operations directly from your office desk or step out to explore the Citadel.

  • 3-Phase Daily Economy: Balance a strict 6-action daily schedule across Morning, Afternoon, and Night phases. Split your time between private training sessions at your desk and exploring Citadel locations to complete weekly chores, scavenge rare ingredients, or sell crafted goods at the market.

  • The Mutating Dialogue & H-Engine: Watch interactions dynamically evolve across 6 distinct Lewd Levels. Commands, requests, and intimacy options that trigger intense resistance or hostility at Level 0 become confident, uninhibited, and natural as their defenses crumble.

  • Deep Multi-Stage H-Quests: Embark on multi-period questlines initiated at your desk. Fetch rare alchemical ingredients, resolve personal dilemmas, and unlock cinematic, boundary-breaking milestone scenes that permanently alter character metrics.

  • Dominant vs. Flattering Control: Shape how you interact with each woman during critical story choices. Choose between Assertive command to enforce dominant control or Submissive flattery to dismantle their emotional walls with quiet reassurance.

  • Citadel Exploration & Stealth Events: Leave your office to forage for rare herbs in the Shadow Gardens, brew specialized tonics at the Alchemy Lab, or trigger contextual, unscripted stealth events in the subterranean Onsen and private Dormitories.

  • Four Distinct, Complex Heroines:

    • Morgana: The cold, calculating Coven Matriarch who harbors a secret need to relinquish her crushing political authority behind locked doors.

    • Vesper: The hyperactive, manic kinetic genius desperately seeking a grounding force for her volatile magic.

    • Lilith: The gloomy, cynical archivist whose cold detachment masks a deeply vulnerable, submissive core.

    • Bast: The shameless, mercenary cat-girl driven entirely by primal feline desires, greed, and immediate rewards.

store_data.about_the_game:
Today, a corner shop. Tomorrow, an empire.

Grab your friends, pull up the shutters, and turn one empty room into the busiest supermarket in town.

Supermarket Empire Together is a hands-on co-op business sim where you do the work yourself. You place the orders, carry the boxes, arrange every single item on the shelf, write every price tag — and stand at the register counting change while the queue grows behind you. Play alone at your own pace, or bring in up to 3 friends and split the chaos.

🛒 YOUR STORE, YOUR RULES

You start with a bare room. Order furniture from your office PC, drop it into place with a snapping hologram preview, and rearrange it until it feels right. Repaint the walls, retile the floor, swap the ceiling. Then put your own name above the door in raised 3D letters, in whatever color you like. When the space gets tight, unlock the sealed sections of the building and expand.

💰 REAL WORK AT THE REGISTER

There is no auto-sell button. Ring up the items, open the physical drawer, pick out the right notes and coins, and hand the change back yourself. Get it right and the customer leaves happy; hold up the line and they walk out empty-handed. Every product carries its own price tag and its own demand curve — undercut the market and watch the shelves empty, push your margin and watch the stock sit. Finding the sweet spot is the whole game.

🚨 NOT EVERY CUSTOMER PAYS

Some people walk in with no intention of ever reaching the checkout. When the door alarm goes off, the call is yours: chase them down and take back what's yours — with your fists, if that's what it takes. Or hire a security guard and let someone else keep the peace while you work.

👥 BUILD YOUR CREW

Cashiers, stockers, cleaners and security guards — hire them from your PC, promote them as they gain experience, and pay their wages every week. The bills arrive whether you're ready or not, and if you let them slide too long the power goes out and your staff walk. Assign products to shelf sections and your stockers will keep them full while you handle the bigger problems.

🌆 A SHOP INSIDE A LIVING CITY

Your store isn't a box floating in the void. Traffic moves on the road outside, pedestrians pass your windows, streetlights flicker on at dusk and the whole city rolls through a full day-night cycle while you work. Open up in the morning, hit your daily quota, pay the rent, read the end-of-day report — then do it all again, bigger.

📈 LICENSE UP, UNLOCK EVERYTHING

You begin with a handful of basics. Dry goods, fresh produce, deli and meat, cold drinks and dairy, cleaning supplies, refrigerated equipment, self-checkout — all of it sits behind a license you earn by proving your store can handle it. 87 products and 15 licenses stand between you and the shop you're picturing.

🤝 UP TO 4 PLAYERS — OR JUST YOU

Invite friends straight through Steam and run the same store together with up to 4 players. Split the jobs however you want: one on the register, one hauling boxes from the delivery point, one scrubbing the floor, one sprinting after the guy who just ran out the door. The wallet, the shelves, the mess and the profit are all shared. Prefer the quiet? The entire game plays start to finish as a single-player experience.

FEATURES

  • 87 products across dry goods, produce, deli and meat, cold drinks and household

  • 15 licenses gating products and equipment as your store proves itself

  • Hands-on checkout — physical cash drawer, manual change-giving, POS screen

  • Dynamic pricing — every product has its own demand curve to read

  • Free-form stocking — place every item on the shelf yourself

  • Build mode with hologram previews and snap-to-wall furniture placement

  • 4 staff roles across 3 promotion tiers, plus weekly wages and bills

  • Store customization — wall, floor and ceiling decor plus your own 3D storefront sign

  • Shoplifters, door alarms and hands-on justice

  • Full day-night cycle with shifts, rent, daily quotas and end-of-day reports

  • Character customization — body, outfit color, hair, beard and glasses

  • Multiple save worlds, first- and third-person view, and emotes

VIP Scandal Patrol is a chaotic 2–4 player co-op party security game where every client expects a different kind of night. Check the guests, handle disasters, work with your team and give each client exactly the party they asked for.

KEEP THE PARTY WILD, NOT OUT OF CONTROL

Every client wants a different kind of night. Some want classy, some want crazy. Turn the party up when it is too tame, and pull it back before things go completely off the rails.

BRING FRIENDS. MAKE IT WORSE.

Split up, shout warnings, improvise on the fly and rescue each other's terrible decisions. Four players can solve problems much faster, assuming they are not busy creating new ones.

WHO LET THAT IN?

Not everyone gets through the door. Check invitations, inspect guests and search their belongings. Expect the strangest surprises to be hidden where you least expect them.

MOPS, FIRE EXTINGUISHERS, BAD IDEAS

Drunk guests, jealous exes, fires, escaped animals and other disasters can turn a good night into mayhem in seconds. Grab whatever is nearby, deal with what matters and improvise when the sensible solution is nowhere to be found.

NEW PARTY. NEW RULES.

A luxury villa, a yacht, a masquerade or a palace can all demand a completely different kind of night. New venues, clients and party setups change what can go wrong and how crazy the host actually wants things to get.

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet SlimeKitten — an adorable blob of cat-shaped slime with a knack for getting airborne. Behind the cute face is a razor-sharp 2D precision platformer you can play your way: plan every leap like a puzzle, or chase the perfect, flawless run.

Aim your jump. Own your arc.

Every jump is yours to line up. Pull back and a trajectory line shows exactly where SlimeKitten will fly — dial in the power, angle, and speed, and let go. Stick to walls, cling on, and launch again. It's a movement system all its own: part precision platformer, part physics puzzle, all satisfying.

Cute on the outside, merciless on the inside

• Dozens of handcrafted levels across escalating worlds

• Instant death, instant respawn — no waiting, pure flow

• Hidden collectables tucked into every level for completionists

• Built-in timers and best-times to beat — made for speedrunners

• Tight, responsive controls with full controller support

• Play it your pace — take your time, or go for the flawless run

store_data.about_the_game:
Going once. Going twice. Build an empire.

You start small.

A little cash. Cheap storage. No reputation. No prestigious contacts.

Just enough money to walk into a local auction and take a chance on something everyone else overlooked.

Maybe that dusty painting is exactly what the catalogue says it is.

Maybe it's worth ten times the estimate.

Maybe the collector across the room knows something you don't.

And maybe he's bluffing.

Auction Simulator is a deep auction-house and collecting simulator built around incomplete information, psychological bidding, market speculation and long-term progression.

Buy objects.

Research their history.

Build collections.

Restore forgotten treasures.

Follow market trends.

Read your rivals.

Sell for a profit.

Build relationships with collectors and experts.

Open your own auction house.

Or discover the very different opportunities hiding beneath the legitimate market.

THE AUCTION HOUSE IS YOUR POKER TABLE

Auctions aren't simply about who has the most money.

Every bidder has a different hand.

Except instead of cards, their hand is made from information.

You might know the painting has an unusual signature.

Margaret might know it belongs to a larger collection.

Henry might already have a private buyer.

And the bidder who just doubled the price?

Maybe they know something nobody else does.

Or maybe they're bluffing.

Read bid timing, hesitation, sudden aggression, unusual interest and changes in behaviour. Build a mental model of your opponents and decide when they're revealing genuine information — and when they're trying to manipulate what you believe.

But remember: they're reading you too.

Bid predictably and experienced rivals may learn when you're confident, when you're uncertain and when you're bluffing.

There are no cards.

But everyone at the table has a hand.

EVERY BID TELLS A STORY

Auctions aren't simply about who has the most money.

They're about information.

Your opponents have their own knowledge, budgets, collections, objectives and personalities.

A bidder suddenly jumps from $8,000 to $15,000.

Why?

Did they recognize the artist?

Are they completing a collection?

Do they already have a private buyer?

Are they trying to scare you away?

Or do they simply want you to believe they know something?

Watch how your rivals behave.

Learn their habits.

Identify their interests.

Recognize hesitation.

Pressure their liquidity.

But remember:

they're watching you too.

Become predictable and experienced opponents may learn exactly when you're bluffing.

NOBODY KNOWS THE WHOLE TRUTH

Every object is an information puzzle.

Auction catalogues provide estimates.

Experts provide opinions.

Research reveals history.

Restoration can uncover hidden details.

Provenance documents tell part of the story.

Other bidders reveal clues through their behaviour.

But information isn't always complete.

And it isn't always correct.

You might discover that an ordinary-looking painting has an unusual signature.

Another collector might recognize the subject.

Someone else may know where the painting was exhibited fifty years ago.

A private dealer might claim to know its previous owner.

Everyone sees a different part of the picture.

Decide what you believe.

Then decide how much you're willing to risk on being right.

BUILD A CAREER, NOT JUST A COLLECTION

Every auction is part of a persistent career.

Objects, money, relationships, reputation, knowledge and collections survive from one auction to the next.

Start at small estate sales and local auction rooms.

Build your reputation.

Develop expertise.

Meet collectors.

Gain access to specialist sales and prestigious auction houses.

Eventually, six-figure bids that once seemed impossible may become routine.

But larger opportunities mean larger mistakes.

One brilliant discovery can transform your career.

One terrible acquisition can leave you scrambling for liquidity.

FIND YOUR OWN PATH

There is no single correct way to dominate the auction world.

THE DEALER

Buy undervalued objects.

Research opportunities.

Follow market trends.

Turn inventory quickly.

Build relationships with private buyers.

Buy low. Know more. Sell well.

THE COLLECTOR

Hunt rare objects across years of auctions.

Discover relationships between seemingly unrelated pieces.

Complete legendary collections.

Work with museums and experts.

Decide whether your greatest discoveries belong in your collection...

...or back on the market.

THE AUCTIONEER

Stop merely attending auctions.

Run them.

Win prestigious consignments.

Hire specialists.

Build catalogues.

Set reserves.

Attract the right collectors.

Choose your lot order.

Develop your auction house into an internationally respected institution.

THE BROKER

Sometimes the most valuable thing in the room isn't an object.

It's information.

Discover what collectors want.

Connect buyers with sellers.

Build a private client network.

Know where objects are before they reach the public market.

You don't always need to own something to profit from it.

THE BLACK MARKET DEALER

Some objects never reach respectable auction houses.

Some collectors prefer that they don't.

Build a hidden network of private sellers, brokers, informants, experts and secretive collectors.

Buy uncertain objects.

Broker discreet transactions.

Reconstruct provenance.

Find private buyers.

Build trust.

Control information.

And eventually become the person people contact when an object is too unusual, too uncertain or too sensitive for the ordinary market.

Every path can be combined.

Become a collector-dealer.

An auctioneer-broker.

Or operate one of the world's most respected auction houses while quietly maintaining a completely different network behind the scenes.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION

Objects don't disappear when an auction ends.

Keep them.

Research them.

Restore them.

Exhibit them.

Use them as collateral.

Wait for the market to change.

Or search for the other pieces that belong beside them.

A seemingly insignificant object acquired early in your career could become the missing link in a collection worth a fortune many hours later.

And other collectors build collections too.

Discover what they're looking for and suddenly an ordinary $5,000 object might be worth $50,000...

to exactly one person.

The question is whether they know that you know.

RESEARCH WHAT YOU OWN

Winning an auction is sometimes only the beginning.

A mysterious painting purchased for $3,200 might initially be listed simply as:

Unknown Dutch Painting

Invest in research.

Clean it.

Investigate its provenance.

Consult a specialist.

Discover an old exhibition record.

Eventually it might become:

Attributed to the Workshop of a Dutch Master

Estimated value:

$18,000–$30,000

Now you have another decision.

Sell immediately?

Continue researching?

Wait for the market?

Find a private collector?

Or put it into your own auction?

Knowledge can be more valuable than the object itself.

SELL YOUR OWN OBJECTS AT AUCTION

Eventually you'll be sitting on the other side of the transaction.

Choose an auction house.

Set your reserve.

Research the object.

Restore it.

Improve its presentation.

Promote it to specialist collectors.

Then watch the auction unfold.

$12,000.

$14,000.

$16,000.

One bidder folds.

Another hesitates.

This time you're not hoping they'll stop.

You're hoping somebody bids again.

BUILD YOUR OWN AUCTION HOUSE

As your career grows, you can stop relying entirely on other auction houses and build your own.

Attract sellers.

Negotiate commissions.

Hire specialists.

Research consignments.

Build themed auctions.

Promote headline lots.

Invite collectors.

Develop your reputation.

And decide exactly what enters your catalogue.

Your auction house isn't a building-placement minigame.

The auction itself is your build.

You might have 40 available consignments but only 15 places in your next prestigious evening sale.

Which objects belong together?

Which collectors will they attract?

Which lot should open the auction?

Where should you place the headline object?

Will similar lots create excitement...

...or drain the same collectors' budgets before your most valuable piece appears?

Build the right catalogue.

Get the right people into the room.

Then let them fight over it.

KNOW YOUR BUYERS

A great object doesn't guarantee a great auction.

You need the right bidders.

If only one serious collector wants your rare watch, you have a problem.

If three wealthy collectors want it...

you have an auction.

Build relationships.

Learn their interests.

Send private invitations.

Develop specialist mailing lists.

Create previews.

And remember which collectors hate losing to each other.

Sometimes your greatest skill as an auctioneer is simply making sure the right two people are sitting in the same room.

FOLLOW THE MARKET

Values change.

Categories rise and fall.

A major exhibition can suddenly increase interest in an artist.

A famous collection entering the market can create oversupply.

A celebrity purchase can ignite demand for a forgotten category.

A scandal can destroy confidence overnight.

Buy today.

Sell next week.

Or hold for six months.

Your inventory isn't just a collection of objects.

It's a portfolio.

RISK YOUR CAPITAL

The best opportunities rarely arrive when you have enough cash.

Borrow against your collection.

Finance major acquisitions.

Offer guarantees to win important consignments.

Invest in restoration.

Expand your operation.

But debt changes the way you play.

Imagine discovering an object that might be worth $900,000.

The seller wants $450,000.

You have $180,000.

You can borrow the rest.

If you're right, it could transform your career.

If you're wrong...

the loan doesn't disappear just because the painting is fake.

COMPETE WITH RIVAL AUCTION HOUSES

You're not building your business alone.

Other auction houses want the same:

Collectors.

Experts.

Sellers.

Important estates.

Headline objects.

Prestige.

Dominate the watch market and a rival may launch a competing specialist sale.

Hire a brilliant expert and another house might try to recruit them.

Bid aggressively for a major estate.

Offer guarantees.

Compete for the objects that can define an entire season.

ENTER THE BLACK MARKET

Eventually you may discover another side of the auction world.

A message arrives.

I hear you acquired Lot 47.

The auction house doesn't know what they sold you.

I do.

IGNORE

RESPOND

The black market isn't simply another shop.

It's a network.

Private collectors.

Brokers.

Informants.

Specialists.

Questionable provenance.

Secret collections.

Objects respectable auction houses won't touch.

And information people don't want appearing in a catalogue.

BECOME THE DEALER

At first, you're just another buyer.

Build trust and the relationship changes.

Private sellers begin contacting you.

Collectors tell you what they're searching for.

Brokers introduce opportunities.

Eventually you don't even need to buy the object yourself.

You know someone who owns it.

You know someone who desperately wants it.

Make the connection.

Negotiate the deal.

Take your fee.

Protect your reputation.

Build your client book.

Progress from an unknown contact to a trusted buyer, connector, underground dealer, network operator...

and eventually:

a market maker.

At that level, you aren't waiting for opportunities.

You're creating them.

INFORMATION IS A COMMODITY

Someone offers you information:

Margaret Sinclair is searching for objects from the Beaumont Estate.

Price:

$1,500

Tomorrow's catalogue contains:

Beaumont Family Portrait

Estimated value:

$4,000–$6,000

That information could be worth a fortune.

Or it could be wrong.

Outdated.

Incomplete.

Or deliberately planted by Margaret herself.

Every source has a history.

Every informant has motives.

And sophisticated rivals can manipulate the same networks you use.

RECONSTRUCT THE PAST

Some underground objects aren't worthless.

They're simply impossible to sell through prestigious channels.

Yet.

Buy an uncertain object.

Investigate its history.

Find previous owners.

Recover missing documentation.

Restore it.

Seek authentication.

Get it exhibited.

Build credible provenance.

Eventually, something acquired privately for $12,000 might become a legitimate six-figure auction lot.

Or months of research might reveal exactly why nobody respectable wanted it.

PROTECT YOUR REPUTATION

Your public and private careers can coexist.

Perhaps you're known publicly as:

★★★★★ Distinguished Auctioneer

while privately you've become:

★★★★★ Underground Dealer

That combination can give you extraordinary access.

It also gives you far more to lose.

One disputed object.

One unreliable contact.

One provenance scandal.

And a business you spent years building can suddenly be under pressure.

How close to the edge are you willing to operate?

EVERY CAREER CREATES DIFFERENT STORIES

One career might make you the world's leading watch dealer.

Another might revolve around completing a legendary art collection.

Another could see you building an international auction house.

Another might turn you into the invisible broker connecting the world's wealthiest collectors.

Or perhaps you operate both sides of the market.

Publicly respected.

Privately indispensable.

The systems overlap.

Objects move between markets.

Collectors become rivals.

Rivals become clients.

Experts become allies.

Information becomes leverage.

And something you bought for almost nothing ten hours ago might eventually become the most important object in your career.

KEY FEATURES

Deep Psychological Auctions
Read behaviour, bid patterns, hesitation, aggression and opponent motivations.

Persistent Career Mode
Your money, objects, relationships, reputation and discoveries survive every auction.

Multiple Career Paths
Develop as a Dealer, Collector, Auctioneer, Broker, Black Market Dealer or hybrid.

Dynamic Object Values
Objects can have different values to different buyers based on collections, information, market conditions and private objectives.

Research & Authentication
Investigate provenance, authenticity, condition and historical significance.

Persistent Collections
Hunt connected objects across many auctions and build increasingly valuable sets.

Sell Your Own Objects
Choose venues, estimates, reserves, preparation and promotion before watching your objects go under the hammer.

Build an Auction House
Acquire consignments, hire experts, construct catalogues, attract bidders and develop an international reputation.

Catalogue Building
Select lots, create themes and determine lot order to maximize attendance and competition.

Dynamic Markets
React to changing demand, events, supply and collector trends.

Financing & Risk
Use loans and portfolio collateral to chase opportunities that would otherwise be beyond your reach.

Persistent Rivals
Collectors and competing auction houses remember, adapt and pursue their own objectives.

Private Buyers & Brokerage
Connect sellers and collectors without necessarily owning the object yourself.

Black Market Career
Build a secret network of dealers, informants, specialists and private collectors.

Information Trading
Buy and sell intelligence while deciding which sources deserve your trust.

Provenance Reconstruction
Transform uncertain objects through research, expertise and historical evidence.

Reputation & Heat
Balance legitimate prestige against the risks of your underground activities.

Systemic Events & Missions
Manipulate auctions, locate missing collection pieces, investigate rivals and exploit changing market opportunities.

High Replayability
Different objects, markets, opponents, collections, auction houses, contacts, factions and career choices create a different economy every time.

FROM A $500 BOX TO AN AUCTION EMPIRE

You walk into your first estate auction with almost nothing.

Twenty hours later, you might be deciding whether to:

Sell a legendary collection.

Borrow $500,000 to chase a masterpiece.

Guarantee an important estate for your auction house.

Manipulate a rival into overspending.

Accept an underground consignment.

Hire a world-renowned expert.

Or risk your reputation on an object that could change everything.

Every great collection starts with one object.

Every auction empire starts with one bid.

Going once.

Going twice...

What happens next is up to you.

Send private invitations.

Develop specialist mailing lists.

Create previews.

And remember which collectors hate losing to each other.

Sometimes your greatest skill as an auctioneer is simply making sure the right two people are sitting in the same room.

FOLLOW THE MARKET

Values change.

Categories rise and fall.

A major exhibition can suddenly increase interest in an artist.

A famous collection entering the market can create oversupply.

A celebrity purchase can ignite demand for a forgotten category.

A scandal can destroy confidence overnight.

Buy today.

Sell next week.

Or hold for six months.

Your inventory isn't just a collection of objects.

It's a portfolio.

RISK YOUR CAPITAL

The best opportunities rarely arrive when you have enough cash.

Borrow against your collection.

Finance major acquisitions.

Offer guarantees to win important consignments.

Invest in restoration.

Expand your operation.

But debt changes the way you play.

Imagine discovering an object that might be worth $900,000.

The seller wants $450,000.

You have $180,000.

You can borrow the rest.

If you're right, it could transform your career.

If you're wrong...

the loan doesn't disappear just because the painting is fake.

COMPETE WITH RIVAL AUCTION HOUSES

You're not building your business alone.

Other auction houses want the same:

Collectors.

Experts.

Sellers.

Important estates.

Headline objects.

Prestige.

Dominate the watch market and a rival may launch a competing specialist sale.

Hire a brilliant expert and another house might try to recruit them.

Bid aggressively for a major estate.

Offer guarantees.

Compete for the objects that can define an entire season.

ENTER THE BLACK MARKET

Eventually you may discover another side of the auction world.

A message arrives.

I hear you acquired Lot 47.

The auction house doesn't know what they sold you.

I do.

IGNORE

RESPOND

The black market isn't simply another shop.

It's a network.

Private collectors.

Brokers.

Informants.

Specialists.

Questionable provenance.

Secret collections.

Objects respectable auction houses won't touch.

And information people don't want appearing in a catalogue.

BECOME THE DEALER

At first, you're just another buyer.

Build trust and the relationship changes.

Private sellers begin contacting you.

Collectors tell you what they're searching for.

Brokers introduce opportunities.

Eventually you don't even need to buy the object yourself.

You know someone who owns it.

You know someone who desperately wants it.

Make the connection.

Negotiate the deal.

Take your fee.

Protect your reputation.

Build your client book.

Progress from an unknown contact to a trusted buyer, connector, underground dealer, network operator...

and eventually:

a market maker.

At that level, you aren't waiting for opportunities.

You're creating them.

INFORMATION IS A COMMODITY

Someone offers you information:

Margaret Sinclair is searching for objects from the Beaumont Estate.

Price:

$1,500

Tomorrow's catalogue contains:

Beaumont Family Portrait

Estimated value:

$4,000–$6,000

That information could be worth a fortune.

Or it could be wrong.

Outdated.

Incomplete.

Or deliberately planted by Margaret herself.

Every source has a history.

Every informant has motives.

And sophisticated rivals can manipulate the same networks you use.

RECONSTRUCT THE PAST

Some underground objects aren't worthless.

They're simply impossible to sell through prestigious channels.

Yet.

Buy an uncertain object.

Investigate its history.

Find previous owners.

Recover missing documentation.

Restore it.

Seek authentication.

Get it exhibited.

Build credible provenance.

Eventually, something acquired privately for $12,000 might become a legitimate six-figure auction lot.

Or months of research might reveal exactly why nobody respectable wanted it.

PROTECT YOUR REPUTATION

Your public and private careers can coexist.

Perhaps you're known publicly as:

★★★★★ Distinguished Auctioneer

while privately you've become:

★★★★★ Underground Dealer

That combination can give you extraordinary access.

It also gives you far more to lose.

One disputed object.

One unreliable contact.

One provenance scandal.

And a business you spent years building can suddenly be under pressure.

How close to the edge are you willing to operate?

EVERY CAREER CREATES DIFFERENT STORIES

One career might make you the world's leading watch dealer.

Another might revolve around completing a legendary art collection.

Another could see you building an international auction house.

Another might turn you into the invisible broker connecting the world's wealthiest collectors.

Or perhaps you operate both sides of the market.

Publicly respected.

Privately indispensable.

The systems overlap.

Objects move between markets.

Collectors become rivals.

Rivals become clients.

Experts become allies.

Information becomes leverage.

And something you bought for almost nothing ten hours ago might eventually become the most important object in your career.

KEY FEATURES

Deep Psychological Auctions
Read behaviour, bid patterns, hesitation, aggression and opponent motivations.

Persistent Career Mode
Your money, objects, relationships, reputation and discoveries survive every auction.

Multiple Career Paths
Develop as a Dealer, Collector, Auctioneer, Broker, Black Market Dealer or hybrid.

Dynamic Object Values
Objects can have different values to different buyers based on collections, information, market conditions and private objectives.

Research & Authentication
Investigate provenance, authenticity, condition and historical significance.

Persistent Collections
Hunt connected objects across many auctions and build increasingly valuable sets.

Sell Your Own Objects
Choose venues, estimates, reserves, preparation and promotion before watching your objects go under the hammer.

Build an Auction House
Acquire consignments, hire experts, construct catalogues, attract bidders and develop an international reputation.

Catalogue Building
Select lots, create themes and determine lot order to maximize attendance and competition.

Dynamic Markets
React to changing demand, events, supply and collector trends.

Financing & Risk
Use loans and portfolio collateral to chase opportunities that would otherwise be beyond your reach.

Persistent Rivals
Collectors and competing auction houses remember, adapt and pursue their own objectives.

Private Buyers & Brokerage
Connect sellers and collectors without necessarily owning the object yourself.

Black Market Career
Build a secret network of dealers, informants, specialists and private collectors.

Information Trading
Buy and sell intelligence while deciding which sources deserve your trust.

Provenance Reconstruction
Transform uncertain objects through research, expertise and historical evidence.

Reputation & Heat
Balance legitimate prestige against the risks of your underground activities.

Systemic Events & Missions
Manipulate auctions, locate missing collection pieces, investigate rivals and exploit changing market opportunities.

High Replayability
Different objects, markets, opponents, collections, auction houses, contacts, factions and career choices create a different economy every time.

FROM A $500 BOX TO AN AUCTION EMPIRE

You walk into your first estate auction with almost nothing.

Twenty hours later, you might be deciding whether to:

Sell a legendary collection.

Borrow $500,000 to chase a masterpiece.

Guarantee an important estate for your auction house.

Manipulate a rival into overspending.

Accept an underground consignment.

Hire a world-renowned expert.

Or risk your reputation on an object that could change everything.

Every great collection starts with one object.

Every auction empire starts with one bid.

Going once.

Going twice...

What happens next is up to you.
store_data.short_description: Build an auction career where every bid is a tell. Buy, research and sell valuable objects, read rivals in poker-inspired psychological auctions, build collections, run your own auction house, or become a dealer in the dark market. Every bid is information. Every object could be an opportunity.
