5100980.name: The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier

store_data.about_the_game:
THE LAST ROUTE HOME

You return from a distant transport run to find an invasion already underway. Communications are jammed. The inner worlds have not been warned. One ship now stands between the hostile armada and Prima Verd.

The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier is a story-driven vertical space shooter built around a campaign of ten increasingly dangerous frontiers. Fight your way inward, restore the communications network, and assemble a ship capable of reaching the source of the enemy command signal.

THE ENEMY WILL NOT SIMPLY FLY AT YOU

Hostile ships enter from multiple directions, reposition in flight, launch flanking attacks, form manoeuvring groups, and cover one another. Rammers lock onto your course, minelayers restrict your space, teleporters change position, and repair vessels return damaged targets to the fight.

Every new frontier expands the enemy arsenal and increases the pressure. Difficulty grows through overlapping threats, faster projectiles, denser formations, and more aggressive attack patterns — not health bars alone.

COMMANDERS CHANGE THE RULES OF THE FIGHT

Heavy ships are not enlarged versions of ordinary enemies. They unfold armour sections, detach weapons, construct firing networks, protect vulnerable systems, and transition through multiple phases during combat.

Read each attack through mechanical movement and light signals, find your window to strike, and survive the commander blockades before facing the flagship of each frontier.

BUILD A SHIP AROUND YOUR STYLE

Develop your ship across a nine-step mastery track. Core upgrades steadily unlock its full potential, while four pairs of mutually exclusive specialisations let you shape your preferred style: control, explosive damage, penetration, shrapnel, the Chronosphere, or point defence.

Purchase twelve ship modules across three technology tiers, combine them with your skills, and unlock additional synergies. Enemy strength never scales secretly to match your equipment — every upgrade delivers a real, measurable advantage.

THE BREAKTHROUGH IS MORE THAN A STRAIGHT FIGHT

The sector map connects the main campaign, trading hubs, and optional operations. Navigate the hazardous approach to Tartassa, restore the Lost Relay, and expose camouflaged hostiles hidden among civilian traffic over Erynia.

Side missions reveal new routes and technology, provide valuable credits, and help prepare your ship for the next stage of the pursuit — without replacing the skill required in the main battles.

ASTRA MAINTAINS THE SHIPBOARD ARCHIVE

ASTRA is the Autonomous System for Tactical Response and Analysis. It warns you of incoming threats, reconstructs intercepted signals, and studies technology recovered from the wreckage of enemy commanders.

Every new archive entry adds another piece to the invasion. The closer you get to Prima Verd, the clearer it becomes: the armada has come for more than a single world, and what you recover may prove more important than conventional weapons.

REACH THE HEART OF THE ARMADA

Ten story frontiers transform a desperate border breakthrough into a full-scale pursuit of the enemy command source. The final route tests everything you have built in a battle against Hyperion, a five-phase flagship.

Commander checkpoints preserve the pace of longer sorties, while full controller support lets you navigate the sector map, shops, mastery tree, minigames, and combat missions without a mouse.

KEY FEATURES

·       10 story-driven combat frontiers with steadily escalating intensity.

·       Multi-phase commanders and flagships with individual attacks and transformations.

·       9 mastery steps, 4 pairs of specialisations, and the option to rebuild your chosen branches.

·       12 ship modules across 3 technology tiers, supported by a separate synergy system.

·       A sector map with side operations, minigames, shops, and a shipboard archive.

·       Transparent balancing with no hidden enemy scaling based on build strength.

·       Full keyboard and controller support.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a day-night, terrain-and-biome-generating voxel wilderness — in Fangjie: Shattered Altars, you play an adventurer set on restoring order, searching the shattered world for its lost altars.

KEY FEATURES

  • Procedurally generated open world: terrain, biomes, and encounters recombine every run, so there's no fixed path.

  • 4 races × 5 classes: choose from four races with distinct strengths — Human, Elf, Orc, and Undead — paired with five combat classes including Warrior, plus a freely allocated skill tree to build your own playstyle.

  • Action combat: melee, ranged, and spellcasting all keep a hands-on feel, with clear differences between classes.

  • Solo or co-op: get comfortable with the world alone, or bring friends along to explore, fight, and find altars together.

CURRENT STATE

Fangjie is still in active development, but the main story is playable from start to finish, including all of its endings. We're still polishing the open-ended progression system that continues past the story, multiplayer synchronization for quest and story progress, and combat balance across the full level range. We're being upfront about where things stand, and we want players to help shape Fangjie into a complete world.

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE BUTTON. A TERRIBLE IDEA.

How much horror can fit between START and the end credits?

The World's Shortest Horror Game is a bite-sized horror-comedy game that lasts only a few minutes. It gives you one simple task:

Press the button.

Take your seat. Put on your headphones. Check the volume. Look at the button. Decide that you're ready. Realize that you aren't.

Press it anyway.

Saying any more would spoil half the game. For now, all you need to know is that it involves analog horror, maliciously timed audio, one nasty surprise, and an end-credit sequence that takes the whole thing far too seriously.

This is a microgame. It is not a traditional, full-length horror adventure. It was made to be played in minutes, passed around between friends, streamed for reactions, or sent as a tiny prank disguised as a gift.

YOU PRESSED IT. NOW IT'S YOUR FRIEND'S TURN.

Gift it to a friend.

Don't tell them too much.

Just say, “I found a really short game.”

Tell them to wear headphones.

If possible, ask them to share their screen.

Then sit back and find out whether your friendship can survive this.

WHAT AWAITS YOU?

  • One button and one terrible idea.

  • A short, complete horror experience with no filler.

  • Analog-horror aesthetics and carefully timed sound design.

  • Dark comedy delivered with a completely straight face.

  • Built for sharing with friends, gifting, and hunting for reactions on stream.

  • Optional, moderated Community Credits: Leave one public name behind, or quietly flee the scene without one.

  • Interface support for 31 languages.

Headphones are strongly recommended.

Make sure your friend wears them too.

CONTENT WARNING

Contains sudden loud sounds, rapid glitch imagery, and brief flashing effects.

Community Credits may display moderated nicknames submitted by other players. Participation is entirely optional.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’ve been hired to work the night shift at an old roadside motel.

Your job sounds simple:

Inspect the motel. Remember what you see. Report anything that changes.

But as the days pass, the motel begins to feel less familiar.

A picture may change.

An object may disappear.

A door that was closed may suddenly be open.

Someone may be standing where nobody was before.

Or perhaps...

nothing has changed at all.

SURVIVE 8 DAYS

Complete your cleaning shifts and make it through all 8 days. As the days pass, the motel becomes increasingly unpredictable and disturbing.

Complete your inspection correctly to progress to the next day.

As you move forward, expect increasingly strange events and encounters throughout the motel.

Your goal is simple:

Make it through all 8 days.

SPOT THE ANOMALIES

Pay close attention to your surroundings and memorize the motel.

Anomalies can appear in different forms. Some will be impossible to miss. Others may be hiding in the smallest details.

When you've finished your inspection, you must make a decision.

DANGER : You noticed an anomaly.

SAFE : Everything appears normal.

FOLLOW THE RULES

The motel has rules.

They are there for a reason.

Read the instructions carefully. Remember where things belong. Don't trust everything you see.

And most importantly...

Do not open any door you were told to leave closed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neverscape is the story of a fallen hero, searching for a cure to a mysterious soul malady. The journey leads them to remote corners of the Slavic-inspired kingdom of Iskra, where they gather an eclectic band of companions on a journey of self-discovery.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Deep Personal Story. 
    There's something wrong with your soul. As you adventure by day in search of a cure, you'll reflect on your choices by writing in your journal at night. Can you keep your broken soul together?

  • Rich Character System. 
    Neverscape has 13 classes to choose from, from the classic Warrior, Rogue and Mage, over familiar classes with a twist (like the Disciple or Virtuoso), to rare picks like Alchemist and Engineer.

  • Six Quirky Races. 
    Ever wanted to play a giant? Or a race with functioning wings? In Neverscape, every race comes with a unique mechanic that puts an additional twist on the way you play your class.

  • Memorable Companions. 
    Characters are the heart of any good story, so our 10+ companions each come with a personal storyline, party banter and strong reactivity to your adventures. Together, you'll find joy, tears, friendship... And maybe even love!

  • A Strange Land. 
    You'll explore the land of Iskra, inspired by Slavic mythology and Serbian folklore. Meet interesting creatures, battle frightening beasts, and explore dreamlike landscapes as you search for a cure.

  • The World as a Puzzle. 
    To unravel the mystery of your soul, you'll have to unravel the mysteries of the world around you. Solve puzzles and unveil mysteries to unlock new areas and companion bonds.

  • Epic multi-stage boss battles: Test your skills against a variety of boss tanks. Each encounter is a unique challenge, featuring fast, heavily armored, flying, flamethrower-wielding, and chaotic multi-barreled monstrosities.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep within the Fabled Forest, Lyra the songstress was venturing back to her homeland but she is then ambushed by the Wolfskin twins, Luna and Lune. Her basket was taken by them and so Lyra sets off on a journey to reclaim her lost belongings.

Venture across the land of Clerica in this 2D Platformer with Metroidvania esque exploration. Areas shift between 2D sidescroller and top-down adventure which broaden the non-linearity of this experience. Combat is seamless with a nimble Twirl and bosses offer a great challenge that is much like the Soulslikes of today.

Z: Confirm / Attack

X: Cancel / Jump

C: Twirl

A: Spell Menu

S: Left Swap

D: Right Swap

Enter: Pause

(Control bindings can be remapped in game for both keyboard and controller.)

Twirl (C by default): Lyra performs a nimble twirl that is able to evade attacks from enemies. This move can be used during Lyra's grounded attacks.

Sprint (Keep C held down after a Twirl): Lyra enters a run state that is faster than her usual walk speed.

Power Cut (Keep Z held down after an attack): Strength is concentrated into a single attack with more range and damage. Charge is lost upon getting hit.

Cast (Up + Attack): Magic Points (MP) are used to perform a magical attack with Lyra's current Spell. Use Left Swap and Right Swap (S and D by default) to switch between Spells.

Dive (Down + Jump while in midair): Lyra quickly descends to the ground, this move is able to jump on enemies and deal damage.

Dive Jump: Diving onto a slope and then pressing Jump will preserve Lyra's sliding speed until she lands on the ground.

Guard Crush: Using a Power Cut or an Spell against a shielded enemy will dispel their protection and leave them vulnerable to melee Attacks.

Lyra is able to cast a variety of Spells with her harp once they are obtained. These abilities include ranged attacks such as a stream of butterflies as well as self-buffs that increase Lyra's jump height and run speed. The amount of MP used correlates to a Spell's magic tier.

Spells are learned by finding one of the seven Maidens throughout Lyra's journey. The effective of Spells can also be raised by leveling up Lyra's Magic stat once she finds a Guiding Butterfly.

Within the Settings Menu of the main menu is a distinct feature that applies a palette of 4 colors onto the game to alter the visual experience. Choose between 19 different color palettes, including 4 iconic retro palettes. Along with this is an alternative 8-bit soundtrack to complement the pixel aesthetic.
store_data.detailed_description:
Deep within the Fabled Forest, Lyra the songstress was venturing back to her homeland but she is then ambushed by the Wolfskin twins, Luna and Lune. Her basket was taken by them and so Lyra sets off on a journey to reclaim her lost belongings.

Venture across the land of Clerica in this 2D Platformer with Metroidvania esque exploration. Areas shift between 2D sidescroller and top-down adventure which broaden the non-linearity of this experience. Combat is seamless with a nimble Twirl and bosses offer a great challenge that is much like the Soulslikes of today.

Z: Confirm / Attack

X: Cancel / Jump

C: Twirl

A: Spell Menu

S: Left Swap

D: Right Swap

Enter: Pause

(Control bindings can be remapped in game for both keyboard and controller.)

Twirl (C by default): Lyra performs a nimble twirl that is able to evade attacks from enemies. This move can be used during Lyra's grounded attacks.

Sprint (Keep C held down after a Twirl): Lyra enters a run state that is faster than her usual walk speed.

Power Cut (Keep Z held down after an attack): Strength is concentrated into a single attack with more range and damage. Charge is lost upon getting hit.

Cast (Up + Attack): Magic Points (MP) are used to perform a magical attack with Lyra's current Spell. Use Left Swap and Right Swap (S and D by default) to switch between Spells.

Dive (Down + Jump while in midair): Lyra quickly descends to the ground, this move is able to jump on enemies and deal damage.

Dive Jump: Diving onto a slope and then pressing Jump will preserve Lyra's sliding speed until she lands on the ground.

Guard Crush: Using a Power Cut or an Spell against a shielded enemy will dispel their protection and leave them vulnerable to melee Attacks.

store_data.about_the_game:
Flavours Beneath is an active incremental game. You take over the old tavern your aunt left behind and start making a living underground.

Fire roots into a moving track, match them up to make dishes, sell what you cook, then put the bottle caps you earn right back into the restaurant. Run things well enough, and a few potatoes might just grow into a proper business.

Let's make something to eat

Fire potatoes, radishes, sweet potatoes, and other root vegetables into the track. Get enough of the same ingredient together, and they'll turn into a dish!

A good match pulls the track back together, opens up some space, and lets you earn even more bottle caps in one go!

One after another means more money

Plan where your ingredients land so one match leads into the next.

Put that money to good use

Sell what you cook, then spend your earnings on more ingredients, permanent upgrades, and anything else that can make the old tavern look a little cooler.

For now, just focus on growing this little business.

See how much one dinner can make

A few roots might not be worth much, but that's all right.

Chains get longer, ingredients pile up, and dishes start coming out faster and faster.

By the time the kitchen can barely keep up, you'll probably have more bottle caps than you can count.

store_data.about_the_game:
THIS CITY IS YOURS.

A new city is generated every run - districts, traffic, crews, and trouble
included. How you make your name in it is up to you.

SAVE IT - OR TAKE IT.

Every action feeds MERIT or INFAMY. Stop a mugging and the block remembers;
finish the mugging yourself and the sirens do. A 12-mission branching story
locks in your path: clean the streets with Detective Reyes, or climb the
Vireo Syndicate under Vex.

FIGHT LIKE YOU MEAN IT

Real combat, or button mash: combo chains, high kicks that launch,
directional blocks and perfect-block counters, dodge rolls, and a full clinch game: grab, knee, punch, and the judo whiplash throw that sends people across the street. Attacks go where you face, so it plays
as well on a pad as a mouse. Train at the dojo, earn belts from five
masters, and test it all in THE PIT, an underground wave-survival fight club
where you walk with the pot… or risk it on one more round.

DRIFT. RACE. WRECK.

120 car models across four rarity tiers haunt the traffic pool - log them,
hunt the six legendaries, store your keepers in the garage. Race checkpoint
circuits against rivals running the same drift physics you do. Cars catch
fire, cook off, and blow debris across the intersection. Rain slicks the
roads; the radio plays original or upload your own.

OWN THE BLOCK

  • Territory - 16 districts. Wipe the turf crew, survive the
    retaliation, collect the income.
  • Gang wars - four named crews brawl over unclaimed blocks with or
    without you. Pick a side for a cut, or break it up for merit.
  • Businesses & safehouses - from a laundromat to a nightclub;
    owned districts pay 1.5×. Buy a pad, set your respawn, swap your look.

SCORE-ATTACK STATIONS

Twelve neon challenge terminals scattered through the city - DRIFT TRIAL,
SPRINT, MAYHEM (with a loaned SMG and arcade power-ups: STAR, RAPID, MEGA,
TURBO) and SURVIVAL against the district crew and its boss. Bronze, silver
and gold medals pay cash, XP and gear; gold every station of a type and the
city hands you something legendary. Instant retry - that one-more-try
feeling, no walk back.

THE ARCADE

Real playable cabinets inside the city's businesses, each a fictional
franchise with its own high-score board: STREET SERPENT II, RAT ATTACK '89,
NEON SMASH TURBO, BLOCK BUSTER 2099 - and a rare prototype hidden somewhere
in town. Own the arcade and every cabinet in the city is free play. Beat
the house #1 and it pays out.

HEAT

A five-star wanted system that escalates for real: foot patrols, pursuit
cruisers, SWAT vans, spike-strip roadblocks - and at five stars, the police
helicopter with a searchlight and a door gunner. It's shootable. Good luck.

MODDING LAB

The game ships with the tool: turn your art into playable
characters, import your own soundtrack, import/export new characters.

AND THE REST

  • 28 trackable challenges and three daily contracts with streak bonuses
  • Full character creator: builds, heights, outfits, hairstyles, faces
  • Full controller support, including menus
  • Procedural chiptune radio + original soundtrack

store_data.about_the_game:
⚠️ IN DEVELOPMENT

Champions of Thaloria is being built by a single developer and is still in

active development. Everything shown on this page — screenshots, video and

artwork — comes from a work-in-progress build. Interfaces, systems and

visuals will keep changing before release, and features may be added,

reworked or removed along the way.

What you see here is where the game is today, not where it will be at launch.






TWO GODS DESTROYED EACH OTHER. HUMANITY BUILT ITS LAST CITY UPON THE RUINS.

Long before recorded history, Aethel-Sol, the Blinding Light, and Syren-Gha, the Untamed Wild, waged a war that nearly destroyed the world. When the two gods finally fell, their powers collided with such force that the land itself was forever changed, leaving behind a vast, petrified plateau filled with unstable, lifeless energy. With nowhere else to go, humanity built its last great stronghold upon the ruins of this ancient battlefield. They named it Thaloria. For centuries, the city's walls have protected its people from the horrors beyond them, but now those walls are beginning to fail. Deep beneath the Khor-Vhal caldera, something that should have remained buried has awakened. The ancient wound left behind by the gods has opened once again, releasing a dead and light-devouring force known as the Nir-Khor. Its influence is spreading throughout the valley, forests are dying, the earth is cracking open, and ancient ruins buried for centuries are rising from beneath the ground as forgotten forces begin to stir. Yet the greatest threat may not be waiting outside the city. Thaloria has always been protected by three powerful bloodlines, but their alliance has never been built on trust. Old rivalries and ancient grudges are beginning to resurface, and as the darkness spreads beyond the walls, the city itself is starting to fracture from within. Something ancient is returning, and Thaloria may not survive what comes next.

THREE BLOODLINES. THREE LEGACIES. NO CHOSEN HEROES.

☀ PALADIN — The blood of Aethel-Sol runs through the veins of the Paladins, granting them a power no ordinary human body was ever meant to contain. Their wounds close within seconds, their bodies become stronger and harder to break, and they can survive injuries that would kill an ordinary warrior. But Aethel-Sol's gift comes with a terrible price: the more they draw upon the light, the more it consumes them from within. Every Paladin knows how their story will end, yet they continue to fight because they believe protecting Thaloria is worth the price they will eventually have to pay.

image

🌿 WIZARD — Wizards are born with the ability to channel the raw forces of nature through their own bodies. They can command fire, summon storms, manipulate the elements, and bend the forces of nature to their will. Their staffs serve as conduits, helping them control powers that would otherwise overwhelm the human body, but magic always comes at a cost. Every spell drains the Wizard's strength, and the more powerful the magic, the greater the toll it takes. With every spell they cast, they sacrifice a part of themselves to unleash the forces they have learned to control.

image

🖤 FALLEN — Generations ago, the royal guard made the ultimate sacrifice to save Thaloria from a devastating firestorm that threatened to consume the entire city. They gave up their souls and unleashed a power strong enough to stop the flames, saving countless lives in the process. But the power that saved Thaloria eventually drove the royal guard into madness, and the very people they had sworn to protect were forced to hunt them down and destroy them. Their descendants survived, but their bloodline was never forgiven. The Fallen became outcasts, feared and hated by the people of Thaloria and blamed for the sins of their ancestors. Yet whenever something emerges from the darkness that ordinary soldiers cannot face, the city still turns to them. They may be hated and feared, but when the monsters come, they are still the ones who stand between Thaloria and destruction.

image

A WORLD WORTH FIGHTING FOR

Champions of Thaloria is built around real-time party combat where every decision matters. Timing your abilities, positioning your party, managing cooldowns, and exploiting status effects can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Beyond the safety of the city, dangerous dungeons are filled with powerful enemies, deadly encounters, and bosses guarding valuable rewards. Take on these challenges, defeat the monsters, and claim the loot they protect, but remember that becoming stronger is never completely safe. The Forge allows you to upgrade your equipment and push your gear beyond its limits, but every upgrade comes with a risk, and pushing your equipment too far could mean losing everything. Guilds are more than a place to chat; players can work together, contribute to shared progression, and build something that belongs to the entire guild. With deep talent trees, every character can be shaped around an individual playstyle, allowing players to experiment with different abilities, create unique builds, and find the combinations that work best for them. As you progress through the world, you can also earn hundreds of avatars, frames, and titles to show what you have accomplished. None of these rewards can be purchased for power; they are earned through progression, achievements, and dedication.

THE ARENA DOES NOT LIE

When you enter the Arena, cosmetics stay at the door. Your avatar, frame, and title provide absolutely no combat advantage, meaning they grant no additional damage, defense, or power. Every match is governed by the same rules, and every fight is validated by the server. Every item, every drop, every piece of gold, and every combat interaction is verified server-side, ensuring that the client is never trusted. There are no shortcuts and no pay-to-win advantages. In the Arena, your cosmetics cannot save you, your purchases cannot give you an advantage, and your status means nothing. The only things that matter are your character, your decisions, your build, and the skill of the player controlling it.

THE WAR HAS BEGUN

Champions of Thaloria is being forged by Idanthyr Studios. The city still stands, the ancient darkness is awakening, and the three bloodlines are preparing for a war unlike anything Thaloria has faced before. Beyond the walls, something that was supposed to remain dead is returning, while inside the city, old rivalries threaten to destroy the fragile alliance that has kept humanity alive for generations. Thaloria has survived for centuries, but survival is no longer guaranteed. The world is ready, the war has begun, and now it is time to decide whether you will stand with Thaloria.

LOAGRITE: The Flightless Bird is a roguelite platformer where the player must reach the flagpole at the end in 10 seconds or less!  If the player can't reach the end in time, they can buy Items to make their run a lot easier to play through!

Some Items for the player include:

FUNGUS: +1 HP per level

WING BOOTS: +1 jump per level

TIN HAT: gain imperviousness when active

CLOAK: gain intangibility when active

SATURN: stops time for a few seconds

And many more for 42 Items total!

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR PARENTS BROUGHT YOU INTO THIS WORLD.

NOW MAKE THEM ANSWER FOR IT.

You never agreed to be born.

You never signed a contract.

You never agreed to the bills, the work, the pain, or the decades of life that came with it.

So there is only one reasonable thing left to do:

Sue your parents.

In Sue Your Parents, an absurd argument is treated with complete seriousness inside a courtroom.

Take the side of the child and argue that your parents should be held responsible for bringing you into this world without your consent.

Or switch sides.

Defend your parents and argue that creating a life does not create an unlimited debt to the person they created.

Every choice pushes the case in a different direction.

Question responsibility.

Attack the idea of consent.

Argue over the cost of living.

Decide whether parents owe their children anything simply because they chose to have them.

Then let the court decide.

TWO SIDES. ONE RIDICULOUS LAWSUIT.

  • Sue your parents for bringing you into this world.

  • Defend your parents against the exact same accusation.

  • Build your position through a series of courtroom choices.

  • Watch the opposing side turn your own logic against you.

  • Reach different verdicts depending on the arguments you make.

  • Replay the case from the opposite side and defend what you just attacked.

  • No dense legal jargon. The arguments are designed to be immediately understandable.

  • A short, focused courtroom game built to be played in one sitting.

There is no murder.

There is no abuse allegation.

There is no hidden family secret.

Your parents' alleged offense is that you exist.

The only question is:

SHOULD THEY HAVE TO PAY FOR IT?

store_data.about_the_game:
In Tell Me Your Tale, you take on the role of an inspector for the F.T.I.D. (Fairy Tale Inspection Department), responsible for controlling the entry of characters from fairy tales, fables, legends, and folklore. But there is one problem: not everyone is who they claim to be.

During each shift, you must interview characters, check documents, examine their appearance, inspect their belongings, and compare their answers with official records. A small detail can be the difference between letting the true character from a story pass or allowing something through the gates that never should have entered.

Each visitor can be the Original, an Impostor attempting to steal their identity, or an Aberration created from a completely distorted version of their tale.

Consult your books, follow the department’s rules, and uncover contradictions before making your decision. As the days go by, new rules, procedures, and situations will make your job increasingly complex.

Your choices have consequences. Who you approve, who you reject, and the mistakes you make during inspections can change the course of events and lead to different endings.

Observe. Question. Compare. Decide.
At the F.T.I.D., knowing the story may be the only way to discover who truly belongs in it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sans Issue is a 2D game mixing chess and card-deck building games, where you build decks and use cards to have an advantage over an opponent. 

At the beginning of each game, you start with a king, three pawns, and three cards. These cards can be played by using tokens, which are earned every turn (you also get a bonus token if you capture a piece). There is a wide variety of cards to play - you can summon other chess pieces, transport your pieces around the map, and even throw bombs onto empty spaces. 

In Sans Issue, the game ends not when you checkmate someone, but when you capture their king. There are many sneaky moves to take out an enemy’s king - you won’t always be told that you’re potentially in check! If you are checkmated, and you can’t play a card to save yourself, a timer will start playing, forcing you to make a move and abandon your king. Sans Issue - no way out.

Earn new cards via the campaign, create custom decks using the deckbuilder, and play against your friends both locally and over Steam.

store_data.about_the_game:
Veibyn's GunGame is a fast, chaotic arena shooter where every kill brings a new opportunity to become more powerful.

Instead of simply progressing through a list of weapons, kills allow you to choose between three random upgrades. Increase your fire rate, movement speed, damage, health, projectile count and more — then stack upgrades together to create increasingly ridiculous builds.

No two matches have to play the same way.

KILL. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

Every kill pushes your build further.

Choose one of three upgrades and decide how you want your fighter to evolve. Focus on raw damage, turn your weapon into a bullet-spewing machine, increase your mobility, stack additional projectiles, or combine upgrades into something completely chaotic.

Some rare upgrades can dramatically change how your build works.

By the end of a match, your simple starting weapon can become an absolute monster.

MULTIPLAYER ARENA BATTLES

Fight against other players in fast arena matches, invite friends using multiplayer codes, or jump into battle with bots filling the remaining slots.

Prefer playing alone?

Single-player matches let you fight entirely against bots while keeping the same upgrade-driven progression.

ZOMBIE SURVIVAL

Take on increasingly dangerous hordes in Zombie Survival.

Fight multiple zombie types, survive escalating waves and face powerful bosses as the match becomes progressively more difficult.

Build your character as you survive and work together to stay alive.

When a teammate falls, special upgrades can even give you the opportunity to bring them back into the fight.

The run ends when everyone is dead.

How long can you survive?

MULTIPLE ARENAS

Battle across a collection of arenas with completely different themes, including:

- Neon Circuit

- Toon Town

- Castle Siege

- Warehouse Wire

- Western Town

- Desert Pyramid

Maps can rotate between matches, keeping battles varied and unpredictable.

BUILD YOUR OWN CHAOS

There isn't one correct build.

Stack attack speed until your weapon barely stops firing.

Add more projectiles.

Increase your damage.

Become faster.

Become harder to kill.

Or combine everything and see how ridiculous your weapon can become.

Veibyn's GunGame is about starting small and becoming completely overpowered.

FEATURES

- Fast-paced arena shooter combat

- Upgrade choice after kills

- Three random upgrade choices

- Stackable upgrades

- Rare and powerful upgrades

- Multiple weapons

- Online multiplayer

- Invite-code multiplayer

- Single-player with bots

- Bots fill empty player slots

- Multiple rotating arenas

- Zombie Survival mode

- Multiple zombie types

- Boss encounters

- Revive mechanics

- Controller and keyboard & mouse support

- Builds that become increasingly chaotic as the match progresses

Enter the arena. Get the kill. Choose your upgrade. Break the game.

You bought 500,000 boxes

You spent every last cent at an auction, buying 500,000 boxes of unclaimed cargo. Now you have to process them all and turn that gamble into profit.

Grind boxes. Feed the hole. Get paid.

Throw boxes into the grinder. Take what comes out and drop it in the hole. The hole pays you money. That's the deal.

Automate everything

Unlock vacuums, trash bags, fans, and conveyors. Buy drones that collect boxes for you. Build a setup that runs on its own , then watch the piles finally start to shrink.

What took an hour on day one takes seconds later on.

What's in the boxes?

Most of it is junk. Some of it isn't. Every box was somebody's. Now it's all yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight in a wraparound space arena in this 2D top-down versus shooter.

In Solar Arena, you pilot a constantly moving craft, steering and boosting while using your weapons and barrier to outmaneuver your opponents. The arena wraps around at every edge, so enemies can reappear from the opposite side of the screen. Read your opponent’s distance and direction, adjust your position, and fight for victory.

Distinct Craft and Weapons

Each craft comes equipped with its own unique weapons, including ricochet lasers, homing shots, mines, and twin swords. Their range, attack direction, and ideal fighting distance vary greatly from one craft to another.

From 1-on-1 to 1-on-3 Battles

Enjoy everything from tense one-on-one duels to chaotic battles with attacks coming from multiple directions. As the number of enemies increases, the positioning and tactics required to survive change as well.

Customize Your Pilot

Customize your pilot’s hairstyle, colors, face, and other visual details. Your chosen appearance is reflected throughout the game, including the battle HUD and various menus.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a Factory Powered by Color

ChromaFlow is a 2D factory automation game where color is both your resource and your recipe.

Extract red, green, and blue from glowing deposits, transport them across conveyor networks, and combine them to create an expanding spectrum of increasingly complex colors. Every request from the Chroma Core presents a new production challenge—and every completed delivery brings your factory closer to mastering the full spectrum.

Turn Three Colors into an Entire Spectrum

Begin with the primary colors and learn to produce familiar combinations such as yellow, cyan, and magenta. As the campaign progresses, your recipes become increasingly elaborate.

Mix prepared ingredients, purify pigments, deepen their tones, and refine advanced colors through multi-stage production chains. Later requests require carefully planned factories in which the output of one line becomes the input of another.

Design, Expand, and Optimize

Build conveyor routes, connect extractors, balance multiple Mixer inputs, divide production with Splitters, and use storage to keep important materials flowing.

As your technology improves, entire machine families upgrade automatically. Expand your existing factory instead of replacing every machine individually, then use production statistics and diagnostic overlays to find congestion, improve utilization, and increase throughput.

Restore the Chroma Core

Progress through a ten-era campaign containing 80 color requests. New machines, recipes, research branches, and factory capabilities are introduced as you need them, allowing your production network to grow naturally from a simple RGB line into a vast chromatic industry.

Complete the campaign to unlock Infinite Spectrum, where continuing procedural contracts let you keep expanding and optimizing your finished factory.

Features

  • Extract, transport, mix, process, and deliver color as a physical resource

  • Discover and manufacture 61 named colors

  • Build increasingly complex, multi-stage production chains

  • Progress through 80 Core requests across ten technological eras

  • Unlock permanent factory-wide improvements through the Research Tree

  • Create conveyor networks with automatic routing assistance and multiple transport tiers

  • Inspect throughput, congestion, efficiency, and resource flow with diagnostic overlays

  • Explore deterministic seeded worlds with visible color deposits

  • Choose between Relaxed, Standard, Engineer, and customizable difficulty settings

  • Continue playing after the campaign with Infinite Spectrum contracts

  • Use color names, symbols, pattern cues, color-vision palettes, interface scaling, and reduced-motion options

store_data.about_the_game:
Some hide. One hunts. Only your tail can betray you.

Glow Tail is a 5-player asymmetric multiplayer horror game where every match splits your group into two very different nightmares. One player becomes the Hunter — bigger, stronger, and moving through the same dark, decaying house as everyone else, driven by one goal: catch every last Mouse before they finish what they came to do.

The rest become the Mice. Small, quick, and desperate, they scurry through vents, closets, and shadowed hallways to complete objectives scattered across the house — but there's a catch. Every Mouse has a glowing tail. It can't be hidden, can't be turned off, and in the right (or wrong) light, it's a flare telling the Hunter exactly where you are.

Features:

Asymmetric 1v4 gameplay — one Hunter, up to four Mice, every round feels different depending on who's playing what. Tension built into your own body — your glowing tail is your greatest liability. Positioning, timing, and knowing when to move (and when to freeze) is the whole game. Objective-based survival — Mice aren't just hiding, they're working against the clock to complete tasks scattered through a house that was never built to be safe. A house full of dread — dim hallways, creaking floors, and rooms that feel lived-in and wrong in equal measure. Built for groups — quick rounds, constant role-swapping, and enough chaos and betrayal-by-glow-stick to make this a go-to for horror game nights with friends.

Whether you're the one stalking the halls or the one praying your tail stays hidden just a few seconds longer, Glow Tail turns every round into a story your group will be yelling about after it's over. Some hide. One hunts. Only your tail can betray you.

Kilnborn is a fast-paced 1v1 platform fighting game where your fragile fighter shatters in just one hit. Test your platform fighter fundamentals by out-maneuvering your opponents on the battlefield and finding the perfect spot to unleash a critical strike on your foes. Fight for the glory of the kiln that created you and win, no matter who stands in your way.

EXPRESS YOURSELF WITH SIMPLE BUT UNIQUE CHARACTERS

Kilnborn's characters have a grounded attack, air attack, and dash attack that build the foundations of their gameplan. Each character controls uniquely and plays into a different archetype, so no matter who you are you'll find a character that works for you. Rush your opponent's down with the blinding speed of Ezekias or trap your opponents in a minefield of exploding souls with Dib. The choice of how to play is yours, and with a wealth of movement options available to you, there's always another skill to master.

store_data.about_the_game:
A station you were never told about

An envelope, a set of keys, and the deed to a railway station no one in your family ever spoke of. You go to see what you have been left — and find that its platforms do not lead where platforms lead.

Four cities, a century apart

Each platform opens onto a real place at a real time: Berlin, Paris, New York, Hong Kong, decades apart. You are not shown a museum of them. You walk their streets, read their signs, speak to the people standing on their corners, and pick up what they left lying around.

A clue in one era changes another

This is the whole game. Something you read in one city means nothing until a thing you find in another tells you what it was. The notebook you carry between them is the only place those two halves ever meet — and the story is what you assemble in it, not what you are told.

Quiet, first-person, unhurried

No combat, no timers, no fail state. Historiker is about looking closely and following a thread across a hundred years, at your own pace.

A preview is in development. Wishlist to hear when it opens.

A choice-driven management and narrative strategy game about leading a Norse colony in Vinland. You are handed one event at a time, each with a small set of choices, and every decision shapes the colony’s future.

Manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the fragile relationships that hold your settlement together. Guide your family and influence your heir, whose choices and ambitions may determine the legacy you leave behind.

Navigate the political climate between your colony and the native peoples of Vinland. At the same time, watch your colony’s faith slowly change as the old Norse gods contend with Christianity, whether through Rome, Constantinople, or the traditions your people refuse to abandon.

Across 50 in-game years, your choices shape not only whether the colony survives, but what kind of society it becomes... and what you leave behind.

store_data.about_the_game:
One berried female. An empty tank. Thirty-one morphs you haven't bred yet.


Shrimpscape is a shrimp keeping sim about the two things that actually decide whether a tank works: what's hidden in your shrimp's genes, and what's dissolved in your water. Everything else — the scape, the shop, the money — is built on top of those two.

Genetics that keeps secrets from you

Every shrimp carries a full genotype across a dozen loci: recessive Taiwan Bee, a red base, the blue locus behind Blue Bolt, four additive loci for white coverage, four more for spot density, the Tiger locus behind Pinto, and a three-allele eye locus where orange eyes are recessive and have to be carried on both sides. Nothing is rolled from a loot table. Two plain-looking shrimp can hold a morph between them for generations before it shows, and when it finally does, it's because of what you actually paired.

Water decides whether any of it happens

Lay the substrate, place hardscape rock and driftwood in real 3D, glue plants where you want them, aim the light, and step back to see it from any angle. Photo mode is there for the moment when it finally looks the way you pictured.

Walk out of your tank and into the aquarium store: livestock in the showcase tanks along one wall, plants and hardscape on the shelves along the other. store_data.about_the_game:
God has Died...

...leaving their Throne empty. Without them, the world is falling into ruin, with powerful entities forming cults in a bid to take the Throne. You are the Chosen of one such entity, and fated to leave this world behind as a pawn in the grand struggle.

Assemble a deck of cards to face off against horrors in a unique turn system where you're always in control. Enemy actions are on a timer, and each card you play brings them closer to acting, but it never stops beings "your turn." 

Features

1. Variable Turn System

  • Cards cost “time” instead of resources, and the actions of each enemy are tied to a timer. Each card you play counts down these timers until the enemy eventually acts. 

  • Turn order constantly changes and staggers as enemies take different actions, keeping you on your toes.

2. Skills

  • Your patron has granted you abilities that do not advance Time, but require sacrificing cards from your hand. Find use for unwanted cards and pull off last-minute actions to defeat enemies

3. Replayable Roguelike

  • Encountered enemies and cards are randomized each time you play through the game. Find different cards and mostrous factions each run. Will you be able to claim God's Throne by the end of it? 

    More to come...

    Death Knell is still relatively early in development, with plans to add more cards, enemies, features, and polish! Wishlist and follow to receive updates, and look forward to a demo later this year.

store_data.about_the_game:
A small life, at the edge of space

SPACE JK is a laid-back life sim about watching over pixel-art roommates called JK.

Decorate the room, put out some food, pat them on the head, send them off on errands, and take the sticker they drew. Days like that quietly add up.

Hatched from cosmic eggs, ten personalities

Every JK hatches from a cosmic egg, and no two look alike. There are ten personalities — cuddly, diligent, airheaded, cool — and the same moment gets a different answer from each of them.

Hey, look at me?
Did you eat properly?
...It's not like I wanted to talk
The wall said "hello"

Live together, pat them, share snacks, and they'll warm up to you in their own time.

One sticker a day

Leave a table in the room and the JKs living there will each draw you one pixel-art sticker every day. Twelve series, 144 designs, with seasonal and event artwork added little by little.

Every sticker goes into your own sticker book, arranged however you like — and you can trade with other players for the ones you'd rather have. Build the page you want.

Build the room

Choose your colors, place your furniture, and make the room yours. Six moods to set the atmosphere, and the view outside the window changes to match.

Furniture can be repainted, so the same shelf can belong to two completely different rooms.

On your own, or together

  • Add your stickers to Altair's Sticker Book, a public album the whole player base builds together
  • Trade stickers with other players through the Wish Post
  • Put everything you've collected on show in your own Moonside Gallery, open for anyone to visit
  • Welcome a JK raised by another player through JK Scout
  • And when troublesome visitors turn up from space, raids break out — everyone sees them off together

How a day goes

Your JKs run errands, throw themselves into club activities, and now and then head out on an excursion. And every so often, a letter arrives for you — from someone very fond of you.

About the browser version

SPACE JK also runs in your browser. This Steam version signs in with the same account, so you pick up right where your room left off.

What you'll need

This game runs against our servers. A constant internet connection and a free account (FaSPel ID) are required to play.

Sticker book pages, Moonside Galleries and player names created by other players appear in some parts of the game.

Special Thanks (in no particular order)

Phonemae is a short narrative incremental. Souls pass through your workshop, and you need to fill quotas. Start by manually extracting their essence, then when you're tired, you buy machines to automate. At what cost?

store_data.about_the_game:
Tank Fu is an experimental over-the-top character action fighting game. Make your tank dash, fly, and punch its way into victory by mastering all its moves and combos.

*This is a pre-alpha playtest, all aspects of the game are open for change.

Hear me out, what if tanks started fighting using martial arts? Inspired by games like Bayonetta and Hi-Fi RUSH, we prototyped a quick character action with over 16 moves for you to master and get the best score you can get.

The scoring can be accumulative as long as you keep your streak going and use a variety of moves, so don't relly too much on just a few combos.

For this simple pre-alpha playtest, you can play:

-A 4-arena tutorial to learn most of the moves.

-A 5-minute arena with endless enemies to get the highest score and compete your score against other players on the leaderboard.

Features:

-Over 16 moves to master

-Both air and ground combos

-Cinematic finisher moves

-Leaderboards

store_data.about_the_game:
● ABOUT THIS GAME

Misohagi Crossing is a visual novel adventure game set in a rural Japanese town, blending horror and mystery with a character-driven story.

The game consists of three main styles of gameplay:
visual novel sections, where you follow the story like a novel;
adventure sections, where you explore the town, talk to its residents, and gather information;
and escape-game sections, where you solve puzzles and find your way out of supernatural otherworlds.

● STORY

Hotaru Akasaki, a first-year university student, returns to Yokomizo, his father's hometown, for the first time in seven years for his grandfather's first Obon, a summer observance honoring the spirits of deceased family members.

There, he reunites with relatives he hasn't seen in years.
His cousin Inori, now so beautiful she hardly seems like the girl he remembers.
And Sayo Amano―the girl who was his first love when he was a child.

Beyond a railroad crossing surrounded by blooming misohagi flowers, Hotaru meets Sayo again.
But later that night, his cousin Shinya tells him something impossible to believe.

The entire Amano family died three years ago in what was believed to be a family murder-suicide.

Then who was the Sayo he met that day?
When Hotaru returns to her house the next day, Sayo is still there, exactly as she was before.

Sayo and her older sister Mizuho know that they are already dead.
They say they are trapped in a single summer day, repeating endlessly.

What really happened to the Amano family?
Why is Hotaru the only one who can enter the world where the dead remain?
And what is the grotesque “black flesh” that appears whenever he draws closer to the truth...?

As Hotaru speaks with the people of Yokomizo and investigates the incident from three years ago, memories he had long forgotten slowly begin to return.

Face the supernatural horror of the black flesh alongside Hotaru.
And set that frozen summer day in motion once more―

● CHARACTERS

Sayo, Hotaru & Inori

Hotaru Akasaki

A first-year university student and the protagonist of the story.
He returns to Yokomizo for the first time in seven years for his grandfather's first Obon.
As he begins retracing memories from his childhood, he becomes entangled in the mystery of an incident that occurred three years ago.

Inori Akasaki

Hotaru's cousin and the same age as him. Cheerful and straightforward, she has adored Hotaru since they were children.
She is delighted to see him again after so many years, but grows increasingly worried as he involves himself in a dangerous mystery.

Sayo Amano

Hotaru's first love from childhood. She was the one who taught him the name of the misohagi flowers and the local name for the railroad crossing.
Hotaru reunites with her for the first time in seven years―but Sayo is supposed to have died three years ago.

The Akasaki Family

Shinya (23) ― Inori's older brother. Three years ago, he had feelings for Sayo's older sister, Mizuho.

Kaori (17) ― Inori's younger sister. An otaku high school girl with a boyish way of speaking.

Shinichi (49) ― Inori's father and Hotaru's uncle. Boisterous, outgoing, and always looking after those around him.

Satomi (43) ― Inori's mother, and one of the people who keeps the lively Akasaki household running.

Setsuko (69) ― Hotaru's grandmother. She dotes on her grandchildren, though some of her views are firmly rooted in old-fashioned values.

The People of Yokomizo

The daughter of a local family-run diner.
A young man working tirelessly to revitalize the town.
Members of the volunteer fire brigade.
A Buddhist priest.
A hard-drinking old man―

Yokomizo is home to plenty of people who have little or nothing to do with the incident itself.

Explore the town and talk to its residents, and you'll discover glimpses of their pasts and everyday lives that you would never see by following the main story alone.

● EXPLORE YOKOMIZO AND DISCOVER WHAT LIES BEYOND THE MAIN STORY

The main story follows a single path.
There are no branching endings based on dialogue choices.

Instead, the adventure sections allow you to freely visit various locations around Yokomizo.

Choose a location on the map, travel there, talk to the people you find, and investigate your surroundings to gather information.

Some events are necessary to move the story forward, but wandering away from the main objective can reveal unexpected sides of the characters and glimpses of everyday life in Yokomizo.

Right beside supernatural phenomena and the shadows of past tragedies, people are preparing for the summer festival, struggling to promote their hometown, or simply gathering with neighbors for drinks.

Life in this warm, close-knit community goes on.

● ESCAPE FROM SUPERNATURAL OTHERWORLDS

At key moments in the story, Hotaru himself is dragged into strange otherworlds where supernatural phenomena occur.

Investigate suspicious locations on the screen, find items, and use them in the right places as you search for a way out.

Examining the same location while holding a particular item may also produce a different reaction.

By investigating these otherworlds yourself and searching for an escape, you can experience Hotaru's fear and tension firsthand.

Every puzzle includes both hints and full solutions accessible from the menu.
Even if escape games aren't your specialty, you can continue the story without getting permanently stuck.

● OPTIONAL EXPLORATION & COLLECTIBLES

Small discoveries are hidden even in places that have nothing to do with the main incident.

As you explore Yokomizo, you can collect:

  • Photos of the town's stray cats

  • Photos of insects you discover

  • Yokomizo's local “Seven Mysteries”

None of these collections are required to complete the story.

They are optional activities for players who want to wander off the main path, explore more of Yokomizo, and complete everything the town has to offer.

● NAVIGATION THAT KEEPS THE STORY MOVING

During the adventure sections, the screen always displays guidance based on your current progress, showing where you should go or what you should do next.

If you want to focus on the main story, simply follow the guidance and you'll always know how to proceed.

Or take a detour and discover sides of the characters that never appear in the main story, along with more of everyday life in Yokomizo.

Explore the town and experience the story at your own pace.

● FEATURES

  • A horror mystery set in rural Japan

  • A linear main story combined with freely explorable adventure sections

  • Gather information through conversations and exploration to uncover the truth behind both the incident and its characters

  • Escape-game-style puzzle sequences set in supernatural otherworlds

  • Hints and full solutions available for every puzzle

  • Navigation showing your next destination and objective

  • Optional collections featuring stray cats, insects, and Yokomizo's Seven Mysteries

  • A human drama about first love, family, home, and saying goodbye to the past

  • Regional dialects, summer festivals, Obon, local revitalization projects, and other elements of everyday life and culture in rural Japan

  • One ending

  • No voice acting

  • Estimated playtime: approximately 6–14 hours

Playtime can vary considerably depending on how much optional dialogue and exploration you choose to experience, as well as the amount of time spent solving puzzles.

store_data.about_the_game:
WHAT IS LOOTPANIC?

A multiplayer heist game for up to 12 players, set in a hillside town with 20 robbable buildings, three elevation tiers, back alleys, rooftops and exactly five black-market buyers — all of them downhill.

Money flows down. The police know it.

THE LOOP

Break in. Crack the safe. Carry the loot. Sell it before you're caught.

Every target you hit raises your wanted level, and every sale point is on the lowest tier of the map — which means almost every run ends with a chokepoint between you and your payday.

PICK A SIDE. OR DON'T.

Play as a thief and coordinate a quiet entry. Play as police and cut off the routes. Or take the mole role — trusted by the crew, paid by the badge. Voice chat is open. Everyone hears the panic.

THE TOWN

800 by 800 metres, built by hand, not by grid:
  • Downtown — the densest block, highest value, longest sightlines. When it goes wrong here, escape is vertical.
  • Suburbs — curved streets, cul-de-sacs, a network of back gardens. The cul-de-sac is a trap. The gardens are the way out.
  • Warehouse — orthogonal service grid, container gaps, rooftop crossings.
  • Trailers — one winding loop, no sightline longer than 20 metres. The best escape network on the map.
  • Farm — high ground, long views, and a cornfield to disappear into.

TOOLS OF THE TRADE

Multi-lock doors, keypad safes, security cameras, traps you place yourself, and a black market that pays less the more you flood it.

IN DEVELOPMENT

LootPanic is in active development. The map, the heist loop, the economy and the role system are playable. Voice chat, quests and progression are next.

Wishlist to get told the moment it's ready.

store_data.about_the_game:
HUNDRED FIRES: OPEN VECTOR — EPISODE 1

Infiltrate. Fight. Cut through anything in your way.

In an alternate reality shaped by the Cold War, ancient technology capable of defying the laws of physics has changed the balance of power forever.

You play as Merche, daughter of a legendary former guerrilla and an expert infiltrator, thief and fighter in her own right. As a member of Open Vector, she is tasked with recovering mysterious Ancient Weapons before they fall into the hands of the world's greatest powers.

Your katana is your primary weapon.

But it is also your most important tool.

STEALTH & KATANA COMBAT

Infiltrate secret facilities, eliminate enemies from the shadows or throw stealth out the window and fight your way through.

Your katana features both free and precision cutting, allowing you to slice through enemies and many elements of the environment. Cut cables, objects and structures to open new paths, solve environmental puzzles or simply tear through anything standing in your way.

When steel isn't enough, switch to your other weapons. Use pistols, submachine guns, medkits and powerful Ancient Weapons to deal with whatever the mission throws at you.

ACTION WHEN YOU LEAST EXPECT IT

Stealth is only part of the mission.

Expect high-speed chases, intense firefights, boss battles and explosive set pieces that take Merche far beyond the usual infiltration operation.

Ride through dangerous environments, take control of powerful machinery and face enemies that won't give you the luxury of staying hidden.

AN ALTERNATE COLD WAR

In this reality, humanity discovered technology that should never have existed.

The United States and the Soviet Union began a secret race to recover Ancient Weapons capable of changing the balance of power.

Open Vector refuses to let either side control them.

But Merche's latest mission may uncover something far more personal.

Some of the stories her father told her as a child may not have been the fantasies everyone thought they were.

A STORY THAT IS JUST BEGINNING

HUNDRED FIRES: OPEN VECTOR — EPISODE 1 is the first chapter of a new story in the Hundred Fires: The Rising of Red Star universe.

A cinematic single-player adventure combining stealth, fast-paced combat, environmental puzzles and explosive action sequences.

Discover the secrets behind the Ancient Weapons and uncover a mystery that will take Merche far beyond her original mission.

FEATURES

  • 🗡️ Fast-paced katana combat with free and precision cutting.

  • ✂️ Cut through the environment to fight, explore and solve puzzles.

  • 🕵️ Stealth and infiltration, with the freedom to choose when to stay hidden or fight your way through.

  • 🔫 A varied arsenal, including pistols, submachine guns and powerful Ancient Weapons.

  • 🧩 Environmental puzzles integrated into exploration and progression.

  • 🚁 Explosive action sequences, including high-speed chases and vehicle sequences.

  • 🤖 Boss battles and unique playable set pieces, including moments where you'll take control of something much bigger than yourself.

  • 🎬 A cinematic, story-driven adventure with a strong focus on characters, mystery and cutscenes.

  • 🌎 An alternate Cold War setting filled with secret organizations, impossible technology and ancient weapons.

  • 📖 The first episode of a new story within the Hundred Fires universe.

store_data.about_the_game:
Keep Swimming is a multiplayer underwater hide-and-seek game for two to eight players. One Diver hunts in smaller games, while a second joins larger lobbies. Everyone else disguises themselves as fish and hides among the local schools.

Diver Role

The Divers must find and catch every player fish before the hunt ends. Watch how each school moves, listen for a badly timed meal, and look for the fish that turns or bolts at the wrong moment. Scatter Pulse and Chum Bait force nearby schools to react, helping a sharp-eyed hunter spot anyone who fails to follow the crowd.

Choose each shot carefully. Catching a player fish keeps the hunt alive, but spearing an innocent fish costs Sanity.

Fish Role

Fish survive by looking like they belong. Join a school, match its speed, copy its movements, and eat before hunger gives away your hiding place. Feeding at the wrong moment could put every eye on you.

Fake a feed or flee with the school when a Diver tests your hiding place. If your cover is blown, a Panic Dash might save you. If the fish hold out long enough, Blood Tide begins. The Divers lose their weapons, the surviving fish fight back, and the hunters become the hunted.

Reef Basin

Reef Basin is an underwater hunting ground filled with coral, kelp, sand banks, bubbles, and roaming prey. Thirty decoy fish live across eleven different habitats, each with its own movement and habits. Some schools stay close together. Others drift, scatter, or break away to feed.

Learn the basin, choose the right school, and try not to look like a player pretending to be a fish.

Four Rounds

store_data.detailed_description:
Keep Swimming is a multiplayer underwater hide-and-seek game for two to eight players. One Diver hunts in smaller games, while a second joins larger lobbies. Everyone else disguises themselves as fish and hides among the local schools.

Diver Role

The Divers must find and catch every player fish before the hunt ends. Watch how each school moves, listen for a badly timed meal, and look for the fish that turns or bolts at the wrong moment. Scatter Pulse and Chum Bait force nearby schools to react, helping a sharp-eyed hunter spot anyone who fails to follow the crowd.

Choose each shot carefully. Catching a player fish keeps the hunt alive, but spearing an innocent fish costs Sanity.

Fish Role

Fish survive by looking like they belong. Join a school, match its speed, copy its movements, and eat before hunger gives away your hiding place. Feeding at the wrong moment could put every eye on you.

Fake a feed or flee with the school when a Diver tests your hiding place. If your cover is blown, a Panic Dash might save you. If the fish hold out long enough, Blood Tide begins. The Divers lose their weapons, the surviving fish fight back, and the hunters become the hunted.

Reef Basin

Reef Basin is an underwater hunting ground filled with coral, kelp, sand banks, bubbles, and roaming prey. Thirty decoy fish live across eleven different habitats, each with its own movement and habits. Some schools stay close together. Others drift, scatter, or break away to feed.

Learn the basin, choose the right school, and try not to look like a player pretending to be a fish.

Four Rounds

When the expedition ends, the player with the highest score wins. Whatever happens, keep swimming.
store_data.short_description: One or two Divers hunt up to six friends hiding among schools of fish in an underwater game of hide-and-seek. Copy the locals, stay fed and don’t give the hunters a clean shot. Just keep swimming...

A board game roguelike featuring acrylic pieces and multi-sided dice!

Experience the creative synergy of various items and their combinations—each class offers multiple roguelike builds to explore. There are multiple ways to clear the stage.

What if you're unlucky and fail to form a powerful team? Use the weather, use the terrain, use the environment.

Cooperate, compete, or betray? Each game offers a different storyline.

Beyond combat, you can also choose items that enhance dialogue to take alternative paths—perhaps an unexpected storyline turns out to be the best one.

Everyone has their own unique traits, and bosses are no exception.

Gather sufficient information—through dialogue or combat—about each boss's strengths and weaknesses, enter the Reflection Realm, and use your knowledge and strategy to challenge each floor's boss with maximum advantage.

**You’re the president. Secretary Misaki helps keep the company alive.**

A macro management simulation of an IT firm. You don’t micromanage every employee — you steer sales, managers, and engineers as factions, watch cash, reputation, and management points, and grow the company through contracts, staffing, and services.

**Three ways to make money**

- **Contracts** — Bid on projects, assign staff, and deliver. Weigh fail risk and parallel limits.

- **Staffing** — A steadier income pillar. Fill client slots within tech and capacity caps.

- **Services** — Develop and go live for recurring revenue and tech growth.

**Balance inside the company decides everything**

Use pay bands, privileges, and policy to manage faction unrest and growth. Cultivate outsource partners to cover shortfalls — but lean on them too hard and reputation suffers.

**Play your way**

- **Tutorial** — A short training guided by Misaki

- **Free Play** — No clear condition; register on the local ranking at the 10-year mark

- **Scenarios** — Timed goals such as “Black SI Revival” and “Exit SES”

Localized in Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese. Save/load, monthly P&L, and annual reports support long campaigns.

Keep the company running — one month at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a miner, and you are almost done.

Forty years in the belt. One cell of charge per shift, a tractor beam, and three tools that each know one job. Cut a meteor open, take what's inside, sell it to people who need it. Put what's left into the fund.

When the fund is full, you retire. To a planet you have only seen in a brochure, where someone is waiting who was a child last time you visited.

That's the whole game. Nothing chases you. Nothing runs out. The belt will still be here tomorrow.

The right tool for the layer

Every meteor is built in layers: a dull crust, something better underneath, and sometimes a core worth the whole shift.

  • SHOCK strips the shell fast, and wastes ore doing it.
  • LASER is the workhorse that can do anything, slowly.
  • ION draws a clean line and splits the rock open without losing a gram.

Any tool cuts anything. The right one just does it better.

A shift at a time

Scan the field. Pick your rock. Work it down layer by layer while the sun drops behind the belt.

Dock. Sell to the orders on the board. Spend on the pod or the station. Decide how much goes into the fund this time.

Then do it again, for as long as you like.

The people on the board

Orders come from people. A foreman whose crew broke the thing that makes the other things. A widow keeping her husband's ship running. A robot with no reasons, only wants.

Between belts you'll meet stranger things: a buoy selling equipment that does not work in zero gravity, a broadcast about who really owns the rocks, a memorial nobody maintains, a man in a too-tight shirt explaining why saving for retirement is a waste of your time.

The fund

Deposits are one-way. The bar fills slowly, then all at once, and one day the station tells you that you are done.

Or you leave early. That's allowed too. The game never punishes you for it, but it will remember.

What's in it

  • Real layered destruction, cut with actual geometry
  • Three tools with three jobs, and drones that learn to help
  • Sixteen encounters, most of which want something from you
  • A cockpit that fills up with things you kept
  • Two endings, both of them yours
  • No death, no fail states, no timer on anything
  • Built for Steam Deck first

store_data.about_the_game:
RTS - Tower Defense - MOBA

Inspired by the strategic depth of StarCraft, the hero-driven combat of Warcraft 3, and the gritty charm of KKnD 2.

Fight across three-lane maps inspired by League of Legends and Dota — with richer detail and interactive environments. Every match demands you manage three layers of action simultaneously:

Defend & Expand — Build towers and structures, upgrade them to unlock new units and widen your perimeter.

Control Production — Manage unit output and direct which of the three lanes they attack.

Lead the Frontline — Pilot your hero to push lanes and break through the enemy's defenses.

A single currency drives everything: Energy. Generate it through oil refineries, wind turbines, or solar arrays — your choice of power defines your strategy.

Story

Thousands of years after the fourth nuclear war, Earth's soil finally recovered. The Series 37 agricultural robots — the last of their kind — had been replanting the world for centuries, tending to a seed bank deep beneath the ashes.

For the humans, of course.

They're gone. The fields are not.

Then the anomalies appeared. Strange creatures emerged from the earth and the radio-toxic air. Mysterious forces wreck the reclaimed fields and forests. Laser-shooting dinosaurs roam the ruins.

Something is very wrong with this world.

Key Features

Three-Lane Combat — Fight across maps inspired by LoL and Dota, with interactive environments and strategic depth.
Three Layers of Gameplay — Defend & expand your base, control unit production, and lead the frontline as your hero.
Energy Economy — Choose your power source: oil refineries, wind turbines, or solar arrays. Your economy shapes your strategy.
Tower Defense Meets MOBA — Build and upgrade towers, unlock new units, and push lanes with your hero unit.
Post-Apocalyptic World — Explore a unique setting of reclaimed Earth, rogue agricultural robots, and mysterious anomalies.
1vs1 Multiplayer — Head-to-head matches that test your strategy and skill.
2 Player Co-op — Fight against the anomalies together with a friend.
Steam Deck Supported — Play comfortably on Steam Deck with full controller support.

From now on, you must survive as a single ant in a brutal financial market. You can take on risk and pour all your money into high-stakes products — or play it safe, manage your portfolio, and use hedging to come through even a bear market unscathed.

Keep one thing in mind: this is a survival simulation. Losing to the market is nothing to be ashamed of. The real question is how you'll read it, attack it, and manage your risk.

Features

ANT SIMULATOR models the following aspects of the Korean stock market.

Amplified Volatility

The market in ANT SIMULATOR is modeled on the real Korean market, but it compresses months of movement into 10–40 days — so volatility is deliberately set higher than reality, letting you live through both bull and bear markets in a single short session.

  • Median daily volatility of the ANTPI: 2.08%

  • Median annualized volatility of the ANTPI: 33.04% (5th–95th percentile: 26.49%–39.04%)

For reference, the real 2025 KOSPI had daily volatility of roughly 0.5–0.7%, or about 8–11% annualized. This game's market swings roughly 3–4× harder than the real one — an intentional design choice so you feel the full drama of the market within a compressed playtime.

(For comparison, the VKOSPI — the volatility the options market expects — stood at about 28.9% at the end of 2025. It's a different kind of metric and not directly comparable, but it helps gauge how volatile this game feels.)

Note: 2026 is not yet over and its volatility has been unusually high, so we use 2025 as the baseline for comparison.

Market Safeguards

  • Circuit Breaker — When prices fall sharply and suddenly, trading is halted temporarily to absorb the shock to the market.

  • Sidecar — Triggers to cushion immediate shocks, curbing the chaos that sharp futures swings can spill into the spot market.

  • Volatility Interruption (VI) — When a single stock's price spikes or plunges in an instant, that stock briefly switches to single-price auction trading to cool the volatility down.

And more

  • Sector cycle ignition

  • Leading-stock drift

  • News/event gaps and lingering news pressure

  • Foreign-investor momentum

  • Institutional value & cycle judgment

  • Retail attention / FOMO

  • Order impact and general price impact

What's the Same, and What's Different, from the Real Market

ANT SIMULATOR is modeled on the real stock market, but it's deliberately built to be approachable and to play like a game.

  • Global markets — Their direction is linked to the domestic index, but only the core linkage is kept; other variables are compressed.

  • Exchange rates & foreign investors — FX and foreign flows are intertwined, with the relationship simplified for readability.

  • Oil & airlines — Rising oil prices weigh on airlines and travel; secondary cost and demand variables are kept restrained.

  • Corporate metrics — PER, PBR, ROE and more are used — but financial structures are generated virtually and at random.

  • Investor flows — You watch retail, institutional, and foreign flows, though the full real order book is not reproduced.

  • Market safeguards — VI, circuit breakers, and the like are active, tuned to the compressed timescale.

  • Volatility — Rallies, declines, and sudden crashes all occur, compressing months of movement into 10–40 days.

  • Information — You make decisions from multiple indicators, but real-world opacity such as disinformation and disclosure delays is mostly removed.

We also deliberately reduced the proportion of NPC retail investors, to reinforce your position as a lone ant.

This game is a virtual simulation for educational and entertainment purposes. It does not provide investment advice or real returns.

Engine & Measured Data

The engine behind ANT SIMULATOR is precisely designed and tuned, yet built to be very lightweight — and purpose-built for the Korean market. It moves in ways that are controllable at the level of overall supply and demand, yet unpredictable in the moment. So — sorry, chart-analysis fans — the charts here are best read purely as the result of how the market moved. (That's exactly what makes them honest!)

Correlations

Macro-correlation bar chart

This market is full of interlocking relationships. When oil rises, airlines and travel are pressured; when global indices climb, the domestic market follows; exchange rates and foreign flows react in turn. These relationships were measured across 500 simulations, and their directions match the real market.

A Different Market Every Time — With a Consistent Distribution

We used Monte Carlo analysis to tune and balance the engine. Across 500 independent runs, a different market emerged every time — yet gather up the final index values and they trace the stable distribution above (mean 2510, standard deviation 61.9). In other words: any single game is unpredictable, but the market as a whole holds consistent statistical properties.

Day-to-day movement, however, is another story. Daily returns aren't normally distributed — they have fat tails, so most days are calm, but every so often the market crashes or spikes far harder than a normal distribution would ever predict. Hard to forecast, and that's what makes it thrilling — and infuriating.

Now It's Your Turn

The market is always cold and unpredictable. But in ANT SIMULATOR, even that uncertainty becomes something you can turn into strategy. Don't just leave it to luck — read the flow of the data, manage your risk, and sometimes bet boldly, living the fierce life of an ant investor. When the market shakes you, what will you choose?

Launch ANT SIMULATOR now, and prove your own survival strategy in a brutal financial market.
