store_data.about_the_game:
An island completely buried in trash, an endless ocean, and a new life you have to build from scratch.

Welcome to Trash Island!

Play solo or team up in 1-4 player co-op as you collect, sort, grind, and transform garbage into useful materials. Almost everything you find while cleaning the island can become a valuable resource for building your new life.

COLLECT, PROCESS, AND CRAFT

Old plastics, metal scraps, wooden planks, and all kinds of waste are scattered across the island.

Collect the trash, sort it, and grind it down into usable materials. Process things that look worthless at first, craft new items, and slowly build a system that works for you.

Because on Trash Island, there is no such thing as garbage. There are only materials you have not used yet.

BUILD YOUR OWN TRASH ISLAND

Do more than simply get rid of what you collect. Use it to create a place you can actually live in.

Build a small shelter, set up work areas, create storage spaces, and keep developing your island.

The more trash you collect, the more materials you have to work with. And the more materials you have, the more you can build.

HEAD OUT TO SEA

The adventure does not end at the shoreline.

Use the junk you find on the island to build your own boat and head out onto the ocean. Search through floating debris, discover valuable materials, and bring your findings back to the island.

The farther you travel from shore, the less you know about what might be waiting for you.

KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE HORIZON

Do not forget to watch the sea and the sky.

Ships and helicopters may occasionally pass near the island. Sometimes they leave behind ordinary trash. Other times, they may drop much rarer and more valuable pieces.

Spot them in time, chase them down, and try to grab the best materials before they disappear.

CLEAN UP THE ISLAND

Beneath all those piles of garbage, there is still an island waiting to be saved.

Watch the environment change as you clear away the waste. Take a filthy, abandoned dumping ground and gradually transform it into a place you can actually live.

Every pile of trash you remove reveals a little more of the island underneath.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Clean up Trash Island on your own or team up with friends in a 1-4 player co-op experience.

Split up the work, search for different resources, head out to sea together, and develop the island as a team.

Or ignore the plan completely, do whatever you want, and somehow turn the island into an even bigger mess than when you started.

Collect. Grind. Transform. Build. Set sail.

Trash Island is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grow your herd. Don't run out of grass.

Start with a small pasture and a handful of rabbits. Then watch your ranch come to life.

Your animals move, graze, and reproduce on their own. As the herd grows, so does its appetite. Grass disappears, space runs short, and seemingly easy growth soon becomes a strategic challenge.

Let the herd keep breeding or sell some of it? Exchange animals for more valuable species or spend your resources on new land? Invest in protection or risk it and keep pushing for more cows?

In Herd League, the rules are simple. The decisions are anything but.

Breed, exchange, and grow your herd

Exchange rabbits for sheep, sheep for pigs, pigs for cows, and eventually cows for horses.

In the settings, you can choose whether pigs or goats appear in your herd. The choice is cosmetic and does not change the rules or game balance.

Fast-breeding animals can accelerate your growth, but every new animal eats grass and takes up valuable pasture space. Let your herd grow too large and reproduction may slow down or stop entirely as food runs short.

Sometimes the fastest-breeding animals are the most profitable to sell.

Manage your pasture

Grass is one of the most important resources on your ranch.

A small herd can easily thrive on a modest pasture. A rapidly growing one cannot. Watch the land change under grazing pressure, expand your ranch into neighboring plots, and decide how aggressively you want to grow.

Weather and changing conditions can make life harder even on a well-managed ranch.

Trade on a shared market

Turn animals into cash and use it to fund expansion and protection.

Market prices change over time and respond to activity during the match. Sell when prices are favorable, keep valuable animals for further breeding, or liquidate part of your herd when you urgently need a new plot or better protection.

Other players cannot interfere with your ranch directly, but their decisions can still affect the shared market you all rely on.

Protect what you've built

A growing herd attracts unwanted attention.

Upgrade your fences and bring in guard dogs before the wolves arrive. Better protection reduces the risk of losing valuable animals, but every expense devoted to security uses funds you cannot spend on further growth.

Sometimes the safest ranch is not the fastest-growing one.

Race for the cows

The rules of Cow Race are simple: be the first to reach the required cow count.

Every decision brings you closer to that goal. Maintain a large, efficiently breeding herd, make bold exchanges, expand your land early, protect what you have, and react when your rivals begin to pull ahead.

Play solo against bots or compete online in matches for up to 12 participants. Bots can fill open slots, so you do not need a full lobby to start the race.

More than numbers

You can see your progress directly on the pasture.

The herd grows larger. Grass disappears beneath hungry animals. New plots expand the ranch. Dogs patrol its borders. Wolves put your defenses to the test.

What begins with a few rabbits can become an enormous herd fighting for the last patches of healthy pasture.

Grow the herd. Manage the pasture. Win the league.

store_data.about_the_game:
The castle does not hold itself.

You are one of five wardens standing a vigil at the end of the world. The horde comes in waves. The dead do not stay dead.

Five classes, five ways to die badly.

  • Tank — the wall the horde breaks against. Hold the line, ring the peal, refuse to move.

  • Berserker — slaughter as rhythm. Keep the tempo or lose the fire.

  • Mage — reality as a rough draft. Comets, wards, and a great deal of standing still.

  • Rogue — in, out, and gone before the wound registers.

  • Hunter — mark the quarry, plant the cairn, and let nothing leave the courtyard.

Each carries its own kit, its own passive rhythm, and its own set of talents to sink shards into.

The forge rewrites you between waves.

Improve your kit looting runes from downed mobs, by unlocking talent vaults or forging your soul by consuming relics.

The bosses await in the crypt.

Four wardens of the castle wait in the darkness. Morthain. The Hollow Bell. Skarn. Vaskha. Which one answers, no one knows.

And then it does not stop.

Endless mode takes the brakes off entirely. There is no victory screen down there — only a number, and the question of whether you can beat the one you left last time.

What's in the box;

Endless fun in a run— a whole vigil in one sitting

Five classes with distinct kits, passives and talent trees

A dust economy of doors, traps and set-pieces that punishes hoarding and greed equally

Four rotating bosses

Endless mode with a persistent record to beat

22 achievements and lifetime kill statistics for every enemy and boss in the game

Difficulty presets from Normal to Nightmare

Fully playable in 21 languages

store_data.about_the_game:
«MORTAROT — a card roguelike where Death deals the cards, and the price is the same for all.»


A GAME WITH DEATH

Death waits at the table and invites you to play. You play only with her deck, and she deals the cards herself. It's yours to decide — which to turn over, and when to leave the table.

  • Draw cards from the spread, one at a time

  • Take what's yours and go one circle deeper, or tempt fate once more

  • Pass twelve circles and walk away alive

  • Lose, and start over — the runs are short

    KNOWLEDGE BEATS LUCK

    Here knowledge is worth more than gold. Death won't catch off guard the one who can read the table.

store_data.about_the_game:
Incident Number Eight is a hardcore third-person 3D platformer. You are Number Eight, a volunteer with amnesia. To remember what led to the disaster, you relive the recordings from your helmet. Each video is a high-speed sprint through the corners of a pocket universe created for secret experiments.

The protagonist awakens in a medical capsule, wearing only underwear and no spacesuit. Her consciousness is a blank slate. No name, no understanding of how she ended up here. As soon as she leaves the medical capsule, the doors open and she is greeted by a robot assistant who identifies her only as "Number Eight".

The robot informs her that her helmet awaits in the next room, connected to computers. The recordings on it have survived, and they can be used to reconstruct her memory.

Each individual recording is a level, a deadly obstacle course of spikes, lasers, and hostile drones.

On the way to her goal, she will have to overcome obstacles using gravity, portals, teleports, dashes, and other abilities, all while managing her oxygen and spacesuit's energy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rogue’s Dark Descent is a traditional roguelike set in a procedural world built to be explored rather than simply cleared.

Travel across wilderness, settlements, ruins, caves, and forgotten underground places while searching for equipment, artifacts, supplies, and pieces of the world’s history. Day turns to night, danger grows as you travel farther from safety, and each expedition develops its own story.

Combat is tactical and deliberate. Use weapons, magic, potions, equipment, and the environment to survive encounters with creatures above and below the surface. You may also meet people along the way—some simply trying to survive, others offering quests, information, or the chance to travel beside you.

The world has a history, but it is not handed to you all at once. Records, conversations, locations, artifacts, and conflicting accounts gradually reveal what happened here and what may still be waiting in the depths below.

Death is permanent. Saves exist to continue a living run, not to undo mistakes. When a character dies, that journey ends—and they are remembered.

Features

  • Explore a procedurally generated world of wilderness, settlements, buildings, ruins, and forgotten places below.

  • Fight tactical turn-based battles using weapons, magic, equipment, potions, artifacts, and the environment.

  • Discover lore through exploration, conversations, records, ruins, and environmental storytelling.

  • Meet procedural NPCs, take on quests, and recruit optional companions.

  • Experience changing visibility and danger through a full day-and-night cycle.

  • Find unusual locations and artifacts with mechanics and stories of their own.

  • Build a character through attributes, equipment, discoveries, and what you manage to survive.

  • Face true roguelike permadeath: one life, one evolving save, and no reloading an earlier checkpoint when things go wrong.

store_data.about_the_game:
From a jungle strip to a major aviation hub. Airport Madness: Evolution is the next chapter in two decades of Airport Madness gameplay. Hidden deep in the jungle, a single dirt strip cuts through the dense canopy. Two aircraft. A few weathered buildings. And the beginning of something much bigger.

Every airport in Airport Madness: Evolution begins small. Remote. Limited. Quiet. But not for long. This is a whole new direction for the series: airports that evolve over time.

You begin with a humble airfield. One runway, long enough for a twin engine to land, no gates, and a trickle of traffic. As demand grows, the airport grows with it: more runways, taxiways, gates, and aprons, transforming into a high-pressure international hub before your eyes.

Manage traffic across five distinct locations:

  • A Caribbean island paradise

  • A Swiss Alps mountain resort

  • A dense North American big-city hub

  • A tropical jungle gateway

  • A massive Middle Eastern desert mega-hub

What's new in Airport Madness: Evolution:

  • Airports That Evolve. Watch your airfield grow from a single dirt strip into a sprawling international hub as traffic demands increase.

  • 50 All-New Aircraft. Aircraft models inspired by real-world airlines.

  • Next-Gen Scenery. A brand-new terrain generation system delivers vastly improved landscapes.

  • Richer Environments. More realistic surroundings, including improved trees and foliage.

  • New Controller Tools. Stop/Go taxi control, and "Make 360" instructions for sharper airborne sequencing.

Five airports at launch, with more on the way!

Kitty Needs a Home! is a warm little story about a small backyard that finds homes for cats all over the world.

Jane has flown off to save a shelter far away, and left the yard in your hands. Catch cats, upgrade the shelter, read letters — from a snowman by the ice rink to an alien with a dead-battery flying saucer — and find every whiskered friend the perfect home.

💌 44 clients — 44 little stories. Programmers, ballerinas, firefighters, rock stars, and one very lonely zombie fighter. Fulfill a request — get a postcard for your Endings Album.

🌍 Spread kindness across the world. Level up geo-zones and send cats off to London, Tokyo, Houston, and Dubai.

🔮 Branching quests. Strange glowing grass, a flying saucer, and letters that only arrive at night… Some stories will find you on their own.

😴 Plays while you sleep. The shelter runs without you: hearts drip in, letters pile up. And "Catcher Mode" turns the game into a sweet little desktop companion in the corner of your screen.

❤️ And, of course, Jane. Every cat you find a home for brings the end of this story a little closer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Handlebar is a first-person downhill roguelike about descending strange worlds at extreme speed.

Ride down procedurally generated mountains, search for the portal to the next realm, and build a growing contraption of powerful devices directly on your handlebar.

No tricks to perform, no extreme sports career rivalries. Just you, your bike, and the descent through nature-inspired worlds.

Extreme Speed

Handlebar uses visceral simcade bike physics built around high-speed descending. You'll fly down steep terrain, regret taking YOLO blind jumps, and narrowly avoid death while speeding through a dense forest.

The faster you ride, the better upgrades you'll receive for your build. Later stages will put that build to the test, as endgame levels may even prevent you from slowing down at all.

Strange Worlds

Descend through surreal mountain realms with a stylized, nature-inspired art direction and changing weather, lighting, and atmosphere.

Follow the path towards the exit portal, or leave it behind to cut corners, search for secrets, and find your own route. The wilderness will not guide you back if you get lost.

Build Your Handlebar

Every item you collect is physically mounted to your bike and remains visible while you ride.

Combine navigation tools, recovery systems, defensive devices, active abilities, and stranger machinery into powerful synergies that operate in real time as you progress through the run.

Control Your Run

After every descent, choose where to go next.

Take a dangerous route for greater rewards, or use an easier stage to recover and strengthen your build. Narrower paths, total darkness, hostile weather, low gravity, and powerful curses gradually push each run further.

Reach the end, or die and try again.

store_data.about_the_game:
A city full of cats, and all of them are hiding


Istanbul has more cats than it has people who admit to feeding them. This is a game about finding them.

Six storybook neighbourhoods, from the steep streets under the Galata Tower to the arches of the Grand Bazaar and the ferry docks at Karakoy. Every scene is packed with the small business of a city at golden hour: crates of fruit, hanging lanterns, laundry, tea glasses, barrels, bicycles. And somewhere in all of it, cats. On awnings, behind railings, inside baskets, watching from upstairs windows.

How it plays


  • Look, and click. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Find a cat, it answers with a meow and settles in with a small gold ring.
  • No timers and no losing. Nothing runs out. Nothing punishes you for taking your time or for putting it down for a week.
  • A hint when you want one. Stuck on the last cat? Ask, and it will be ringed for a moment. There is no penalty and no limit; being stuck is not the fun part.
  • Bonus objects. A simit, a glass of tea, an evil eye bead, a fish, a mussel, tucked into every scene. Entirely optional. Every one of them sounds like the thing it is when you find it.

What is in it


  • 6 storybook scenes
  • 104 cats, each one placed by hand and named
  • 29 bonus objects across 5 kinds
  • 28 Steam achievements, 8 of them hidden
  • Full English and Turkish, text and interface

Made to be put down


Scenes take somewhere between five and twenty minutes depending on how carefully you look. Every scene remembers that you finished it, but starts fresh when you open it again, so a scene you loved is worth going back to rather than being spent.

Made with the Godot Engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Esports Dynasty Manager is an esports management game where you take control of a professional organization in a fictional competitive MOBA scene.

Your job goes far beyond choosing five players. Build the right roster, scout new talent, hire staff, manage salaries and sponsorships, improve your infrastructure, study your opponents, and prepare your team for every series.

Every great organization begins with difficult decisions. Balance immediate results with long-term development, choose where to invest, and create an identity capable of surviving bad seasons, meta shifts, and the pressure to win trophies.

Every player has unique traits, potential, specialties, and a personal hero pool. Find the right balance between Hard Carry, Mid, Offlane, Support 4, and Support 5, follow your players’ development, and decide when to renew, negotiate, or search for a new star.

TRAIN, ADAPT, EVOLVE

Set training priorities, manage fatigue, and improve individual and team attributes. The meta changes, heroes rise and fall in priority, and a strategy that dominates today may fail at the next major tournament.

Study your opponent, consider each player’s signature heroes, build strong synergies, and prepare your picks and bans. A great draft can create a path to victory before the first fight even begins.

See your strategy come to life in a tactical MOBA simulation divided into Early, Mid, and Late Game. Movement, map control, objectives, team fights, kills, and momentum help tell the story of every match.

A LIVING ESPORTS WORLD

Other organizations sign, sell, develop, and struggle too. Follow transfers, rivalries, records, upsets, rising stars, and teams that may dominate a region — or fall apart after a difficult season.

FROM REGIONAL LEAGUES TO THE WORLD STAGE

Compete in regional leagues, fight for promotion, avoid relegation, and earn your place in the biggest international tournaments. Every season adds a new chapter to your organization’s story.

• A fictional esports world built around competitive MOBA.

• Hundreds of players and organizations to follow, sign, and face.

• Five-player rosters with distinct roles.

• Scouting, transfers, contracts, and staff management.

• Player development, potential, fatigue, and hero mastery.

• Tactical training and team development.

• Drafting shaped by the meta, synergy, hero pools, and opponent tendencies.

• Match simulation covering Early, Mid, and Late Game.

• Regional leagues, promotion, relegation, and international tournaments.

• Sponsorships, salaries, prize money, and infrastructure upgrades.

• News, rivalries, records, and emergent stories across multiple seasons.

You are building a dynasty.

store_data.about_the_game:
Paint your own path! Parkour to escape from hunters in this colorful funny tag game!

Brush Rush!

Its the meccha (super) fun game of tag we all grew playing... except with magical paint brushes, paint shotguns, a pair of boxing gloves, and insane parkour skills!

Put on some special boxing gloves!

As the Hunter, you’ll be equipped with special boxing gloves that do more than just pack a punch. Use them to lunge and leap farther in any direction, giving you the mobility you need to catch those pesky Painters!

Paint your path!

As a Runner, you can paint 3D platforms out of thin air to create your own escape routes. Climb onto rooftops, slide down slopes, bridge large gaps, or block the Hunter’s path. Paint wherever you need to go!

Test your aim with the paint shotgun!

If you are unable to catch the runners with boxing gloves alone, don't worry, you can shoot them down with your trusty paint shotgun. Or atleast destroy their paint paths so they are easier to catch!

Proximity Voice Chat!

Voice chat adds a ton of humor to the game. Some of the funniest moments happen when you hear the painters running and screaming as you chase them!

Multiplayer!

The more the merrier! Play with friends, foes, or even randos in this funny and exciting multiplayer tag game. 2-12 players is our recommended party size!

Videos and Streaming

We strongly encourage to post videos and go live on stream. We only ask 2 things

  • Include the name of the game in the title

  • Include a link to the steam store page in the description

We hope you have a blast!

DRIFT. FIGHT. SURVIVE.


WANTED DRIFT throws you into an endless neon city where every run becomes a faster, louder fight for one more Wanted level. Drift through traffic, weaponize your car on the move, and stay ahead as a routine pursuit grows into a screen-filling swarm.

CHOOSE YOUR CAR. BUILD THE REST.


Choose a car and its starting weapon, then let the run decide what comes next. Unlock more cars for the garage and start future runs with a different way to fight.

EVERY CRATE IS A DECISION


Open loot crates without leaving the chase. Take a weapon level or change the whole build with more damage, critical chance, projectile speed, area, fire rate, and other stat upgrades. By late game, four weapons are clearing the streets around you at once.

THE CITY IS NOT SCENERY


Fences, traffic lights, benches, trees, and anything else in your line become part of the crash. Cut through a park, tear across a sidewalk, or let the pursuit destroy the route behind you.

THE CHASE NEVER STOPS GROWING


Wanted levels keep climbing. More police enter the pursuit, tougher units join the chase, elite enemies raise the stakes, and the city turns into a moving battlefield. Survive longer, push your score higher, and find out how much pressure your build can handle.

KEY FEATURES


  • Fast arcade drifting designed to stay controllable at pursuit speed
  • Four-weapon vehicle combat that builds during each run
  • Meaningful loot choices between weapon levels and stat upgrades
  • Escalating Wanted levels with tougher units, drones, and elite enemies
  • An endless neon city with a seamless day-to-night cycle
  • Destructible streets, explosive crashes, and environmental chaos
  • Unlockable cars with different starting weapons
  • Steam achievements, Steam Cloud, and full controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
Drop your pickaxes, mine resources, and build your way to riches!

Plinko Mining is a relaxing yet addictive incremental idle mining game where mining meets the satisfying chaos of Plinko. Drop your pickaxes into a field of rocks and watch them bounce, collide, and smash through valuable resources with every hit.

Start small with basic tools and simple materials. As you keep mining, you'll slowly build up your operation, unlock new resources, discover powerful pickaxes, and turn a humble mining site into a highly efficient resource-generating machine.

Every upgrade makes a difference. Every new pickaxe gives you another way to improve your production. And as your operation grows, you'll constantly feel that satisfying sense of progression as numbers get bigger, your mining becomes faster, and your setup becomes more powerful.

Mine, Upgrade, Repeat

Every run gives you resources and experience that can be invested back into your mining operation. Increase your pickaxe count, improve their speed, boost your resource production, increase your income, and unlock new ways to make your mine even more efficient.

The progression starts slow, but that's part of the fun. Build your operation piece by piece, watch it gradually come to life, and eventually see your mining field turn into a powerful resource-producing machine.

With a variety of pickaxes to unlock, each progression step brings something new to chase. Keep upgrading, keep experimenting, and find the setup that lets you push your earnings even further.

Grow Your Skill Tree

Your progress isn't just about bigger numbers. Use your experience to expand a Skill Tree filled with powerful upgrades and permanent bonuses.

Choose the skills that fit your playstyle and shape your mining operation around them. Improve mining speed, resource production, income, pickaxe efficiency, and more as you unlock deeper parts of the tree.

Every choice helps you push a little further, giving you another reason to come back and see how much stronger your operation can become.

Satisfying Mining Chaos

There's something incredibly satisfying about watching your pickaxes bounce through the mine, hit rocks, trigger resource drops, and keep the whole operation moving.

Drop your tools, sit back, and watch the numbers climb as your mine works for you. Whether you're actively optimizing your upgrades or simply checking in to collect your earnings, Plinko Mining is designed around that satisfying "just one more upgrade" feeling.

Build Your Mining Empire

  • Drop pickaxes and watch them bounce through the mine

  • Smash rocks and extract resources with every hit

  • Unlock a variety of increasingly powerful pickaxes

  • Discover new and more valuable resources as you progress

  • Increase your pickaxe count and mining speed

  • Boost production, income, and overall efficiency

  • Expand your Skill Tree with powerful permanent upgrades

  • Gradually transform a small mining operation into a massive resource-generating machine

  • Chase bigger numbers and optimize your progression

  • Unlock achievements and complete challenges along the way

  • Enjoy a relaxing idle experience with satisfying incremental progression

  • Keep coming back for new upgrades, milestones, and bigger rewards

Start small. Mine a little. Upgrade a little. Then watch your entire operation take off.

How far can you take your mining empire?

store_data.about_the_game:
A perforated chassis, a box of parts, and a robot that has to roll. You bolt the mechanics underneath, you wire the electrics on top, you switch it on — and then you find out what you got wrong.

Build with real parts

Solenoids, gears from 8 to 32 teeth, connecting rods, crank pins, bearings, shafts, drive wheels, flywheels, a contact breaker, capacitors, a resistor, a switch. Every part has a data sheet, real dimensions and a place where it fits. Nothing snaps magically into position: if your two shafts sit a few millimetres too far apart, the gears will not mesh, and the game will tell you by how much.

Nothing is faked

Ten thousand times a second, the game solves a real system of equations to find the voltage at every point of your build and the current in every wire. That is why your machine behaves like a machine. It stalls at dead centre until you fit a flywheel. Your breaker contacts erode spark by spark until they stop conducting — and a capacitor in the right place will save them. The connecting rod tears off if you stretch the linkage too far.

Every failure has a cause, and you can find it

A perforated chassis, a box of parts, and a robot that has to roll. You bolt the mechanics underneath, you wire the electrics on top, you switch it on — and then you find out what you got wrong.

Build with real parts

Solenoids, gears from 8 to 32 teeth, connecting rods, crank pins, bearings, shafts, drive wheels, flywheels, a contact breaker, capacitors, a resistor, a switch. Every part has a data sheet, real dimensions and a place where it fits. Nothing snaps magically into position: if your two shafts sit a few millimetres too far apart, the gears will not mesh, and the game will tell you by how much.

Nothing is faked

Ten thousand times a second, the game solves a real system of equations to find the voltage at every point of your build and the current in every wire. That is why your machine behaves like a machine. It stalls at dead centre until you fit a flywheel. Your breaker contacts erode spark by spark until they stop conducting — and a capacitor in the right place will save them. The connecting rod tears off if you stretch the linkage too far.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chart your fortune across a living galaxy. In 4096 Space Traders Era, you are a trader-pilot working your way from star to star, hunting the best deals the universe has to offer.

Explore a fully 3D galaxy: scroll through star systems, dive into each system to inspect its planets, and pick your next destination from a sprawling map where distance and reachability matter. On every world, the trading and stock screen puts a live market at your fingertips — buy commodities cheap on one planet, haul them across space, and sell them dear. Track your cargo, your positions, and your profit and loss in real time, because your one true goal is to grow the combined value of your cash and stock to the very top.

But the void is not empty. Every journey to a planet can drop you into a dogfight against alien fighters — dodge, out-fly and out-shoot them with guns and missiles while your Quantum Energy and ammo drain away. Whether you're winning or losing the battle, you can open comms and negotiate with the aliens to settle the fight and finish your journey on your own terms.

Trade, fly, fight, and deal your way to the richest hold in the galaxy.

- Deep 3D exploration — Scroll a detailed, navigable star map, jump between systems within your hyperdrive's range, and drop into any system to survey its planets before choosing where to trade next.

- Living market & stock screen — Buy low, sell high across thousands of worlds. A real-time trading board and inventory screen track your cargo, average cost, current market value and profit/loss, with prices that drift and evolve as the galactic economy simulates day by day (complete with price history and sparklines).

- One goal: build your fortune — Your net worth is the combined value of your cash + stock. Grow it as high as you can, chase the top "Stock and Cash Value," and beat your own peak.

- Alien dogfights — Every trip to a planet can erupt into combat. Pilot your fighter, manage Quantum Energy and ammo, and fight off alien waves with guns and missiles.

- Negotiate your way out — Win or lose, open comms with the aliens to settle any battle and continue your journey on your terms.

- Risk & permanence — Manage fuel, hull damage and cargo weight between trips, repair at station, and play with optional permadeath for a true high-stakes run.

Welcome to Night Drive - Anomaly, a supernatural driving horror experience where you find yourself trapped on a mysterious road that seems to have no end.

But be careful.

Choose the wrong road and the night will reset. Encounter the wrong anomaly, and your journey may come to an end.

Keep driving. Watch the road. Find the anomalies.

*Can you escape the loop before the night consumes you?*

store_data.about_the_game:
Clean out the abandoned house with your coworkers!

You and your crew have been sent to clean a house nobody else would touch.

Mop the floors, scrub the walls, take out the trash. Once it is all done, get in the truck and go home. That is it.

Oh, was there something else in the safety briefing?

Scrub every corner

The filth is not only on the floor. It is on the walls and on the ceiling too, so get every last spot.

Mops, brooms, buckets, even a pressure washer!

Pick the right tool for the stain in front of you.

Buy upgraded cleaning gear

Trash and junk will not move themselves. Everything you pick up goes in the bin!

Sounds like too much work?

A robot vacuum is standing by to collect the trash for you!

The shop stocks plenty of other tools too, so work hard and make some money.

Evict the current residents

These houses have been abandoned for a long time. There is no way they stayed empty.

Inside the walls, above the ceilings and under the floors, something has already settled in,

and it sees you as an intruder, not a cleaner.

You cannot reason with them, so make your case with a shotgun.

Dispose of the bodies

If your luck runs out, a coworker gets dragged off whole and turns up hanging from the ceiling.

The enemies you kill do not simply disappear either.

They are no longer enemies or coworkers, just more trash for you to take out.

Clean up and get out

Your employer does not care how tired you are, or even how badly you are hurt.

Once you hit the cleanliness the contract asked for, you can send the truck on its way again.

Finish the job before the time runs out and move on to the next house.

And do not forget to bring your coworkers along.

store_data.about_the_game:
POOL, BUT NOBODY PLAYS FAIR

Cue Chaos is a billiards game for people who cheat. Every round each

player drops a sabotage gadget on the table — then everyone has to

play around it. Mines fling balls across the felt. Portals swallow a

shot and spit it out somewhere else. Glue stops a ball dead. Oil makes

it never stop at all.

Play solo against bots, online with friends, or on the same keyboard.

One to four players, teams or free-for-all.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY

RELAX — Solo pool with no clock and no bots. Balls come back out, the

table never empties. Just you, practising.

CLASSIC — Straight eight-ball. Your colour, then the black. No gadgets,

no excuses.

CHAOS — Classic rules, plus a gadget from every player, every round.

The table changes shape faster than you can plan a shot.

POOL FOOTBALL — The pockets are plugged and there is a goal at each end,

with a keeper patrolling it. One ball, two sides, and your own balls

become the defensive wall.

HOT POTATO — Classic eight-ball with one difference: the cue ball is on

fire and travels five times faster. Control it or lose it.

EIGHT GADGETS TO RUIN A SHOT

MINE — Blows up whatever hits it, including your own ball

PORTAL — Placed in pairs; a ball enters one and leaves the other

MAGNET — Drags in anything that rolls too close

GLUE — Whatever touches it sticks fast

OIL — Balls crossing it never slow down

BUMPER — Flings balls away like pinball

WALL — Blocks the lane and rewrites your angles

PLUG — Seals a pocket completely

BUILT FOR A TABLE FULL OF FRIENDS

Steam voice chat built in, so you can hear exactly how betrayed they

feel. Eight table designs to play on. Thirty languages. Bots that

actually aim, at three difficulty levels, so a missing player never

ends the night.

store_data.about_the_game:
You take charge of a small shop and run it for 100 days.

Customers walk through the door looking for medicine, equipment, and food.

The basics are simple. Understand what they need, choose the right items,
place them on the tray, and hand them over.

What you sell, how much you sell, and what price you charge are all up to you.

Interpret Each Customer's Request

  • “Three healing potions.” A straightforward order.

  • “Give me something for a snakebite.” Work out which item fits the purpose.

  • “I have the worst luck... Got anything that might help?” Figure out what the customer truly wants.

  • Some customers communicate only through icons.

Choose the wrong item and the customer will be disappointed.

Make too many mistakes and they may leave empty-handed.

Had you known where they were headed, you might have chosen more carefully.

Put Each Order Together on the Tray

Choose items from your stock, place them on the tray, and decide the quantity and combination.

Give customers exactly what they ask for, recommend something else, add extra items, or send them away with nothing.

Choices in this game are not made in a dialogue box. They are made across the counter.

Keep Goods Moving and Expand Your Stock

Customers do more than buy.

Purchase the ore, hides, and bones they bring in, then sell them to wholesalers.

Watch the market, time your deals, and earn a profit.

Invest in your shop and business partners.

Before long, newly developed products will appear on your shelves.

Set Your Own Prices

The suggested price is only a guideline.

Raise prices to increase your profit, or sell at a loss to help a customer in need.

You can also give items away for free or refuse the transaction entirely.

The ledger remembers every deal you make.

And Then, the End Arrives

One day, you will leave this shop behind.

Whether business went well or poorly, the final day will always come.

Some customers will return. Others will never walk through the door again.

Your final ledger will reveal what you left behind the counter.

store_data.about_the_game:
From Watching Fireworks to Creating Them.

BURST NOIR - Fireworks Simulator is a fireworks show creation game where you design your own displays and bring them to life across the night sky.

Choose from fireworks with different colors, shapes, and visual characteristics, then arrange them along a timeline.
Control when they launch, how they overlap, and how the show builds from one moment to the next.

You can let a single firework bloom in the silence of the night.
Or launch wave after wave until the entire sky erupts into a spectacular finale.

Once your show is complete, play it back and watch your creation unfold against a nighttime landscape of mountains and water.

Create Your Own Fireworks Show

Choose from a library of fireworks with different visual characteristics and freely arrange them along the timeline.

You decide:

  • Which fireworks to use

  • When each one launches

  • How much time to leave between bursts

  • When to suddenly fill the entire sky

Even when using the same fireworks, changing their combinations and timing can completely transform the atmosphere of a show.

Create anything from quiet compositions built around space and silence to dense sequences of explosions that illuminate the entire night sky.

Complete Missions and Unlock New Fireworks

BURST NOIR features missions that challenge you to create fireworks shows under a variety of conditions.

Work within limited budgets, available fireworks, launch counts, timing requirements, and other restrictions as you build a show that satisfies each mission.

Progress through the missions to unlock new fireworks and new challenges.

It is not simply about launching as many fireworks as possible.

Choosing which firework to use and exactly when to launch it is part of the experience.

20 Original Music Tracks

BURST NOIR includes 20 original music tracks created to accompany your fireworks shows.

Play music in the background while your fireworks launch and enjoy your completed show together with its soundtrack.

Colors, density, timing, and music.
Combine them to create a night sky that feels entirely your own.

Create It. Then Watch It.

When you finish editing, play your fireworks show from beginning to end.

Light spreading across the night sky.
Mountains silhouetted against the glow.
Fireworks reflected across the surface of the water.

Individual launches placed in the editor become a complete performance the moment the show begins.

Create overwhelming chains of explosions.
Or make use of silence and empty space to build a more restrained display.

Design the night sky.

Create your own fireworks show in BURST NOIR.

Videos, Livestreaming, and Monetization

Gameplay videos, livestreams, commentary, reviews, and other video content featuring BURST NOIR may be freely published by both individuals and organizations.

Monetization through the standard features provided by video and streaming platforms is permitted.

All in-game music is original and is not registered with YouTube Content ID.

Gameplay videos and livestreams that include the in-game music may also be published and monetized.

C:\ > Immersive_File_Sorting_Simulator <

It's 1998 and lighting hit some family's PC. Every file survived... just not in the right places. It's up to you, the IT professional, to put it all back.

Navigate ~3,000 files across a deep, branching tree of folders, each themed around which files belong there. Games in games, taxes in taxes, and "homework" in homework.

D:\ > Take_Your_Time <

  • Cozy and satisfying, take as long as you need

  • Light detective work as some files are more obvious than others

  • Tools are buried in the mess, dig them out to help you sort and file with ease

  • Sometimes things just go in the trash

E:\ > Choose_Your_Era <

  • Pick from 3 themes: Cleaner 98, Cleaner XP, and iCleaner

  • Relax to a 90's-inspired liquid DnB Soundtrack

  • Collect music also buried within the files to play on the media player and visualizer

F:\ > Ways_To_Play <

  • The main campaign is single player, with the goal of putting away ~3000 files

  • Each campaign is procedurally generated, so no two hunts are the same

  • There is also an abridged Speedrun Time-Attack mode with a leaderboard

store_data.about_the_game:
You have one presidential term to preserve the republic.

Over 48 months, ministers, diplomats, investigators, military officers, activists, and ordinary citizens will bring urgent issues to your desk. Each case offers two defensible choices. Neither guarantees safety, and every signature changes the country's future.

Information is incomplete. Decisions are final. Consequences remember everything.

Behind a confident report may lie a disputed source, an unaccounted cost, or a warning hidden in an appendix. Open the supporting documents and examine them with a pixel-art magnifying glass before choosing a political course.

Evidence can reveal what the speaker left unsaid. You may request a second opinion, postpone certain decisions, or act immediately - but delay carries a political price of its own.

Your decisions continuously affect five indicators:

  • Public trust

  • Economy

  • State capacity

  • World standing

  • Tension

Keeping only one indicator high is not enough. A prosperous country can lose the trust of its citizens. A powerful state can provoke a crisis. International success sometimes demands concessions at home. If one of the critical systems collapses, your presidency may end early.

The cabinet is more than a list of names. Ministers have their own skills, loyalties, and political views. Request second opinions, deal with internal disagreements, and reshuffle the government when it needs a new direction.

Your allies remember whose advice you followed, which promises you broke, and who was forced to pay for your decisions.

Your presidential tools expand as the game progresses:

  • Examine evidence and classified documents

  • Manage a cabinet of recurring political characters

  • Pass laws with immediate and long-term effects

  • Build relations with fictional states

  • Face multi-stage crises under time pressure

  • Track previous decisions, active consequences, and the history of your term

Early decisions can unlock follow-up events several months later. Reforms create delayed consequences, allies remember previous agreements, and unresolved problems return in more dangerous forms.

Each new game uses a reproducible world seed and creates a different sequence of events, consequences, and character stories across the 48-month term. The complete pool contains hundreds of political events and documents in Russian and English.

It is impossible to see everything in one playthrough. Different priorities, cabinet relationships, and national conditions lead to new crises, opportunities, and endings.

Reach the election—or lose power before it arrives.

Your final legacy is determined not only by the state of the republic, but also by the history of your actions. You may be remembered as an architect of peace, a constitutional reformer, or the president of a stable republic. Your term may also end in economic collapse, international isolation, a cabinet revolt, or catastrophe.

After the presidency ends, the game creates a detailed report covering final indicators, laws, evidence, broken promises, cabinet loyalty, international relations, achievements, and key decisions.

A complete 48-month term usually takes 2–4 hours, depending on how carefully you read documents and study the political archive. A systemic crisis may end the presidency earlier.

The game is designed for repeated playthroughs, testing different political principles, and discovering consequences that went unnoticed during a previous term.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Smoke Keeper is a cozy first-person organizing simulator set in a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. The night's delivery has been scattered across the shop, and 4,316 boxes, cartons, tins, jars, pouches and accessories must be put back where they belong before morning.

Every item carries a number, and every place on every shelf carries the matching engraved plate. Read the stock, find its bay and shelf, and turn complete chaos into perfect order.

Gameplay

Pick stock up by the armful, cycle through the stack in your hands, and carry each piece to its correct place. The shop itself is your guide: gilt bay letters, shelf plates and a detailed plan help you navigate the building rather than follow a quest list.

Cigars are a job of their own. Find a key for a locked shipping case, open it, then pack each house's cigars by hand into its display boxes.

Make the Shop Your Own

In Cozy mode, completed rows earn skill points. Unlock and improve helpful abilities including Quick Order, Target Hint, Spot Matches, Auto-Place and Batch Grab to make every route through the shop more efficient.

Prefer a challenge? Speedrun removes the help, starts the clock on your first step, and records your best time on the leaderboard.

Features

  • Sort 4,316 pieces of stock across one hand-built two-storey shop

  • Match every item to its numbered bay, shelf and display

  • Unlock five efficiency skills in relaxed Cozy mode

  • Pack cigars from locked shipping cases into their correct display boxes

  • Race in Speedrun mode and compete for a faster finishing time

  • Save your progress and return to the same night whenever you like

  • Full controller support plus rebindable keyboard and mouse controls

store_data.about_the_game:
BLEAK COORDINATES is a psychological survival horror game set deep within a remote mountain valley, where a missing person investigation leads to a place that should not exist.

You take the role of an investigator following a trail of disappearances to an isolated village hidden far from civilization. The coordinates are real. The village is there. But something about it is terribly wrong.

Abandoned homes stand frozen in time. Strange symbols appear throughout the village. Bodies are found in places they should never have reached, and the deeper you investigate, the more the line between a serial murder case and something far more disturbing begins to disappear.

Explore the village and its surrounding wilderness, search abandoned buildings, uncover documents and evidence, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters with those who still wander the valley.

But the village is only the beginning.

Something lies beneath it.

And someone has gone to great lengths to make sure no one discovers the truth.

FEATURES

  • Atmospheric Survival Horror — Explore an isolated mountain village filled with oppressive environments and constant uncertainty.

  • Investigation & Exploration — Search crime scenes, abandoned buildings, hidden paths, and underground locations for clues.

  • Environmental Puzzles — Use evidence and objects found throughout the world to uncover new areas and secrets.

  • Limited Resources — Manage your supplies carefully and decide when to fight, hide, or escape.

  • A Dark Mystery — Follow a seemingly ordinary investigation into something far larger and more horrifying.

  • Connected Horror Universe — Discover subtle connections to events beyond the village and uncover another piece of a much larger story.

Some coordinates were never meant to be found.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Giant Pile of Bricks Is Waiting

Brick by Brick is a first-person sorting and building sandbox filled with thousands of colorful bricks just waiting to be organized.

Start with piles containing roughly 4,000 loose pieces and a room full of empty shelves. Pick up each brick, figure out where it belongs, and watch the room slowly transform as the shelves fill piece by piece.

There is no timer and no need to rush. Sort a few pieces when you have a few minutes, or settle in and organize the whole collection.

SORT IT YOUR WAY

Every brick has a proper place based on its style and color. Find the right shelf, put it away, and earn points based on the studs on the piece.

As your collection grows, unlock abilities that make tackling the piles a little easier.

Finder helps you locate the brick you are searching for.

Summon pulls bricks directly toward you when you need a helping hand.

The more you sort, the more useful your abilities become.

THEN BUILD SOMETHING

The bricks are not only there to be organized.

Use build plates and free-building areas to create your own designs piece by piece. Experiment with different bricks, colors, shapes, and structures without being limited to a predetermined set of instructions.

Finish sorting the collection to open up even more room for building and experimenting.

OR MAKE A MESS AGAIN

Finally got everything exactly where it belongs?

Good.

Now shake it all up.

Trigger an earthquake and send the collection tumbling back into chaos, then start sorting all over again. You can also return pieces to the shelves when you want to reset without the destruction.

PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

Brick by Brick can be enjoyed entirely on your own, but you do not have to sort alone.

Host an online room and share the room code with a friend so they can join your game. Sort, explore, and build together over the internet.

FEATURES

• Thousands of individual bricks to sort

• Shelves that visibly fill as you organize the collection

• Sorting by brick style and color

• Points based on each brick's stud count

• Finder and Summon abilities

• First-person free building

• Multiple building areas

• Physics-based brick interaction

• Earthquakes that turn an organized room back into a giant mess

• Persistent save files

• Single-player play

• Online multiplayer

• Keyboard and mouse support

• Full controller gameplay

• Steam achievements and statistics

• No timers or pressure to finish

Whether you want the satisfaction of turning chaos into order, the freedom to build something new, or the questionable decision to destroy hours of organization with an earthquake, Brick by Brick lets you do it one piece at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
DRIVE EVERYWHERE

CLINK is a red versus blue vehicle combat game set on a single continuous driving surface. The floor, walls, and ceiling are interconnected, allowing you to drive straight up a wall, continue onto the ceiling, and fight upside down. Everyone uses the same surfaces, so opponents can approach from the front, behind, or above.

Your grip keeps you attached to the arena. A Rammer can break it with a boost charge, while a Minelayer can blast you off a surface with a mine. If you lose your grip, you will fall, and the same happens to your wrecked vehicle.



SIX CLASSES

  • Tank — A balanced all-rounder with an aiming turret and no real weaknesses.

  • Sniper — Slow and fragile, it deals high damage at long range, has a zoom scope, and fires flat shots with little bullet drop.

  • Bruiser — The toughest class, it carries a short-range shotgun that is devastating up close and weak at a distance.

  • Kart — Fast and fragile, it has rapid-fire guns fixed forward and uses car-style steering.

  • Minelayer — Carries no gun and deals damage with proximity mines that stick to floors, walls, and ceilings.

  • Rammer — Carries no gun and attacks using a short boost charge that causes heavy contact damage.

The classes counter each other. Snipers punish players caught in the open. Karts and Rammers can get inside their range. Minelayers and Rammers can punish fast flankers.



USE THE ARENA

Mines can be destroyed by gunfire. Shoot an enemy mine to clear a path, or shoot your own mine when an opponent is nearby.

Arenas contain bounce pads, boost pads, conveyors, breakable cover, moving platforms, and hazards. A bounce pad can launch you from the floor to the ceiling or from one wall to another. A conveyor can carry you upside down along the ceiling. Breakable cover can create new routes during a match.

Some arenas are structures drifting in open space. You can drive around their outside, over the top, along the sides, and underneath, with a starfield extending beyond the edge. Weapons fire perfectly flat at any range. A Rammer can launch you far away from the structure. You have about five seconds to get back or you will die.



PLAY YOUR WAY

Team Deathmatch, Free-for-all, and Four-team cover the standard fights. Surface Paint uses the arena itself as the scoreboard. Floor Is Lava floods the floor, forcing everyone to climb onto the walls. Invasion is a cooperative survival mode against alien waves that crawl on the walls and ceilings. In WYRM, one player becomes a growing snake of tank segments that wraps across every surface and kills on contact. King of the Hill, Gun Game, Infection, and Racing complete the list.

Bots drive every class and use every surface, so they never sit idle on the floor. Difficulty ranges from an easy warm-up to a level that can defeat you. The entire game can be played offline against bots.

You can play through single-player story missions, practice against target dummies and spawnable bots, or take it online. A one-click scan finds LAN games on your network, and local splitscreen works in any mode on a single screen.



BUILD AND SHARE

A variety of hand-built arenas range from tight duel boxes to open fields and drifting wrecks. The built-in map editor allows you to create an arena and play it immediately, then share it through Steam Workshop.

You can design your own emblem, and it will appear on your vehicle for everyone online to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
NEBULA BLINK is a real-time space-fleet tactics game where positioning is firepower. Command warships, carriers, strike craft and orbital installations through a 35-operation campaign fought from both sides of a galactic war.

A FLEET, NOT A DOOM STACK

  • Command formations: select several ships and they preserve their relative spacing around the lead vessel. Keep a battle line intact, split it to envelop, or concentrate it for a breakthrough.

  • Bring weapons to bear: guns fire from their actual mounts and arcs. Broadside launchers, all-round point defense and a front-only spinal beam all demand different headings.

  • Read the whole sector: radar, fog of war, contact records and terrain matter as much as the ship directly under your cursor.

EVERY SHOT HAS CONSEQUENCES

  • The Solray-class beam battleship's spinal weapon has an extremely narrow forward arc. Its beam pierces every unit on the line, including friendly ships.

  • Gravity lances are slow, scarce and punishing. Lead the target or turn the hull before the firing window closes.

  • Damage persists: fire slows reloads, fuel leaks shorten aircraft endurance, flight decks can be knocked offline, weapon mounts can be disabled or destroyed, and accumulated speed loss can stop a ship outright.

RUN THE CARRIER WAR

Carriers and orbital fortresses launch three kinds of craft: space-superiority fighters, humanoid assault craft and lance/bomb attackers. Choose aircraft and launch strength by hangar slot. Attackers can switch between Lance, Bomb and unarmed loadouts; changing the loadout imposes maintenance time, so commit before the next wave launches.

TEN TERRAIN TYPES

Fight across deep space, plasma belts, asteroids, asteroid fields, dark nebula masses, fortress walls, giant asteroids, debris fields, fortress cores and plasma streams. Depending on the terrain, ships may slow, accuracy may fall, projectiles may be blocked or detonated, and plasma streams can physically push ships and lances out of the flow.

35 OPERATIONS, TWO PERSPECTIVES

  • The first five operations are guided tutorials.

  • Complete all 35 operations as the Planetary Union to unlock the Galactic Empire campaign.

  • Replay the same war from the Empire side with its own progression and alternate briefings.

  • Each faction fields 16 unit types spanning warships, support vessels, facilities and strike craft.

POST-CAMPAIGN CREATION TOOLS

These tools unlock after completing both faction campaigns.

  • Unit Arsenal: edit hull, shield, speed, turn rate, armor, visibility, hangars, weapon statistics, firing arcs and mount positions.

  • Scenario Editor: paint a 360x270 sector, place both fleets, and configure victory conditions, time limits and reinforcements.

The configuration menu also includes editable terminology dictionaries for Japanese, English and Italian.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

Minimum target: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), 1280x720 display, HTML5 Canvas-capable graphics.

Single-player game. Network multiplayer is not included in this release.

AI USE, MODS AND RIGHTS

Parts of this work's production use AI-generated or AI-assisted content and tools, including Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude.

Purchasers may use this work with AI tools, including for AI learning or training, and may create, distribute or sell MODs and modified products at their own responsibility. You are responsible for legal compliance, third-party rights and the rules of any service or marketplace you use.

Copyright is not waived. Where reasonably possible, please identify NEBULA BLINK as the source and preserve relevant credits.
